8.71.e: Let our songs come anear to him beauteous and bright with piercing flame Our offerings, with our homage, to the Lord of wealth, to him whom many praise, for help:

8.71.d: अग्निं सूनुं सहसो जातवेदसं दानाय वार्याणाम् । द्विता यो भूदमृतो मर्त्येष्वा होता मन्द्रतमो विशि ॥
8.71.e: To Agni Jātavedas, to the Son of Strength, that he may give us precious gifts, Immortal, from of old Priest among mortal men, the most delightful in the house.

8.71.d: अग्निं वो देवयज्ययाग्निं प्रयत्यध्वरे । अग्निं धीषु प्रथममग्निमर्वत्यग्निं क्षैत्राय साधसे ॥
8.71.e: Agni, made yours by sacrifice, Agni, while holy rites advance; Agni, the first in songs, first with the warrior steed; Agril to win the land for us.

8.71.d: अग्निरिषां सख्ये ददातु न ईशे यो वार्याणाम् । अग्निं तोके तनये शश्वदीमहे वसुं सन्तं तनूपाम् ॥
8.71.e: May Agni who is Lord of wealth vouchsafe us food for friendship sake. Agni we ever seek for seed and progeny, the Vasu who protects our lives.

8.71.d: अग्निमीळिष्वावसे गाथाभिः शीरशोचिषम् । अग्निं राये पुरुमीळ्ह श्रुतं नरोऽग्निं सुदीतये छर्दिः ॥
8.71.e: Solicit with your chants, for help, Agni the God with piercing flame, For riches famous Agni, Purumīlha and ye men! Agni to light our dwelling well.

8.71.d: अग्निं द्वेषो योतवै नो गृणीमस्यग्निं शं योश्च दातवे । विश्वासु विक्ष्ववितेव हव्यो भुवद्वस्तुर्ऋषूणाम् ॥
8.71.e: Agni we laud that he may keep our foes afar, Agni to give us health and strength. Let him as Guardian be invoked in all the tribes, the lighter-up of glowing brands.

8.72.d: हविष्कृणुध्वमा गमदध्वर्युर्वनते पुनः । विद्वाँ अस्य प्रशासनम् ॥
8.72.e: PREPARE oblation: let him come; and let the minister serve again  Who knows the ordering thereof,

8.72.d: नि तिग्ममभ्यं१शुं सीदद्धोता मनावधि । जुषाणो अस्य सख्यम् ॥
8.72.e: Rejoicing in his friendship, let the priest be seated over man,  Beside the shoot of active power.

8.72.d: अन्तरिच्छन्ति तं जने रुद्रं परो मनीषया । गृभ्णन्ति जिह्वया ससम् ॥
8.72.e: Him, glowing bright beyond all thought, they seek among the race of man;  With him for  tongue  they seize the food.
He hath inflamed the twofold plain: life-giving, he hath climbed the wood,  And with his tongue hath struck the rock.

8.72.d: चरन्वत्सो रुशन्निह निदातारं न विन्दते । वेति स्तोतव अम्ब्यम् ॥
8.72.e: Wandering here the radiant Calf finds none to fetter him, and seeks  The Mother to declare his praise.

8.72.d: उतो न्वस्य यन्महदश्वावद्योजनं बृहद् । दामा रथस्य ददृशे ॥
8.72.e: And now that great and mighty team, the team of horses that are his,  And traces of his car, are seen.

8.72.d: दुहन्ति सप्तैकामुप द्वा पञ्च सृजतः । तीर्थे सिन्धोरधि स्वरे ॥
8.72.e: The seven milk a single cow; the two set other five to work,  On the stream's loud-resounding bank.

8.72.d: आ दशभिर्विवस्वत इन्द्रः कोशमचुच्यवीत् । खेदया त्रिवृता दिवः ॥
8.72.e: Entreated by Vivasvān's ten, Indra cast down the water-jar  With threefold hammer from the sky.

8.72.d: परि त्रिधातुरध्वरं जूर्णिरेति नवीयसी । मध्वा होतारो अञ्जते ॥
8.72.e: Three times the newly-kindled flame proceeds around the sacrifice:  The priests anoint it with the meath.
With reverence they drain the fount that circles with its wheel above,  Exhaustless, with the mouth below.

8.72.d: अभ्यारमिदद्रयो निषिक्तं पुष्करे मधु । अवतस्य विसर्जने ॥
8.72.e: The pressing-stones are set at work: the meath is poured into the tank,  At the out-shedding of the fount.

8.72.d: गाव उपावतावतं मही यज्ञस्य रप्सुदा । उभा कर्णा हिरण्यया ॥
8.72.e: Ye cows, protect the fount: the two Mighty Ones bless the sacrifice.  The handles twain are wrought of gold.

8.72.d: आ सुते सिञ्चत श्रियं रोदस्योरभिश्रियम् । रसा दधीत वृषभम् ॥
8.72.e: Pour on the juice the ornament which reaches both the heaven and earth  Supply the liquid to the Bull.

8.72.d: ते जानत स्वमोक्यं१ सं वत्सासो न मातृभिः । मिथो नसन्त जामिभिः ॥
8.72.e: These know their own abiding-place: like calves beside the mother cows  They meet together with their kin.

8.72.d: उप स्रक्वेषु बप्सतः कृण्वते धरुणं दिवि । इन्द्रे अग्ना नमः स्वः ॥
8.72.e: Devouring in their greedy jaws, they make sustaining food in heaven,  To Indra, Agni light and prayer.
The Pious One milked out rich food, sustenance dealt in portions seven,  Together with the Sun's seven rays.

8.72.d: सोमस्य मित्रावरुणोदिता सूर आ ददे । तदातुरस्य भेषजम् ॥
8.72.e: I took some Soma when the Sun rose up, O Mitra, Varuṇa.  That is the sick man's medicine.

8.72.d: उतो न्वस्य यत्पदं हर्यतस्य निधान्यम् । परि द्यां जिह्वयातनत् ॥
8.72.e: From where oblations must be laid, which is the Well-beloved's home,  He with his tongue hath compassed heaven.

8.73.d: उदीराथामृतायते युञ्जाथामश्विना रथम् । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
8.73.e: ROUSE ye for him who keeps the Law, yoke your steeds, Aśvins, to your car  Let your protecting help be near.

8.73.d: निमिषश्चिज्जवीयसा रथेना यातमश्विना । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
8.73.e: Come, Aśvins, with your car more swift than is the twinkling of an eye  Let your protecting help be near.

8.73.d: उप स्तृणीतमत्रये हिमेन घर्ममश्विना । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
8.73.e: Aśvins, ye overlaid with cold the fiery pit for Atri's sake:  Let your protecting help be near.

8.73.d: कुह स्थः कुह जग्मथुः कुह श्येनेव पेतथुः । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
8.73.e: Where are ye? whither are ye gone? whither, like falcons, have ye flown?  Let your protecting help be near.

8.73.d: यदद्य कर्हि कर्हि चिच्छुश्रूयातमिमं हवम् । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
8.73.e: If ye at any time this day are listening to this my call,  Let your protecting help be near.

8.73.d: अश्विना यामहूतमा नेदिष्ठं याम्याप्यम् । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
8.73.e: The Aśvins, first to hear our prayer, for closest kinship I approach:  Let your protecting help be near.

8.73.d: अवन्तमत्रये गृहं कृणुतं युवमश्विना । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
8.73.e: For Atri ye, O Aśvins, made a dwelling-place to shield him well,  Let your protecting help be near.

8.73.d: वरेथे अग्निमातपो वदते वल्ग्वत्रये । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
8.73.e: Ye warded off the fervent heat for Atri when he sweetly spake:  Let your protecting help be near.

8.73.d: प्र सप्तवध्रिराशसा धारामग्नेरशायत । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
8.73.e: Erst Saptavadhri by his prayer obtained the trenchant edge of fire:  Let your protecting help be near.

8.73.d: इहा गतं वृषण्वसू शृणुतं म इमं हवम् । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
8.73.e: Come hither, O ye Lords of wealth, and listen to this call of mine:  Let your protecting help be near.

8.73.d: किमिदं वां पुराणवज्जरतोरिव शस्यते । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
8.73.e: What is this praise told forth of you as Elders in the ancient way?  Let your protecting help be near.

8.73.d: समानं वां सजात्यं समानो बन्धुरश्विना । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
8.73.e: One common brotherhood is yours, Aśvins your kindred is the same:  Let your protecting help be near.

8.73.d: यो वां रजांस्यश्विना रथो वियाति रोदसी । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
8.73.e: This is your chariot, Aśvins, which speeds through the regions, earth and heaven: Let your protecting aid be near.

8.73.d: आ नो गव्येभिरश्व्यैः सहस्रैरुप गच्छतम् । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
8.73.e: Approach ye hitherward to us with thousands both of steeds and kine : Let your protecting help be near.

8.73.d: मा नो गव्येभिरश्व्यैः सहस्रेभिरति ख्यतम् । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
8.73.e: Pass us not by, remember us with thousands both of kine and steeds; Let your protecting help be near.
The purple tinted Dawn hath risen, and true to Law hath made the light: Let your protecting help be near.

8.73.d: अश्विना सु विचाकशद्वृक्षं परशुमाँ इव । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
8.73.e: He looked upon the Aśvins, as an axe-armed man upon a tree: Let your protecting help be near.

8.73.d: पुरं न धृष्णवा रुज कृष्णया बाधितो विशा । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
8.73.e: By the black band encompassed round, break it down, bold one, like a fort. Let your protecting help be near.

8.74.d: विशोविशो वो अतिथिं वाजयन्तः पुरुप्रियम् । अग्निं वो दुर्यं वचः स्तुषे शूषस्य मन्मभिः ॥
8.74.e: EXERTING all our strength with thoughts of power we glorify in speech  Agni your dear familiar Friend, the darling Guest in every home.

8.74.d: यं जनासो हविष्मन्तो मित्रं न सर्पिरासुतिम् । प्रशंसन्ति प्रशस्तिभिः ॥
8.74.e: Whom, served with sacrificial oil like Mitra, men presenting gifts  Eulogize with their songs of praise
Much-lauded Jātavedas, him who bears oblations up to heaven  Prepared in service of the Gods.

8.74.d: आगन्म वृत्रहन्तमं ज्येष्ठमग्निमानवम् । यस्य श्रुतर्वा बृहन्नार्क्षो अनीक एधते ॥
8.74.e: To noblest Agni, Friend of man, best Vṛtra-slayer, are we come,  Him in whose presence Rksa's son, mighty Srutarvan, waxes great;
To deathless Jātavedas, meet for praise, adored, with sacred oil,  Visible through the gloom of night

8.74.d: सबाधो यं जना इमे३ऽग्निं हव्येभिरीळते । जुह्वानासो यतस्रुचः ॥
8.74.e: Even Agni whom these priestly men worship with sacrificial gifts,  With lifted ladles offering them.

8.74.d: इयं ते नव्यसी मतिरग्ने अधाय्यस्मदा । मन्द्र सुजात सुक्रतोऽमूर दस्मातिथे ॥
8.74.e: O Agni, this our newest hymn hath been addressed from us to thee,  O cheerful Guest, well-born, most wise, worker of wonders, ne’er deceived.

8.74.d: सा ते अग्ने शंतमा चनिष्ठा भवतु प्रिया । तया वर्धस्व सुष्टुतः ॥
8.74.e: Agni, may it be dear to thee, most grateful, and exceeding sweet:  Grow mightier, eulogized therewith.

8.74.d: सा द्युम्नैर्द्युम्निनी बृहदुपोप श्रवसि श्रवः । दधीत वृत्रतूर्ये ॥
8.74.e: Splendid with splendours may it be, and in the battle with the foe  Add loftier glory to thy fame.

8.74.d: अश्वमिद्गां रथप्रां त्वेषमिन्द्रं न सत्पतिम् । यस्य श्रवांसि तूर्वथ पन्यम्पन्यं च कृष्टयः ॥
8.74.e: Steed, cow, a lord of heroes, bright like Indra, who shall fill the car.  Whose high renown ye celebrate, and people praise each glorious deed.

8.74.d: यं त्वा गोपवनो गिरा चनिष्ठदग्ने अङ्गिरः । स पावक श्रुधी हवम् ॥
8.74.e: Thou whom Gopavana made glad with song, O Agni Aṅgiras,  Hear this my call, thou Holy One.

8.74.d: यं त्वा जनास ईळते सबाधो वाजसातये । स बोधि वृत्रतूर्ये ॥
8.74.e: Thou whom the priestly folk implore to aid the gathering of the spoil,  Such be thou in the fight with foes.

8.74.d: अहं हुवान आर्क्षे श्रुतर्वणि मदच्युति । शर्धांसीव स्तुकाविनां मृक्षा शीर्षा चतुर्णाम् ॥
8.74.e: I, called to him who reels with joy, Srutarvan, Ṛkṣa’s son, shall stroke The heads of four presented steeds, like the long wool of fleecy rams.

8.74.d: मां चत्वार आशवः शविष्ठस्य द्रवित्नवः । सुरथासो अभि प्रयो वक्षन्वयो न तुग्र्यम् ॥
8.74.e: Four coursers with a splendid car, Savistha’s horses, fleet of foot, Shall bring me to the sacred feast, as flying steeds brought Tugra’s son.

8.74.d: सत्यमित्त्वा महेनदि परुष्ण्यव देदिशम् । नेमापो अश्वदातरः शविष्ठादस्ति मर्त्यः ॥
8.74.e: The very truth do I declare to thee, Paruṣṇī, mighty flood. Waters! no man is there who gives more horses than Savishtha gives.

8.75.d: युक्ष्वा हि देवहूतमाँ अश्वाँ अग्ने रथीरिव । नि होता पूर्व्यः सदः ॥
8.75.e: YOKE, Agni, as a charioteer, thy steeds who best invite the Gods: As ancient Herald seat thyself.

8.75.d: उत नो देव देवाँ अच्छा वोचो विदुष्टरः । श्रद्विश्वा वार्या कृधि ॥
8.75.e: And, God, as skilfullest of all, call for us hitherward the Gods:  Give all our wishes sure effect.

8.75.d: त्वं ह यद्यविष्ठ्य सहसः सूनवाहुत । ऋतावा यज्ञियो भुवः ॥
8.75.e: For thou, Most Youthful, Son of Strength, thou to whom sacrifice is paid,  Art holy, faithful to the Law.

8.75.d: अयमग्निः सहस्रिणो वाजस्य शतिनस्पतिः । मूर्धा कवी रयीणाम् ॥
8.75.e: This Agni, Lord of wealth and spoil hundredfold, thousandfold, is head  And chief of riches and a Sage.

8.75.d: तं नेमिमृभवो यथा नमस्व सहूतिभिः । नेदीयो यज्ञमङ्गिरः ॥
8.75.e: As craftsmen bend the felly, so bend at our general call: come nigh,  Aṅgiras, to the sacrifice.

8.75.d: तस्मै नूनमभिद्यवे वाचा विरूप नित्यया । वृष्णे चोदस्व सुष्टुतिम् ॥
8.75.e: Now, O Virūpa, rouse for him, Strong God who shines at early morn,  Fair praise with voice that ceases not.

8.75.d: कमु ष्विदस्य सेनयाग्नेरपाकचक्षसः । पणिं गोषु स्तरामहे ॥
8.75.e: With missile of this Agni, his who looks afar, will we lay low  The thief in combat for the kine.

8.75.d: मा नो देवानां विशः प्रस्नातीरिवोस्राः । कृशं न हासुरघ्न्याः ॥
8.75.e: Let not the Companies of Gods fail us, like Dawns that float away,  Like cows who leave the niggardly.

8.75.d: मा नः समस्य दूढ्य१ः परिद्वेषसो अंहतिः । ऊर्मिर्न नावमा वधीत् ॥
8.75.e: Let not the sinful tyranny of any fiercely hating foe  Smite us, as billows smite a ship.

8.75.d: नमस्ते अग्न ओजसे गृणन्ति देव कृष्टयः । अमैरमित्रमर्दय ॥
8.75.e: O Agni, God, the people sing reverent praise to thee for strength:  With terrors trouble thou the foe.

8.75.d: कुवित्सु नो गविष्टयेऽग्ने संवेषिषो रयिम् । उरुकृदुरु णस्कृधि ॥
8.75.e: Wilt thou not, Agni, lend us aid in winning cattle, winning wealth?  Maker of room, make room for us.

8.75.d: मा नो अस्मिन्महाधने परा वर्ग्भारभृद्यथा । संवर्गं सं रयिं जय ॥
8.75.e: In this great battle cast us not aside as one who bears a load:  Snatch up the wealth and win it all.

8.75.d: अन्यमस्मद्भिया इयमग्ने सिषक्तु दुच्छुना । वर्धा नो अमवच्छवः ॥
8.75.e: O Agni, let this plague pursue and fright another and not us: Make our impetuous strength more strong.
The reverent or unwearied man whose holy labour he accepts, Him Agni favours with success.

8.75.d: परस्या अधि संवतोऽवराँ अभ्या तर । यत्राहमस्मि ताँ अव ॥
8.75.e: Abandoning the foeman’s host pass hither to this company: Assist the men with whom I stand.

8.75.d: विद्मा हि ते पुरा वयमग्ने पितुर्यथावसः । अधा ते सुम्नमीमहे ॥
8.75.e: As we have known thy gracious help, as of a Father, long agi, So now we pray to thee for bliss.

8.76.d: इमं नु मायिनं हुव इन्द्रमीशानमोजसा । मरुत्वन्तं न वृञ्जसे ॥
8.76.e: NOT to forsake me, I invoke this Indra girt by Maruts,  Lord Of magic power who rules with might.

8.76.d: अयमिन्द्रो मरुत्सखा वि वृत्रस्याभिनच्छिरः । वज्रेण शतपर्वणा ॥
8.76.e: This Indra with his Marut Friends clave into pieces Vṛtra's bead  With hundred-knotted thunderbolt.

8.76.d: वावृधानो मरुत्सखेन्द्रो वि वृत्रमैरयत् । सृजन्त्समुद्रिया अपः ॥
8.76.e: Indra, with Marut Friends grown strong, hath rent asunder Vṛtra, and  Released the waters of the sea.

8.76.d: अयं ह येन वा इदं स्वर्मरुत्वता जितम् । इन्द्रेण सोमपीतये ॥
8.76.e: This is that Indra who, begirt by Maruts, won the light of heaven  That he might drink the Soma juice.
Mighty, impetuous, begirt by Maruts, him who loudly roars,  Indra we invocate with songs.

8.76.d: इन्द्रं प्रत्नेन मन्मना मरुत्वन्तं हवामहे । अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
8.76.e: Indra begirt by Maruts we invoke after the ancient plan,  That he may drink the Soma juice.

8.76.d: मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र मीढ्वः पिबा सोमं शतक्रतो । अस्मिन्यज्ञे पुरुष्टुत ॥
8.76.e: O liberal Indra, Marut-girt, much-lauded Śatakratu, drink  The Soma at this sacrifice.

8.76.d: तुभ्येदिन्द्र मरुत्वते सुताः सोमासो अद्रिवः । हृदा हूयन्त उक्थिनः ॥
8.76.e: To thee, O Indra, Marut-girt, these Soma juices, Thunderer!  Are offered from the heart with lauds.

8.76.d: पिबेदिन्द्र मरुत्सखा सुतं सोमं दिविष्टिषु । वज्रं शिशान ओजसा ॥
8.76.e: Drink, Indra, with thy Marut Friends, pressed Soma at the morning rites,  Whetting thy thunderbolt with strength.

8.76.d: उत्तिष्ठन्नोजसा सह पीत्वी शिप्रे अवेपयः । सोममिन्द्र चमू सुतम् ॥
8.76.e: Arising in thy might, thy jaws thou shookest, Indra, having quaffed  The Soma which the mortar pressed.

8.76.d: अनु त्वा रोदसी उभे क्रक्षमाणमकृपेताम् । इन्द्र यद्दस्युहाभवः ॥
8.76.e: Indra, both worlds complained to thee when uttering thy fearful roar,  What time thou smotest Dasyus dead.
From Indra have I measured out a song eight-footed with nine parts,  Delicate, faithful. to the Law.

8.77.d: जज्ञानो नु शतक्रतुर्वि पृच्छदिति मातरम् । क उग्राः के ह शृण्विरे ॥
8.77.e: SCARCELY was Śatakratu, born ẉhen of his Mother he inquired, Who are the mighty? Who are famed?

8.77.d: आदीं शवस्यब्रवीदौर्णवाभमहीशुवम् । ते पुत्र सन्तु निष्टुरः ॥
8.77.e: Then Śavasī declared to him Aurṇavābha, Ahīśuva: Son, these be they thou must o'erthrow

8.77.d: समित्तान्वृत्रहाखिदत्खे अराँ इव खेदया । प्रवृद्धो दस्युहाभवत् ॥
8.77.e: The Vṛtra-slayer smote them all as spokes are hammered into naves: The Dasyu-killer waxed in might.

8.77.d: एकया प्रतिधापिबत्साकं सरांसि त्रिंशतम् । इन्द्रः सोमस्य काणुका ॥
8.77.e: Then Indra at a single draught drank the contents of thirty pails, Pails that were filled with Soma juice.

8.77.d: अभि गन्धर्वमतृणदबुध्नेषु रजःस्वा । इन्द्रो ब्रह्मभ्य इद्वृधे ॥
8.77.e: Indra in groundless realms of space pierced the Gandharva through, that he Might make Brahmans' strength increase.

8.77.d: निराविध्यद्गिरिभ्य आ धारयत्पक्वमोदनम् । इन्द्रो बुन्दं स्वाततम् ॥
8.77.e: Down from the mountains Indra shot hither his well-directed shaft: He gained the ready brew of rice.

8.77.d: शतब्रध्न इषुस्तव सहस्रपर्ण एक इत् । यमिन्द्र चकृषे युजम् ॥
8.77.e: One only is that shaft of thine, with thousand feathers, hundred barbs, Which, Indra, thou hast made thy friend.

8.77.d: तेन स्तोतृभ्य आ भर नृभ्यो नारिभ्यो अत्तवे । सद्यो जात ऋभुष्ठिर ॥
8.77.e: Strong as the Ribhus at thy birth, therewith to those who praise thee, men, And women, bring thou food to eat.

8.77.d: एता च्यौत्नानि ते कृता वर्षिष्ठानि परीणसा । हृदा वीड्वधारयः ॥
8.77.e: By thee these exploits were achieved, the mightiest deeds, abundantly: Firm in thy heart thou settest them.

8.77.d: विश्वेत्ता विष्णुराभरदुरुक्रमस्त्वेषितः । शतं महिषान्क्षीरपाकमोदनं वराहमिन्द्र एमुषम् ॥
8.77.e: All these things Viṣṇu brought, the Lord of ample stride whom thou hadst sent- A hundred buffaloes, a brew of rice and milk: and Indra, slew the ravening boar

8.77.d: तुविक्षं ते सुकृतं सूमयं धनुः साधुर्बुन्दो हिरण्ययः । उभा ते बाहू रण्या सुसंस्कृत ऋदूपे चिदृदूवृधा ॥
8.77.e: Most deadly is thy bow, successful, fashioned well: good is thine arrow, decked with gold. Warlike and well equipped thine arms are, which increase sweetness for him who drinks the sweet.

8.78.d: पुरोळाशं नो अन्धस इन्द्र सहस्रमा भर । शता च शूर गोनाम् ॥
8.78.e: BRING us a thousand, Indra, as our guerdon for the Soma juice: Hundreds of kine, O Hero, bring.

8.78.d: आ नो भर व्यञ्जनं गामश्वमभ्यञ्जनम् । सचा मना हिरण्यया ॥
8.78.e: Bring cattle, bring us ornament, bring us embellishment and steeds, Give us, besides, two rings of gold.

8.78.d: उत नः कर्णशोभना पुरूणि धृष्णवा भर । त्वं हि शृण्विषे वसो ॥
8.78.e: And, Bold One, bring in ample store rich jewels to adorn the ear, For thou, Good Lord, art far renowned.

8.78.d: नकीं वृधीक इन्द्र ते न सुषा न सुदा उत । नान्यस्त्वच्छूर वाघतः ॥
8.78.e: None other is there for the priest, Hero! but thou, to give him gifts, To win much spoil and prosper him.

8.78.d: नकीमिन्द्रो निकर्तवे न शक्रः परिशक्तवे । विश्वं शृणोति पश्यति ॥
8.78.e: Indra can never be brought low, Śakra can never be subdued: He heareth and beholdeth all.

8.78.d: स मन्युं मर्त्यानामदब्धो नि चिकीषते । पुरा निदश्चिकीषते ॥
8.78.e: He spieth out the wrath of man, he who can never be deceived: Ere blame can come he marketh it.

8.78.d: क्रत्व इत्पूर्णमुदरं तुरस्यास्ति विधतः । वृत्रघ्नः सोमपाव्नः ॥
8.78.e: He hath his stomach full of might, the Vṛtra-slayer, Conqueror, The Soma-drinker, ordering all.

8.78.d: त्वे वसूनि संगता विश्वा च सोम सौभगा । सुदात्वपरिह्वृता ॥
8.78.e: In thee all treasures are combined, Soma all blessed things in thee, Uninjured, easy to bestow.
To thee speeds forth my hope that craves the gift of corn, and kine and gold, Yea, craving horses, speeds to thee.

8.78.d: तवेदिन्द्राहमाशसा हस्ते दात्रं चना ददे । दिनस्य वा मघवन्त्सम्भृतस्य वा पूर्धि यवस्य काशिना ॥
8.78.e: Indra, through hope in thee alone even this sickle do I grasp. Fill my hand, Maghavan, with all that it can hold of barley cut or gathered up.

8.79.e: THIS here is Soma, ne'er restrained, active, all-conquering bursting forth, Rishi and Sage by sapience,

8.79.d: अभ्यूर्णोति यन्नग्नं भिषक्ति विश्वं यत्तुरम् । प्रेमन्धः ख्यन्निः श्रोणो भूत् ॥
8.79.e: All that is bare he covers o'er, all that is sick he medicines; The blind man sees, the cripple walks.

8.79.d: त्वं सोम तनूकृद्भ्यो द्वेषोभ्योऽन्यकृतेभ्यः । उरु यन्तासि वरूथम् ॥
8.79.e: Thou, Soma, givest wide defence against the hate of alien men, Hatreds that waste and weaken us.

8.79.d: त्वं चित्ती तव दक्षैर्दिव आ पृथिव्या ऋजीषिन् । यावीरघस्य चिद्द्वेषः ॥
8.79.e: Thou by thine insight and thy skill, Impetuous One, from heaven and earth Drivest the sinner's enmity.

8.79.d: अर्थिनो यन्ति चेदर्थं गच्छानिद्ददुषो रातिम् । ववृज्युस्तृष्यतः कामम् ॥
8.79.e: When to their task they come with zeal, may they obtain the Giver's grace, And satisfy his wish who thirsts.
So may he find what erst was lost, so may be speed the pious man, And lengthen his remaining life.

8.79.d: सुशेवो नो मृळयाकुरदृप्तक्रतुरवातः । भवा नः सोम शं हृदे ॥
8.79.e: Gracious, displaying tender love, unconquered, gentle in thy thoughts, Be sweet, O Soma, to our heart.

8.79.d: मा नः सोम सं वीविजो मा वि बीभिषथा राजन् । मा नो हार्दि त्विषा वधीः ॥
8.79.e: O Soma, terrify us not; strike us not with alarm, O King: Wound not our heart with dazzling flame.

8.79.d: अव यत्स्वे सधस्थे देवानां दुर्मतीरीक्षे । राजन्नप द्विषः सेध मीढ्वो अप स्रिधः सेध ॥
8.79.e: When in my dwelling-place I see the wicked enemies of Gods, King, chase their hatred far away, thou Bounteous One, dispel our foes.

8.80.d: नह्य१न्यं बळाकरं मर्डितारं शतक्रतो । त्वं न इन्द्र मृळय ॥
8.80.e: O Śatakratu! truly I have made none else my Comforter. Indra; be gracious unto us.

8.80.d: यो नः शश्वत्पुराविथामृध्रो वाजसातये । स त्वं न इन्द्र मृळय ॥
8.80.e: Thou who hast ever aided us kindly of old to win the spoil, As such, O Indra, favour us.

8.80.d: किमङ्ग रध्रचोदनः सुन्वानस्यावितेदसि । कुवित्स्विन्द्र णः शकः ॥
8.80.e: What now? As prompter of the poor thou helpest him who sheds the juice. Wilt thou not, Indra, strengthen us?

8.80.d: इन्द्र प्र णो रथमव पश्चाच्चित्सन्तमद्रिवः । पुरस्तादेनं मे कृधि ॥
8.80.e: O Indra, help our chariot on, yea, Thunderer, though it lag behind: Give this my car the foremost place.

8.80.d: हन्तो नु किमाससे प्रथमं नो रथं कृधि । उपमं वाजयु श्रवः ॥
8.80.e: Ho there! why sittest thou at case? Make thou my chariot to be first And bring the fame of victory near.

8.80.d: अवा नो वाजयुं रथं सुकरं ते किमित्परि । अस्मान्त्सु जिग्युषस्कृधि ॥
8.80.e: Assist our car that seeks the prize. What can be easier for thee? So make thou us victorious.

8.80.d: इन्द्र दृह्यस्व पूरसि भद्रा त एति निष्कृतम् । इयं धीर्ऋत्वियावती ॥
8.80.e: Indra, be firm: a fort art thou. To thine appointed place proceeds The auspicious hymn in season due.

8.80.d: मा सीमवद्य आ भागुर्वी काष्ठा हितं धनम् । अपावृक्ता अरत्नयः ॥
8.80.e: Let not our portion be disgrace. Broad is the course, the prize is set, The barriers are opened wide.

8.80.d: तुरीयं नाम यज्ञियं यदा करस्तदुश्मसि । आदित्पतिर्न ओहसे ॥
8.80.e: This thing we wish. that thou mayst take thy fourth, thy sacrificial name. So art thou held to be our Lord.

8.80.d: अवीवृधद्वो अमृता अमन्दीदेकद्यूर्देवा उत याश्च देवीः । तस्मा उ राधः कृणुत प्रशस्तं प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात् ॥
8.80.e: Ekadyū hath exalted you, Immortals: both Goddesses and Gods hath he delighted. Bestow upon him bounty meet for praises. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.

8.81.d: आ तू न इन्द्र क्षुमन्तं चित्रं ग्राभं सं गृभाय । महाहस्ती दक्षिणेन ॥
8.81.e: INDRA, God of the mighty arm, gather for us with thy right hand Manifold and nutritious spoil.

8.81.d: विद्मा हि त्वा तुविकूर्मिं तुविदेष्णं तुवीमघम् । तुविमात्रमवोभिः ॥
8.81.e: We know thee mighty in thy deeds, of mighty bounty, mighty wealth, Mighty in measure, prompt to aid.

8.81.d: नहि त्वा शूर देवा न मर्तासो दित्सन्तम् । भीमं न गां वारयन्ते ॥
8.81.e: Hero, ẉhen thou art fain to give, neither may Gods nor mortal men Restrain thee like a fearful Bull.

8.81.d: एतो न्विन्द्रं स्तवामेशानं वस्वः स्वराजम् । न राधसा मर्धिषन्नः ॥
8.81.e: Come, let us glorify Indra, Lord supreme of wealth, Self-ruling King: In bounty may he harm us not.

8.81.d: प्र स्तोषदुप गासिषच्छ्रवत्साम गीयमानम् । अभि राधसा जुगुरत् ॥
8.81.e: Let prelude sound and following chant so let him hear the Sāman sung, And with his bounty answer us.

8.81.d: आ नो भर दक्षिणेनाभि सव्येन प्र मृश । इन्द्र मा नो वसोर्निर्भाक् ॥
8.81.e: O Indra, with thy right hand bring, and with thy left remember us. Let us not lose our share of wealth.

8.81.d: उप क्रमस्वा भर धृषता धृष्णो जनानाम् । अदाशूष्टरस्य वेदः ॥
8.81.e: Come nigh, O Bold One, boldly bring hither the riches of the churl Who giveth least of all the folk.

8.81.d: इन्द्र य उ नु ते अस्ति वाजो विप्रेभिः सनित्वः । अस्माभिः सु तं सनुहि ॥
8.81.e: Indra, the booty which thou hast with holy singers to receive, Even that booty win with us.

8.81.d: सद्योजुवस्ते वाजा अस्मभ्यं विश्वश्चन्द्राः । वशैश्च मक्षू जरन्ते ॥
8.81.e: Indra, thy swiftly-coming spoil, the booty which rejoices all, Sounds quick in concert with our hopes.

8.82.d: आ प्र द्रव परावतोऽर्वावतश्च वृत्रहन् । मध्वः प्रति प्रभर्मणि ॥
8.82.e: HASTE forward to us from afar, or, Vṛtra-slayer, from anear, To meet the offering to the meath.

8.82.d: तीव्राः सोमास आ गहि सुतासो मादयिष्णवः । पिबा दधृग्यथोचिषे ॥
8.82.e: Strong are the Soma-draughts; come nigh: the juices fill thee with delight: Drink boldly even as thou art wont'.

8.82.d: इषा मन्दस्वादु तेऽरं वराय मन्यवे । भुवत्त इन्द्र शं हृदे ॥
8.82.e: Joy, Indra, in the strengthening food: let it content thy wish and thought, And be delightful to thine heart.

8.82.d: आ त्वशत्रवा गहि न्यु१क्थानि च हूयसे । उपमे रोचने दिवः ॥
8.82.e: Come to us thou who hast no foe: we call thee down to hymns of praise, in heaven's sublimest realm of light.

8.82.d: तुभ्यायमद्रिभिः सुतो गोभिः श्रीतो मदाय कम् । प्र सोम इन्द्र हूयते ॥
8.82.e: This Soma here expressed with stones and dressed with milk for thy carouse, Indra, is offered up to thee.

8.82.d: इन्द्र श्रुधि सु मे हवमस्मे सुतस्य गोमतः । वि पीतिं तृप्तिमश्नुहि ॥
8.82.e: Graciously, Indra, hear my call. Come and obtain the draught, and sate Thyself with juices blent with milk.

8.82.d: य इन्द्र चमसेष्वा सोमश्चमूषु ते सुतः । पिबेदस्य त्वमीशिषे ॥
8.82.e: The Soma, Indra, which is shed in chalices and vats for thee, Drink thou, for thou art Lord thereof.

8.82.d: यो अप्सु चन्द्रमा इव सोमश्चमूषु ददृशे । पिबेदस्य त्वमीशिषे ॥
8.82.e: The Soma seen within the vats, as in the flood the Moon is seen, Drink thou, for thou art Lord thereof.

8.82.d: यं ते श्येनः पदाभरत्तिरो रजांस्यस्पृतम् । पिबेदस्य त्वमीशिषे ॥
8.82.e: That which the Hawk brought in his claw, inviolate, through the air to thee, Drink thou, for thou art Lord thereof.

8.83.e: WE choose unto ourselves that high protection of the Mighty Gods That it may help and succour us.

8.83.d: ते नः सन्तु युजः सदा वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । वृधासश्च प्रचेतसः ॥
8.83.e: May they be ever our allies, VARUNA, Mitra, Aryaman, Far-seeing Gods who prosper us.

8.83.d: अति नो विष्पिता पुरु नौभिरपो न पर्षथ । यूयमृतस्य रथ्यः ॥
8.83.e: Ye furtherers of holy Law, transport us safe o'er many woes, As over water-floods in ships.

8.83.d: वामं नो अस्त्वर्यमन्वामं वरुण शंस्यम् । वामं ह्यावृणीमहे ॥
8.83.e: Dear wealth be Aryaman to us, VARUNA dear wealth meet for praise: Dear wealth we choose unto ourselves.

8.83.d: वामस्य हि प्रचेतस ईशानाशो रिशादसः । नेमादित्या अघस्य यत् ॥
8.83.e: For Sovrans of dear wealth are ye, Ādityas, not of sinner's wealth, Ye sapient Gods who slay the foe.

8.83.d: वयमिद्वः सुदानवः क्षियन्तो यान्तो अध्वन्ना । देवा वृधाय हूमहे ॥
8.83.e: We in our homes, ye Bounteous Ones, and while we journey on the road, Invoke you, Gods, to prosper us.

8.83.d: अधि न इन्द्रैषां विष्णो सजात्यानाम् । इता मरुतो अश्विना ॥
8.83.e: Regard us, Indra, Viṣṇu, here, ye Aśvins and the Marut host, Us who are kith and kin to you.

8.83.d: प्र भ्रातृत्वं सुदानवोऽध द्विता समान्या । मातुर्गर्भे भरामहे ॥
8.83.e: Ye Bounteous Ones, from time of old we here set forth our brotherhood, Our kinship in the Mother's womb.

8.83.d: यूयं हि ष्ठा सुदानव इन्द्रज्येष्ठा अभिद्यवः । अधा चिद्व उत ब्रुवे ॥
8.83.e: Then come with Indra for your chief, as early day, ye Bounteous Gods Yea, I address you now for this.

8.84.d: प्रेष्ठं वो अतिथिं स्तुषे मित्रमिव प्रियम् । अग्निं रथं न वेद्यम् ॥
8.84.e: AGNI, your dearest Guest, I laud, him who is loving as a friend, Who brings us riches like a car.

8.84.d: कविमिव प्रचेतसं यं देवासो अध द्विता । नि मर्त्येष्वादधुः ॥
8.84.e: Whom as a far-foreseeing Sage the Gods have, from the olden time, Established among mortal men.

8.84.d: त्वं यविष्ठ दाशुषो नॄँः पाहि शृणुधी गिरः । रक्षा तोकमुत त्मना ॥
8.84.e: Do thou, Most Youthful God, protect the men who offer, hear their songs, And of thyself preserve their seed.

8.84.d: कया ते अग्ने अङ्गिर ऊर्जो नपादुपस्तुतिम् । वराय देव मन्यवे ॥
8.84.e: What is the praise wherewith, O God, Afigiras, Agni, Son of Strength, We, after thine own wish and thought,

8.84.d: दाशेम कस्य मनसा यज्ञस्य सहसो यहो । कदु वोच इदं नमः ॥
8.84.e: May serve thee, O thou Child of Power, and with what sacrifice's plan? What prayer shall I now speak to thee?

8.84.d: अधा त्वं हि नस्करो विश्वा अस्मभ्यं सुक्षितीः । वाजद्रविणसो गिरः ॥
8.84.e: Our God, make all of us to dwell in happy habitations, and Reward our songs with spoil and wealth.

8.84.d: कस्य नूनं परीणसो धियो जिन्वसि दम्पते । गोषाता यस्य ते गिरः ॥
8.84.e: Lord of the house, what plenty fills the songs which thou inspirest now, Thou whose hymn helps to win the kine?

8.84.d: तं मर्जयन्त सुक्रतुं पुरोयावानमाजिषु । स्वेषु क्षयेषु वाजिनम् ॥
8.84.e: Him Wise and Strong they glorify, the foremost Champion in the fray, And mighty in his dwelling-place.

8.84.d: क्षेति क्षेमेभिः साधुभिर्नकिर्यं घ्नन्ति हन्ति यः । अग्ने सुवीर एधते ॥
8.84.e: Agni, he dwells in rest and peace who smites and no one smites again: With hero sons he prospers well

8.85.d: आ मे हवं नासत्याश्विना गच्छतं युवम् । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
8.85.e: To this mine invocation, O ye Aśvins, ye Nāsatyas, come, To drink the savoury Soma juice.

8.85.d: इमं मे स्तोममश्विनेमं मे शृणुतं हवम् । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
8.85.e: This laud of mine, ye Aśvins Twain, and this mine invitation hear, To drink the savoury Soma juice.

8.85.d: अयं वां कृष्णो अश्विना हवते वाजिनीवसू । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
8.85.e: Here Kṛṣṇa is invoking you, O Aśvins, Lords of ample wealth. To drink the savoury Soma juice.

8.85.d: शृणुतं जरितुर्हवं कृष्णस्य स्तुवतो नरा । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
8.85.e: List, Heroes, to the singer's call, the call of Kṛṣṇa lauding you, To drink the savoury Soma juice.

8.85.d: छर्दिर्यन्तमदाभ्यं विप्राय स्तुवते नरा । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
8.85.e: Chiefs, to the sage who sings your praise grant an inviolable home, To drink the savoury Soma juice.

8.85.d: गच्छतं दाशुषो गृहमित्था स्तुवतो अश्विना । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
8.85.e: Come to the worshipper's abode, Aśvins, who here is lauding you, To drink the savoury Soma juice.

8.85.d: युञ्जाथां रासभं रथे वीड्वङ्गे वृषण्वसू । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
8.85.e: Yoke to the firmly jointed car the ass which draws you, Lords of wealth. To drink the savoury Soma juice.

8.85.d: त्रिवन्धुरेण त्रिवृता रथेना यातमश्विना । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
8.85.e: Come hither, Aśvins, on your car of triple form with triple seat, To drink the savoury Soma juice.

8.85.d: नू मे गिरो नासत्याश्विना प्रावतं युवम् । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
8.85.e: O Aśvins, O Nāsatyas, now accept with favouring grace my songs, To drink the savoury Soma juice.

8.86.d: उभा हि दस्रा भिषजा मयोभुवोभा दक्षस्य वचसो बभूवथुः । ता वां विश्वको हवते तनूकृथे मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम् ॥
8.86.e: YE Twain are wondrous strong, well-skilled in arts that heal, both bringers of delight, ye both won Dakṣa's praise. Viśvaka calls on you as such to save his life. Break ye not off our friendship, come and set me free.

8.86.d: कथा नूनं वां विमना उप स्तवद्युवं धियं ददथुर्वस्यइष्टये । ता वां विश्वको हवते तनूकृथे मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम् ॥
8.86.e: How shall he praise you now who is distraught in mind? Ye Twain give wisdom for the gain of what is good. Viśvaka calls on you as such to save his life. Break ye not off our friendship, come and set me free.

8.86.d: युवं हि ष्मा पुरुभुजेममेधतुं विष्णाप्वे ददथुर्वस्यइष्टये । ता वां विश्वको हवते तनूकृथे मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम् ॥
8.86.e: Already have ye Twain, possessors of great wealth, prospered Viṣṇāpū thus for gain of what is good. Viśvaka calls on you as such to save his life. Break ye not off our friendship, come and set me free.

8.86.d: उत त्यं वीरं धनसामृजीषिणं दूरे चित्सन्तमवसे हवामहे । यस्य स्वादिष्ठा सुमतिः पितुर्यथा मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम् ॥
8.86.e: And that Impetuous Hero, winner of the spoil, though he is far away, we call to succour us, Whose gracious favour, like a father's, is most sweet. Break ye not off our friendship, come and set me free.

8.86.d: ऋतेन देवः सविता शमायत ऋतस्य शृङ्गमुर्विया वि पप्रथे । ऋतं सासाह महि चित्पृतन्यतो मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम् ॥
8.86.e: About the holy Law toils Savitar the God the horn of holy Law hath he spread far and wide. The holy Law hath quelled even mighty men of war. Break ye not off our ftiendship, come and set me free.

8.87.d: द्युम्नी वां स्तोमो अश्विना क्रिविर्न सेक आ गतम् । मध्वः सुतस्य स दिवि प्रियो नरा पातं गौराविवेरिणे ॥
8.87.e: SPLENDID, O Aśvins, is your praise. Come fountain-like, to pour the stream. of the sweet juice effused-dear is it, Chiefs, in heaven-drink like two wild bulls at a pool.

8.87.d: पिबतं घर्मं मधुमन्तमश्विना बर्हिः सीदतं नरा । ता मन्दसाना मनुषो दुरोण आ नि पातं वेदसा वयः ॥
8.87.e: Drink the libation rich in sweets, O Aśvins Twain: sit. Heroes, on the sacred grass. Do ye with joyful heart in the abode of man preserve his life by means of wealth.

8.87.d: आ वां विश्वाभिरूतिभिः प्रियमेधा अहूषत । ता वर्तिर्यातमुप वृक्तबर्हिषो जुष्टं यज्ञं दिविष्टिषु ॥
8.87.e: The Priyamedhas bid you come with all the succours that are yours. Come to his house whose holy grass is trimmed, to dear sacrifice at the morning rites.

8.87.d: पिबतं सोमं मधुमन्तमश्विना बर्हिः सीदतं सुमत् । ता वावृधाना उप सुष्टुतिं दिवो गन्तं गौराविवेरिणम् ॥
8.87.e: Drink ye the Soma rich in meath, ye Aśvins Twain: sit gladly on the sacred grass. So, waxen mighty, to our eulogy from heaven come ye as wild-bulls to the pool.

8.87.d: आ नूनं यातमश्विनाश्वेभिः प्रुषितप्सुभिः । दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी शुभस्पती पातं सोममृतावृधा ॥
8.87.e: Come to us, O ye Aśvins, now with steeds of many a varied hue, Ye Lords of splendour, wondrous, borne on paths of gold, drink Soma, ye who strengthen Law.

8.87.d: वयं हि वां हवामहे विपन्यवो विप्रासो वाजसातये । ता वल्गू दस्रा पुरुदंससा धियाश्विना श्रुष्ट्या गतम् ॥
8.87.e: For we the priestly singers, fain tohymn your praise, invoke you for the gain of strength. So, wondrous, fair, and famed for great deeds come to us, through our hymn, Aśvins, ẉhen ye hear.

8.88.d: तं वो दस्ममृतीषहं वसोर्मन्दानमन्धसः । अभि वत्सं न स्वसरेषु धेनव इन्द्रं गीर्भिर्नवामहे ॥
8.88.e: As cows low to their calves in stalls, so with our songs we glorify This Indra, even your Wondrous God who checks attack, who joys in the delicious juice.

8.88.d: द्युक्षं सुदानुं तविषीभिरावृतं गिरिं न पुरुभोजसम् । क्षुमन्तं वाजं शतिनं सहस्रिणं मक्षू गोमन्तमीमहे ॥
8.88.e: Celestial, bounteous Giver, girt about with might, rich, mountain-like, in precious things, Him swift we seek. for foodful booty rich in kine, brought hundredfold and thousandfold.

8.88.d: न त्वा बृहन्तो अद्रयो वरन्त इन्द्र वीळवः । यद्दित्ससि स्तुवते मावते वसु नकिष्टदा मिनाति ते ॥
8.88.e: Indra, the strong and lofty hills are powerless to bar thy way. None stay that act of thine ẉhen thou wouldst fain give wealth to one like me who sings thy praise.

8.88.d: योद्धासि क्रत्वा शवसोत दंसना विश्वा जाताभि मज्मना । आ त्वायमर्क ऊतये ववर्तति यं गोतमा अजीजनन् ॥
8.88.e: A Warrior thou by strength, wisdom, and wondrous deed, in might excellest all that is. Hither may this our hymn attract thee to our help, the hymn which Gotamas have made.

8.88.d: प्र हि रिरिक्ष ओजसा दिवो अन्तेभ्यस्परि । न त्वा विव्याच रज इन्द्र पार्थिवमनु स्वधां ववक्षिथ ॥
8.88.e: For in thy might thou stretchest out beyond the boundaries of heaven. The earthly region, Indra, comprehends thee not. After thy Godhead hast thou waxed.

8.88.d: नकिः परिष्टिर्मघवन्मघस्य ते यद्दाशुषे दशस्यसि । अस्माकं बोध्युचथस्य चोदिता मंहिष्ठो वाजसातये ॥
8.88.e: When, Maghavan, thou honourest the worshipper, no one is there to stay thy wealth. Most liberal Giver thou, do thou inspire our song of praise, that we may win the spoil.

8.89.d: बृहदिन्द्राय गायत मरुतो वृत्रहंतमम् । येन ज्योतिरजनयन्नृतावृधो देवं देवाय जागृवि ॥
8.89.e: To Indra sing the lofty hymn, Maruts that slays the Vṛtras best. Whereby the Holy Ones created for the God the light divine that ever wakes.

8.89.d: अपाधमदभिशस्तीरशस्तिहाथेन्द्रो द्युम्न्याभवत् । देवास्त इन्द्र सख्याय येमिरे बृहद्भानो मरुद्गण ॥
8.89.e: Indra who quells the curse blew curses far away, and then in splendour came to us. Indra, refulgent with thy Marut host! the Gods strove eagerly to win thy love.

8.89.d: प्र व इन्द्राय बृहते मरुतो ब्रह्मार्चत । वृत्रं हनति वृत्रहा शतक्रतुर्वज्रेण शतपर्वणा ॥
8.89.e: Sing to your lofty Indra, sing, Maruts, a holy hymn of praise. Let Śatakratu, Vṛtra-slayer, kill the foe with hundred-knotted thunderbolt.

8.89.d: अभि प्र भर धृषता धृषन्मनः श्रवश्चित्ते असद्बृहत् । अर्षन्त्वापो जवसा वि मातरो हनो वृत्रं जया स्वः ॥
8.89.e: Aim and fetch boldly forth, O thou whose heart is bold: great glory will be thine thereby. In rapid torrent let the mother waters spread. Slay Vṛtra, win the light of heaven.

8.89.d: यज्जायथा अपूर्व्य मघवन्वृत्रहत्याय । तत्पृथिवीमप्रथयस्तदस्तभ्ना उत द्याम् ॥
8.89.e: When thou, unequalled Maghavan, wast born to smite the Vṛtras dead, Thou spreadest out the spacious earth and didst support and prop the heavens.

8.89.d: तत्ते यज्ञो अजायत तदर्क उत हस्कृतिः । तद्विश्वमभिभूरसि यज्जातं यच्च जन्त्वम् ॥
8.89.e: There was the sacrifice produced for thee, the laud, and song of joy, Thou in thy might surpassest all, all that now is and yet shall be.

8.89.d: आमासु पक्वमैरय आ सूर्यं रोहयो दिवि । घर्मं न सामन्तपता सुवृक्तिभिर्जुष्टं गिर्वणसे बृहत् ॥
8.89.e: Raw kine thou filledst with ripe milk. Thou madest Sūrya rise to heaven. Heat him as milk is heated with pure Sāma hymns, great joy to him who loves the song.

8.90.d: आ नो विश्वासु हव्य इन्द्रः समत्सु भूषतु । उप ब्रह्माणि सवनानि वृत्रहा परमज्या ऋचीषमः ॥
8.90.e: MAY Indra, who in every fight must be invoked, be near to us. May the most mighty Vṛtra-slayer, meet for praise, come to libations and to hymns.

8.90.d: त्वं दाता प्रथमो राधसामस्यसि सत्य ईशानकृत् । तुविद्युम्नस्य युज्या वृणीमहे पुत्रस्य शवसो महः ॥
8.90.e: Thou art the best of all in sending bounteous gifts, true art thou, lordly in thine act. We claim alliance with the very Glorious One, yea, with the Mighty Son of Strength.

8.90.d: ब्रह्मा त इन्द्र गिर्वणः क्रियन्ते अनतिद्भुता । इमा जुषस्व हर्यश्व योजनेन्द्र या ते अमन्महि ॥
8.90.e: Prayers unsurpassed are offered up to thee the Lover of the Song. Indra, Lord of Bay Steeds, accept these fitting hymns, hymns which we have thought out for thee.

8.90.d: त्वं हि सत्यो मघवन्ननानतो वृत्रा भूरि न्यृञ्जसे । स त्वं शविष्ठ वज्रहस्त दाशुषेऽर्वाञ्चं रयिमा कृधि ॥
8.90.e: For thou, O Maghavan, art truthful, ne'er subdued and bringest many a Vṛtra low. As such, O Mightiest Lord, Wielder of Thunder, send wealth hither to the worshipper.

8.90.d: त्वमिन्द्र यशा अस्यृजीषी शवसस्पते । त्वं वृत्राणि हंस्यप्रतीन्येक इदनुत्ता चर्षणीधृता ॥
8.90.e: O Indra, thou art far-renowned, impetuous, O Lord of Strength. Alone thou slayest with the guardian of mankind resistless never-conquered foes.

8.90.d: तमु त्वा नूनमसुर प्रचेतसं राधो भागमिवेमहे । महीव कृत्तिः शरणा त इन्द्र प्र ते सुम्ना नो अश्नवन् ॥
8.90.e: As such we seek thee now, O Asura, thee most wise, craving thy bounty as our share. Thy sheltering defence is like a mighty cloak. So may thy glories reach to us.

8.91.d: कन्या३ वारवायती सोममपि स्रुताविदत् । अस्तं भरन्त्यब्रवीदिन्द्राय सुनवै त्वा शक्राय सुनवै त्वा ॥
8.91.e: DOWN to the stream a maiden came, and found the Soma by the way. Bearing it to her home she said, For Indra will I press thee out, for Śakra will I press thee out.

8.91.d: असौ य एषि वीरको गृहंगृहं विचाकशद् । इमं जम्भसुतं पिब धानावन्तं करम्भिणमपूपवन्तमुक्थिनम् ॥
8.91.e: Thou roaming yonder, little man, beholding every house in turn, Drink thou this Soma pressed with teeth, accompanied with grain and curds, with cake of meal and song of praise.

8.91.d: आ चन त्वा चिकित्सामोऽधि चन त्वा नेमसि । शनैरिव शनकैरिवेन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
8.91.e: Fain would we learn to know thee well, nor yet can we attain to thee. Still slowly and in gradual drops, O Indu, unto Indra flow.
Will he not help and work for us? Will he not make us wealthier? Shall we not, hostile to our lord, unite ourselves to Indra now?

8.91.d: इमानि त्रीणि विष्टपा तानीन्द्र वि रोहय । शिरस्ततस्योर्वरामादिदं म उपोदरे ॥
8.91.e: O Indra, cause to sprout again three places, these which I declare,– My father's head, his cultured field, and this the part below my waist.

8.91.d: असौ च या न उर्वरादिमां तन्वं१ मम । अथो ततस्य यच्छिरः सर्वा ता रोमशा कृधि ॥
8.91.e: Make all of these grow crops of hair, you cultivated field of ours, My body, and my father's head.

8.91.d: खे रथस्य खेऽनसः खे युगस्य शतक्रतो । अपालामिन्द्र त्रिष्पूत्व्यकृणोः सूर्यत्वचम् ॥
8.91.e: Cleansing Apālā, Indra! thrice, thou gavest sunlike skin to her, Drawn, Śatakratu! through the hole of car, of wagon, and of yoke.

8.92.d: पान्तमा वो अन्धस इन्द्रमभि प्र गायत । विश्वासाहं शतक्रतुं मंहिष्ठं चर्षणीनाम् ॥
8.92.e: INVITE ye Indra with a song to drink your draught of Soma juice,  All-conquering Śatakratu, most munificent of all who live.

8.92.d: पुरुहूतं पुरुष्टुतं गाथान्यं१ सनश्रुतम् । इन्द्र इति ब्रवीतन ॥
8.92.e: Lauded by many, much-invoked, leader of song, renowned of old:  His name is Indra, tell it forth.

8.92.d: इन्द्र इन्नो महानां दाता वाजानां नृतुः । महाँ अभिज्ञ्वा यमत् ॥
8.92.e: Indra the Dancer be to us the giver of abundant strength:  May he, the mighty, bring it near.

8.92.d: अपादु शिप्र्यन्धसः सुदक्षस्य प्रहोषिणः । इन्दोरिन्द्रो यवाशिरः ॥
8.92.e: Indra whose jaws are strong hath drunk of worshipping Sudaksa's draught,  The Soma juice with barley mixt.

8.92.d: तम्वभि प्रार्चतेन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये । तदिद्ध्यस्य वर्धनम् ॥
8.92.e: Call Indra loudly with your songs of praise to drink the Soma juice.  For this is what augments his stiength.

8.92.d: अस्य पीत्वा मदानां देवो देवस्यौजसा । विश्वाभि भुवना भुवत् ॥
8.92.e: When he hath drqnk its gladdening drops, the God with vigour of a God  Hath far surpassed all things that are.

8.92.d: त्यमु वः सत्रासाहं विश्वासु गीर्ष्वायतम् । आ च्यावयस्यूतये ॥
8.92.e: Thou speedest down to succour us this ever-conquering God of yours,  Him who is drawn to all our songs

8.92.d: युध्मं सन्तमनर्वाणं सोमपामनपच्युतम् । नरमवार्यक्रतुम् ॥
8.92.e: The Warrior not to he restrained, the Soma-drinker ne’er o’erthrown,  The Chieftain of resistless might.

8.92.d: शिक्षा ण इन्द्र राय आ पुरु विद्वाँ ऋचीषम । अवा नः पार्ये धने ॥
8.92.e: O Indra, send us riches, thou Omniscient, worthy of our praise:  Help us in the decisive fray.

8.92.d: अतश्चिदिन्द्र ण उपा याहि शतवाजया । इषा सहस्रवाजया ॥
8.92.e: Even thence, O Indra, come to us with food that gives a hundred powers, With food that gives a thousand powers.

8.92.d: अयाम धीवतो धियोऽर्वद्भिः शक्र गोदरे । जयेम पृत्सु वज्रिवः ॥
8.92.e: We sought the wisdom of the wise. Śakra, Kine-giver, Thunder-armed! May we with steeds o’ercome in fight.

8.92.d: वयमु त्वा शतक्रतो गावो न यवसेष्वा । उक्थेषु रणयामसि ॥
8.92.e: We make thee, Śatakratu, find enjoyment in the songs we sing, Like cattle in the pasture lands.

8.92.d: विश्वा हि मर्त्यत्वनानुकामा शतक्रतो । अगन्म वज्रिन्नाशसः ॥
8.92.e: For, Śatakratu, Thunder-armed, all that we craved, as men are wont, All that we hoped, have we attained.

8.92.d: त्वे सु पुत्र शवसोऽवृत्रन्कामकातयः । न त्वामिन्द्राति रिच्यते ॥
8.92.e: Those, Son of Strength, are come to thee who cherish wishes in their hearts: O Indra, none excelleth thee.

8.92.d: स नो वृषन्त्सनिष्ठया सं घोरया द्रवित्न्वा । धियाविड्ढि पुरंध्या ॥
8.92.e: So, Hero, guard us with thy care, with thy most liberal providence, Speedy, and terrible to foes.

8.92.d: यस्ते नूनं शतक्रतविन्द्र द्युम्नितमो मदः । तेन नूनं मदे मदेः ॥
8.92.e: O Śatakratu Indra, now rejoice with that carouse of thine Which is most splendid of them all;

8.92.d: यस्ते चित्रश्रवस्तमो य इन्द्र वृत्रहन्तमः । य ओजोदातमो मदः ॥
8.92.e: Even, Indra, that carouse which slays the Vritras best, most widely famed, Best giver of thy power and might.

8.92.d: विद्मा हि यस्ते अद्रिवस्त्वादत्तः सत्य सोमपाः । विश्वासु दस्म कृष्टिषु ॥
8.92.e: For that which is thy gift we know, true Soma-drinker, Thunder-armed, Mighty One, amid all the folk.

8.92.d: इन्द्राय मद्वने सुतं परि ष्टोभन्तु नो गिरः । अर्कमर्चन्तु कारवः ॥
8.92.e: For Indra, Lover of Carouse, loud be our songs about the juice: Let poets sing the song of praise.

8.92.d: यस्मिन्विश्वा अधि श्रियो रणन्ति सप्त संसदः । इन्द्रं सुते हवामहे ॥
8.92.e: We summon Indra to the draught, in whom all glories rest, in whom The seven communities rejoice.

8.92.d: त्रिकद्रुकेषु चेतनं देवासो यज्ञमत्नत । तमिद्वर्धन्तु नो गिरः ॥
8.92.e: At the Trikadrukas the Gods span sacrifice that stirs the mind: Let our songs aid and prosper it.

8.92.d: आ त्वा विशन्त्विन्दवः समुद्रमिव सिन्धवः । न त्वामिन्द्राति रिच्यते ॥
8.92.e: Let the drops pass within thee as the rivers flow into the sea: O Indra, naught excelleth thee.

8.92.d: विव्यक्थ महिना वृषन्भक्षं सोमस्य जागृवे । य इन्द्र जठरेषु ते ॥
8.92.e: Thou, wakeful Hero, by thy might hast taken food of Soma juice, Which, Indra, is within thee now.

8.92.d: अरं त इन्द्र कुक्षये सोमो भवतु वृत्रहन् । अरं धामभ्य इन्दवः ॥
8.92.e: O Indra, Vṛtra-slayer, let Soma be ready for thy maw, The drops be ready for thy forms.

8.92.d: अरमश्वाय गायति श्रुतकक्षो अरं गवे । अरमिन्द्रस्य धाम्ने ॥
8.92.e: Now Ṣrutakaksha sings his song that cattle and the steed may come, That Indra’s very self may come.

8.92.d: अरं हि ष्म सुतेषु णः सोमेष्विन्द्र भूषसि । अरं ते शक्र दावने ॥
8.92.e: Here, Indra, thou art ready by our Soma juices shed for thee, Śakra, at hand that thou mayst give.

8.92.d: पराकात्ताच्चिदद्रिवस्त्वां नक्षन्त नो गिरः । अरं गमाम ते वयम् ॥
8.92.e: Even from far away our songs reach thee, O Caster of the Stone: May we come very close to thee.

8.92.d: एवा ह्यसि वीरयुरेवा शूर उत स्थिरः । एवा ते राध्यं मनः ॥
8.92.e: For so thou art the hero’s Friend, a Hero, too, art thou, and strong: So may thine heart be won to us.

8.92.d: एवा रातिस्तुवीमघ विश्वेभिर्धायि धातृभिः । अधा चिदिन्द्र मे सचा ॥
8.92.e: So hath the offering, wealthiest Lord, been paid by all the worshippers: So dwell thou, Indra, even with me.

8.92.d: मो षु ब्रह्मेव तन्द्रयुर्भुवो वाजानां पते । मत्स्वा सुतस्य गोमतः ॥
8.92.e: He not thou like a slothful priest, O Lord of spoil and wealth: rejoice in the pressed Soma blent with milk.

8.92.d: मा न इन्द्राभ्या३दिशः सूरो अक्तुष्वा यमन् । त्वा युजा वनेम तत् ॥
8.92.e: O Indra, let not ill designs surround us in the sunbeams' light: This may we gain with thee for Friend.

8.92.d: त्वयेदिन्द्र युजा वयं प्रति ब्रुवीमहि स्पृधः । त्वमस्माकं तव स्मसि ॥
8.92.e: With thee to help us, Indra, let us answer all our enemies: For thou art ours and we are thine.

8.92.d: त्वामिद्धि त्वायवोऽनुनोनुवतश्चरान् । सखाय इन्द्र कारवः ॥
8.92.e: Indra, the poets and thy friends, faithful to thee, shall loudly sing Thy praises as they follow thee.

8.93.d: उद्घेदभि श्रुतामघं वृषभं नर्यापसम् । अस्तारमेषि सूर्य ॥
8.93.e: SURYA, thou mountest up to meet the Hero famous for his wealth,  Who hurls the bolt and works for man

8.93.d: नव यो नवतिं पुरो बिभेद बाह्वोजसा । अहिं च वृत्रहावधीत् ॥
8.93.e: Him who with might of both his arms brake nine-and-ninety castles down,  Slew Vṛtra and smote Ahi dead.

8.93.d: स न इन्द्रः शिवः सखाश्वावद्गोमद्यवमत् । उरुधारेव दोहते ॥
8.93.e: This Indra is our gracious Friend. He sends us in a full broad stream  Riches in horses, kine, and corn.

8.93.d: यदद्य कच्च वृत्रहन्नुदगा अभि सूर्य । सर्वं तदिन्द्र ते वशे ॥
8.93.e: Whatever, Vṛtra-slayer! thou, Sūrya, hast risen upon to-day,  Tbat, Indra, all is in thy power.

8.93.d: यद्वा प्रवृद्ध सत्पते न मरा इति मन्यसे । उतो तत्सत्यमित्तव ॥
8.93.e: When, Mighty One, Lord of the brave, thou thinkest thus, I shall not die,  That thought of thine is true indeed.

8.93.d: ये सोमासः परावति ये अर्वावति सुन्विरे । सर्वाँस्ताँ इन्द्र गच्छसि ॥
8.93.e: Thou, Indra, goest unto all Soma libations shed for thee,  Both far away and near at hand.

8.93.d: तमिन्द्रं वाजयामसि महे वृत्राय हन्तवे । स वृषा वृषभो भुवत् ॥
8.93.e: We make this Indra very strong to strike the mighty Vṛtra dead:  A vigorous Hero shall he be.

8.93.d: इन्द्रः स दामने कृत ओजिष्ठः स मदे हितः । द्युम्नी श्लोकी स सोम्यः ॥
8.93.e: Indra was made for giving, set, most mighty, o’er the joyous draught.  Bright, meet for Soma, famed in song.

8.93.d: गिरा वज्रो न सम्भृतः सबलो अनपच्युतः । ववक्ष ऋष्वो अस्तृतः ॥
8.93.e: By song as ’twere, the powerful bolt which none may parry was prepared  Lofty, invincible he grew.

8.93.d: दुर्गे चिन्नः सुगं कृधि गृणान इन्द्र गिर्वणः । त्वं च मघवन्वशः ॥
8.93.e: Indra, Song-lover, lauded, make even in the wilds fair ways for us, Whenever, Maghavan, thou wilt.

8.93.d: यस्य ते नू चिदादिशं न मिनन्ति स्वराज्यम् । न देवो नाध्रिगुर्जनः ॥
8.93.e: Thou whose commandment and behest of sovran sway none disregards, Neither audacious man nor God.

8.93.d: अधा ते अप्रतिष्कुतं देवी शुष्मं सपर्यतः । उभे सुशिप्र रोदसी ॥
8.93.e: And both these Goddesses, Earth, Heaven, Lord of the beauteous helm! revere Thy might which no one may resist.

8.93.d: त्वमेतदधारयः कृष्णासु रोहिणीषु च । परुष्णीषु रुशत्पयः ॥
8.93.e: Thou in the black cows and the red and in the cows with spotted skin This white milk hast deposited.

8.93.d: वि यदहेरध त्विषो विश्वे देवासो अक्रमुः । विदन्मृगस्य ताँ अमः ॥
8.93.e: When in their terror all the Gods shrank from the Dragon’s furious might, Fear of the monster fell on them.

8.93.d: आदु मे निवरो भुवद्वृत्रहादिष्ट पौंस्यम् । अजातशत्रुरस्तृतः ॥
8.93.e: Then he was my Defender, then, Invincible, whose foe is not, The Vṛtra-slayer showed his might.

8.93.d: श्रुतं वो वृत्रहन्तमं प्र शर्धं चर्षणीनाम् । आ शुषे राधसे महे ॥
8.93.e: Him your best Vṛtra-slayer, him the famous Champion of mankind I urge to great munificence,

8.93.d: अया धिया च गव्यया पुरुणामन्पुरुष्टुत । यत्सोमेसोम आभवः ॥
8.93.e: To come, Much-lauded! Many-named! with this same thought that longs for milk, Whene’er the Soma juice is shed.

8.93.d: बोधिन्मना इदस्तु नो वृत्रहा भूर्यासुतिः । शृणोतु शक्र आशिषम् ॥
8.93.e: Much-honoured by libations, may the Vṛtra-slayer wake for us: May Śakra listen to our prayers.

8.93.d: कया त्वं न ऊत्याभि प्र मन्दसे वृषन् । कया स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
8.93.e: O Hero, with what aid dost thou delight us, with what succour bring Riches to those who worship thee?

8.93.d: कस्य वृषा सुते सचा नियुत्वान्वृषभो रणत् । वृत्रहा सोमपीतये ॥
8.93.e: With whose libation joys the Strong, the Hero with his team who quells The foe, to drink the Soma juice?

8.93.d: अभी षु णस्त्वं रयिं मन्दसानः सहस्रिणम् । प्रयन्ता बोधि दाशुषे ॥
8.93.e: Rejoicing in thy spirit bring thousandfold opulence to us: Enrich thy votary with gifts.

8.93.d: पत्नीवन्तः सुता इम उशन्तो यन्ति वीतये । अपां जग्मिर्निचुम्पुणः ॥
8.93.e: These juices with their wedded wives flow to enjoyment lovingly: To waters speeds the restless one.

8.93.d: इष्टा होत्रा असृक्षतेन्द्रं वृधासो अध्वरे । अच्छावभृथमोजसा ॥
8.93.e: Presented strengthening gifts have sent Indra away at sacrifice, With might, unto the cleansing bath.

8.93.d: इह त्या सधमाद्या हरी हिरण्यकेश्या । वोळ्हामभि प्रयो हितम् ॥
8.93.e: These two who share his feast, Bay Steeds with golden manes, shall bring him to The banquet that is laid for him.

8.93.d: तुभ्यं सोमाः सुता इमे स्तीर्णं बर्हिर्विभावसो । स्तोतृभ्य इन्द्रमा वह ॥
8.93.e: For thee, O Lord of Light, are shed these Soma-drops, and grass is strewn: Bring Indra to his worshippers.

8.93.d: आ ते दक्षं वि रोचना दधद्रत्ना वि दाशुषे । स्तोतृभ्य इन्द्रमर्चत ॥
8.93.e: May Indra give thee skill and lights of heaven, wealth to his votary And priests who praise him: laud ye him.

8.93.d: आ ते दधामीन्द्रियमुक्था विश्वा शतक्रतो । स्तोतृभ्य इन्द्र मृळय ॥
8.93.e: O Śatakratu, wondrous strength and all our lauds I bring to thee: Be gracious to thy worshippers.

8.93.d: भद्रम्भद्रं न आ भरेषमूर्जं शतक्रतो । यदिन्द्र मृळयासि नः ॥
8.93.e: Bring to us all things excellent, O Śatakratu, food and strength; For, Indra, thou art kind to us.

8.93.d: स नो विश्वान्या भर सुवितानि शतक्रतो । यदिन्द्र मृळयासि नः ॥
8.93.e: O Śatakratu, bring to us all blessings, all felicity: For, Indra, thou art kind to us.

8.93.d: त्वामिद्वृत्रहन्तम सुतावन्तो हवामहे । यदिन्द्र मृळयासि नः ॥
8.93.e: Bearing the Soma juice we call, best Vṛtra-slayer, unto thee: For, Indra, thou art kind to us.

8.93.d: उप नो हरिभिः सुतं याहि मदानां पते । उप नो हरिभिः सुतम् ॥
8.93.e: Come, Lord of rapturous joys, to our libation with thy Bay Steeds, come To our libation with thy Steeds.

8.93.d: द्विता यो वृत्रहन्तमो विद इन्द्रः शतक्रतुः । उप नो हरिभिः सुतम् ॥
8.93.e: Known as best Vṛtra-slayer erst, as Indra Śatakratu, come With Bay Steeds to the juice we shed.

8.93.d: त्वं हि वृत्रहन्नेषां पाता सोमानामसि । उप नो हरिभिः सुतम् ॥
8.93.e: O Vṛtra-slayer, thou art he who drinks these drops of Soma: come With Bay Steeds to the juice we shed.

8.93.d: इन्द्र इषे ददातु न ऋभुक्षणमृभुं रयिम् । वाजी ददातु वाजिनम् ॥
8.93.e: May Indra give, to aid us, wealth handy that rules the Skilful Ones: Yea, may the Strong give potent wealth.

8.94.d: गौर्धयति मरुतां श्रवस्युर्माता मघोनाम् । युक्ता वह्नी रथानाम् ॥
8.94.e: THE Cow, the famous Mother of the wealthy Maruts, pours her milk:  Both horses of the cars are yoked,—

8.94.d: यस्या देवा उपस्थे व्रता विश्वे धारयन्ते । सूर्यामासा दृशे कम् ॥
8.94.e: She in whose bosom all the Gods, and Sun and Moon for men to see,  Maintain their everlasting Laws.

8.94.d: तत्सु नो विश्वे अर्य आ सदा गृणन्ति कारवः । मरुतः सोमपीतये ॥
8.94.e: This all the pious sing to us, and sacred poets evermore:  The Maruts to the Soma-draught

8.94.d: अस्ति सोमो अयं सुतः पिबन्त्यस्य मरुतः । उत स्वराजो अश्विना ॥
8.94.e: Here is the Soma ready pressed of this the Maruts drink, of this  Self-luminous the Aśvins drink.

8.94.d: पिबन्ति मित्रो अर्यमा तना पूतस्य वरुणः । त्रिषधस्थस्य जावतः ॥
8.94.e: Of this, moreover, purified, set in three places, procreant,  Drink Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman.

8.94.d: उतो न्वस्य जोषमाँ इन्द्रः सुतस्य गोमतः । प्रातर्होतेव मत्सति ॥
8.94.e: And Indra, like the Herald Priest, desirous of the milky juice,  At early morn will quaff thereof.

8.94.d: कदत्विषन्त सूरयस्तिर आप इव स्रिधः । अर्षन्ति पूतदक्षसः ॥
8.94.e: When have the Princes gleamed and shone through waters as through troops of foes'?  When hasten they whose might ispure?

8.94.d: कद्वो अद्य महानां देवानामवो वृणे । त्मना च दस्मवर्चसाम् ॥
8.94.e: What favour do I claim this day of you  great Deities, you who are  Wondrously splendid in yourselves?

8.94.d: आ ये विश्वा पार्थिवानि पप्रथन्रोचना दिवः । मरुतः सोमपीतये ॥
8.94.e: 1 call, to drink the Soma, those Maruts who spread all realms of earth  And luminous regions of the sky.

8.94.d: त्यान्नु पूतदक्षसो दिवो वो मरुतो हुवे । अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
8.94.e: You, even such, pure in your might, you, O ye Maruts, I invoke From heaven to drink this Soma juice.

8.94.d: त्यान्नु ये वि रोदसी तस्तभुर्मरुतो हुवे । अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
8.94.e: The Maruts, those who have sustained and propped the heavens and earth apart, I call to drink this Soma juice.

8.94.d: त्यं नु मारुतं गणं गिरिष्ठां वृषणं हुवे । अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
8.94.e: That vigorous baud of Maruts that abideth in the mountains, I Invoke to drink this Soma juice.

8.95.d: आ त्वा गिरो रथीरिवास्थुः सुतेषु गिर्वणः । अभि त्वा समनूषतेन्द्र वत्सं न मातरः ॥
8.95.e: SONG-LOVER! like a charioteer come songs to thee when Soma flows.  O Indra, they have called to thee as mother-kine unto their calves.

8.95.d: आ त्वा शुक्रा अचुच्यवुः सुतास इन्द्र गिर्वणः । पिबा त्व१स्यान्धस इन्द्र विश्वासु ते हितम् ॥
8.95.e: Bright juices bitherward have sped thee, Indra, Lover of the Song.  Drink, Indra, of this flowing sap: in every house ’tis set for thee.

8.95.d: पिबा सोमं मदाय कमिन्द्र श्येनाभृतं सुतम् । त्वं हि शश्वतीनां पती राजा विशामसि ॥
8.95.e: Drink Soma to inspirit thee, juice, Indra, which the Falcon brought:  For thou art King and Sovran Lord of all the families of men.

8.95.d: श्रुधी हवं तिरश्च्या इन्द्र यस्त्वा सपर्यति । सुवीर्यस्य गोमतो रायस्पूर्धि महाँ असि ॥
8.95.e: O Indra, hear Tirasci's call, the call of him who serveth thee.  Satisfy him with wealth of kine and valiant offspring: Great art thou.

8.95.d: इन्द्र यस्ते नवीयसीं गिरं मन्द्रामजीजनत् । चिकित्विन्मनसं धियं प्रत्नामृतस्य पिप्युषीम् ॥
8.95.e: For he, O Indra, hath produced for thee the newest gladdening song,  A hymn that springs from careful thought, ancient, and full of sacred truth.

8.95.d: तमु ष्टवाम यं गिर इन्द्रमुक्थानि वावृधुः । पुरूण्यस्य पौंस्या सिषासन्तो वनामहे ॥
8.95.e: That Indra will we laud whom songs and hymns of praise have magnified.  Striving to win, we celebrate his many deeds of hero might.

8.95.d: एतो न्विन्द्रं स्तवाम शुद्धं शुद्धेन साम्ना । शुद्धैरुक्थैर्वावृध्वांसं शुद्ध आशीर्वान्ममत्तु ॥
8.95.e: Come now and let us glorify pure Indra with pure Sāma hymns.  Let the pure milky draught delight him strengthened by pure songs of praise.

8.95.d: इन्द्र शुद्धो न आ गहि शुद्धः शुद्धाभिरूतिभिः । शुद्धो रयिं नि धारय शुद्धो ममद्धि सोम्यः ॥
8.95.e: O Indra, come thou pure to us, with pure assistance, pure thyself.  Pure, send thou riches down to us, and, meet for Soma, pure, be glad.

8.95.d: इन्द्र शुद्धो हि नो रयिं शुद्धो रत्नानि दाशुषे । शुद्धो वृत्राणि जिघ्नसे शुद्धो वाजं सिषाससि ॥
8.95.e: O Indra, pure, vouchsafe us wealth, and, pure, enrich the worshipper.  Pure, thou dost strike the Vṛtras dead, and strivest, pure, to win the spoil.

8.96.d: अस्मा उषास आतिरन्त याममिन्द्राय नक्तमूर्म्याः सुवाचः । अस्मा आपो मातरः सप्त तस्थुर्नृभ्यस्तराय सिन्धवः सुपाराः ॥
8.96.e: FOR him the Mornings made their courses longer, and Nights with pleasant voices spake to Indra.  For him the Floods stood still, the Seven Mothers, Streams easy for the heroes to pass over.

8.96.d: अतिविद्धा विथुरेणा चिदस्त्रा त्रिः सप्त सानु संहिता गिरीणाम् । न तद्देवो न मर्त्यस्तुतुर्याद्यानि प्रवृद्धो वृषभश्चकार ॥
8.96.e: The Darter penetrated, though in trouble, thrice-seven close-pressed ridges of the mountains.  Neither might God nor mortal man accomplish what the Strong Hero wrought in full-grown vigour.

8.96.d: इन्द्रस्य वज्र आयसो निमिश्ल इन्द्रस्य बाह्वोर्भूयिष्ठमोजः । शीर्षन्निन्द्रस्य क्रतवो निरेक आसन्नेषन्त श्रुत्या उपाके ॥
8.96.e: The mightiest force is Indra's bolt of iron when firmly grasped in both the arms of Indra.  His head and mouth have powers that pass all others, and all his people hasten near to listen.

8.96.d: मन्ये त्वा यज्ञियं यज्ञियानां मन्ये त्वा च्यवनमच्युतानाम् । मन्ये त्वा सत्वनामिन्द्र केतुं मन्ये त्वा वृषभं चर्षणीनाम् ॥
8.96.e: 1 count thee as the Holiest of the Holy, the caster-down of what hath ne’er been shaken.  I count thee as the Banner of the heroes, I count thee as the Chief of all men living.

8.96.d: आ यद्वज्रं बाह्वोरिन्द्र धत्से मदच्युतमहये हन्तवा उ । प्र पर्वता अनवन्त प्र गावः प्र ब्रह्माणो अभिनक्षन्त इन्द्रम् ॥
8.96.e: What time, O Indra, in thine arms thou tookest thy wildly rushing bolt to Slay the Dragon,  The mountains roared, the cattle loudly bellowed, the Brahmans with their hymns drew nigh to Indra.

8.96.d: तमु ष्टवाम य इमा जजान विश्वा जातान्यवराण्यस्मात् । इन्द्रेण मित्रं दिधिषेम गीर्भिरुपो नमोभिर्वृषभं विशेम ॥
8.96.e: Let us praise him who made these worlds and creatures, all things that after him sprang into being.  May we win Mitra with our songs, and Indra, and. wait upon our Lord with adoration.

8.96.d: वृत्रस्य त्वा श्वसथादीषमाणा विश्वे देवा अजहुर्ये सखायः । मरुद्भिरिन्द्र सख्यं ते अस्त्वथेमा विश्वाः पृतना जयासि ॥
8.96.e: Flying in terror from the snort of Vṛtra, all Deities who were thy friends forsook thee.  So, Indra, be thy friendship with the Maruts: in all these battles thou shalt be the victor.

8.96.d: त्रिः षष्टिस्त्वा मरुतो वावृधाना उस्रा इव राशयो यज्ञियासः । उप त्वेमः कृधि नो भागधेयं शुष्मं त एना हविषा विधेम ॥
8.96.e: Thrice-sixty Maruts, waxing strong, were with thee, like piles of beaming light, worthy of worship.  We come to thee: grant us a happy portion. Let us adore thy might with this oblation.

8.96.d: तिग्ममायुधं मरुतामनीकं कस्त इन्द्र प्रति वज्रं दधर्ष । अनायुधासो असुरा अदेवाश्चक्रेण ताँ अप वप ऋजीषिन् ॥
8.96.e: A sharpened weapon is the host of Maruts. Who, Indra, dares withstand thy bolt of thunder?  Weaponless are the Asuras, the godless: scatter them with thy wheel, Impetuous Hero.

8.96.d: मह उग्राय तवसे सुवृक्तिं प्रेरय शिवतमाय पश्वः । गिर्वाहसे गिर इन्द्राय पूर्वीर्धेहि तन्वे कुविदङ्ग वेदत् ॥
8.96.e: To him the Strong and Mighty, most auspicious, send up the beauteous hymn for sake of cattle. Lay on his body many songs for Indra invoked with song, for will not he regard them

8.96.d: उक्थवाहसे विभ्वे मनीषां द्रुणा न पारमीरया नदीनाम् । नि स्पृश धिया तन्वि श्रुतस्य जुष्टतरस्य कुविदङ्ग वेदत् ॥
8.96.e: To him, the Mighty, who accepts laudation, send forth thy thought as by a boat o’er rivers, Stir with thy hymn the body of the Famous and Dearest One, for will not he regard it?

8.96.d: तद्विविड्ढि यत्त इन्द्रो जुजोषत्स्तुहि सुष्टुतिं नमसा विवास । उप भूष जरितर्मा रुवण्यः श्रावया वाचं कुविदङ्ग वेदत् ॥
8.96.e: Serve him with gifts of thine which Indra welcomes: praise with fair praise, invite him with thine homage. Draw near, O singer, and refrain from outcry. Make thy voice heard, for will not he regard it?

8.96.d: अव द्रप्सो अंशुमतीमतिष्ठदियानः कृष्णो दशभिः सहस्रैः । आवत्तमिन्द्रः शच्या धमन्तमप स्नेहितीर्नृमणा अधत्त ॥
8.96.e: The Black Drop sank in Aṃśumatīs bosom, advancing with ten thousand round about it. Indra with might longed for it as it panted: the hero-hearted laid aside his weapons.

8.96.d: द्रप्समपश्यं विषुणे चरन्तमुपह्वरे नद्यो अंशुमत्याः । नभो न कृष्णमवतस्थिवांसमिष्यामि वो वृषणो युध्यताजौ ॥
8.96.e: I saw the Drop in the far distance moving, on the slope bank of Aṃśumatīs river, Like a black cloud that sank into the water. Heroes, I send you forth. Go, fight in battle.

8.96.d: अध द्रप्सो अंशुमत्या उपस्थेऽधारयत्तन्वं तित्विषाणः । विशो अदेवीरभ्या३चरन्तीर्बृहस्पतिना युजेन्द्रः ससाहे ॥
8.96.e: And then the Drop in Aṃśumatīs bosom, splendid with light, assumed its proper body; And Indra, with Bṛhaspati to aid him, conquered the godless tribes that came against him.

8.96.d: त्वं ह त्यत्सप्तभ्यो जायमानोऽशत्रुभ्यो अभवः शत्रुरिन्द्र । गूळ्हे द्यावापृथिवी अन्वविन्दो विभुमद्भ्यो भुवनेभ्यो रणं धाः ॥
8.96.e: Then, at thy birth, thou wast the foeman, Indra, of those the seven who ne'er had met a rival. The hidden Pair, the Heaven and Earth, thou foundest, and to the mighty worlds thou gavest pleasure.

8.96.d: त्वं ह त्यदप्रतिमानमोजो वज्रेण वज्रिन्धृषितो जघन्थ । त्वं शुष्णस्यावातिरो वधत्रैस्त्वं गा इन्द्र शच्येदविन्दः ॥
8.96.e: So, Thunder-armed! thou with thy bolt of thunder didst boldly smite that power which none might equal; With weapons broughtest low the phght of Śushṇa, and, Indra, foundest by thy strength the cattle.

8.96.d: त्वं ह त्यद्वृषभ चर्षणीनां घनो वृत्राणां तविषो बभूथ । त्वं सिन्धूँरसृजस्तस्तभानान्त्वमपो अजयो दासपत्नीः ॥
8.96.e: Then wast thou, Chieftain of all living mortals, the very mighty slayer of the Vritras. Then didst thou set the obstructed rivers flowing, and win the floods that were enthralled by Dāsas.

8.96.d: स सुक्रतू रणिता यः सुतेष्वनुत्तमन्युर्यो अहेव रेवान् । य एक इन्नर्यपांसि कर्ता स वृत्रहा प्रतीदन्यमाहुः ॥
8.96.e: Most wise is he, rejoicing in libations, splendid as day, resistless in his anger. He only doth great deeds, the only Hero, sole Vṛtra-slayer he, with none beside him.

8.96.d: स वृत्रहेन्द्रश्चर्षणीधृत्तं सुष्टुत्या हव्यं हुवेम । स प्राविता मघवा नोऽधिवक्ता स वाजस्य श्रवस्यस्य दाता ॥
8.96.e: Indra is Vṛtra’s slayer, man’s sustainer: he must be called; with fair praise let us call him. Maghavan is our Helper, our Protector, giver of spoil and wealth to make us famous.

8.96.d: स वृत्रहेन्द्र ऋभुक्षाः सद्यो जज्ञानो हव्यो बभूव । कृण्वन्नपांसि नर्या पुरूणि सोमो न पीतो हव्यः सखिभ्यः ॥
8.96.e: This Indra, Vṛtra-slayer, this Ribhukshan, even at his birth, was meet for invocation. Doer of many deeds for man’s advantage, like Soma quaffed, for friends we must invoke him.

8.97.d: या इन्द्र भुज आभरः स्वर्वाँ असुरेभ्यः । स्तोतारमिन्मघवन्नस्य वर्धय ये च त्वे वृक्तबर्हिषः ॥
8.97.e: O INDRA, Lord of Light, what joys thou broughtest from the Asuras,  Prosper therewith, O Maghavan, him who lauds that deed, and those whose grass is trimmed for thee.

8.97.d: यमिन्द्र दधिषे त्वमश्वं गां भागमव्ययम् । यजमाने सुन्वति दक्षिणावति तस्मिन्तं धेहि मा पणौ ॥
8.97.e: The unwasting share of steeds and kine which, Indra, thou hast fast secured,  Grant to the worshipper who presses Soma and gives guerdon, not unto the churl.

8.97.d: य इन्द्र सस्त्यव्रतोऽनुष्वापमदेवयुः । स्वैः ष एवैर्मुमुरत्पोष्यं रयिं सनुतर्धेहि तं ततः ॥
8.97.e: The riteless, godless man who sleeps, O Indra, his unbroken steep,—  May he by following his own devices die. Hide from him wealth that nourishes.

8.97.d: यच्छक्रासि परावति यदर्वावति वृत्रहन् । अतस्त्वा गीर्भिर्द्युगदिन्द्र केशिभिः सुतावाँ आ विवासति ॥
8.97.e: Whether, O Śakra, thou be far, or, Vṛtra-slayer, near at hand,  Thence by heaven-reaching songs he who hath pressed the juice invites thee with thy long-maned Steeds.

8.97.d: यद्वासि रोचने दिवः समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपि । यत्पार्थिवे सदने वृत्रहन्तम यदन्तरिक्ष आ गहि ॥
8.97.e: Whether thou art in heaven's bright sphere, or in the basin of the sea;  Whether, chief Vṛtra-slayer, in some place on earth, or in the firmament, approach.

8.97.d: स नः सोमेषु सोमपाः सुतेषु शवसस्पते । मादयस्व राधसा सूनृतावतेन्द्र राया परीणसा ॥
8.97.e: Thou Soma-drinker, Lord of Strength, beside our flowing Soma juice Delight us with thy bounty rich in pleasantness, O Indra, with abundant wealth.

8.97.d: मा न इन्द्र परा वृणग्भवा नः सधमाद्यः । त्वं न ऊती त्वमिन्न आप्यं मा न इन्द्र परा वृणक् ॥
8.97.e: O Indra, turn us not away: be the companion of our feast. For thou art our protection, yea, thou art our kin: O Indra, turn us not away.

8.97.d: अस्मे इन्द्र सचा सुते नि षदा पीतये मधु । कृधी जरित्रे मघवन्नवो महदस्मे इन्द्र सचा सुते ॥
8.97.e: Sit down with us, O Indra, sit beside the juice to drink the meath. Show forth great favour to the singer, Maghavan; Indra, with us, beside the juice.

8.97.d: न त्वा देवास आशत न मर्त्यासो अद्रिवः । विश्वा जातानि शवसाभिभूरसि न त्वा देवास आशत ॥
8.97.e: O Caster of the Stone, nor Gods nor mortals have attained to thee. Thou in thy might surpassest all that hath been made: the Gods have not attained to thee.

8.97.d: विश्वाः पृतना अभिभूतरं नरं सजूस्ततक्षुरिन्द्रं जजनुश्च राजसे । क्रत्वा वरिष्ठं वर आमुरिमुतोग्रमोजिष्ठं तवसं तरस्विनम् ॥
8.97.e: of one accord they made and formed for kingship Indra, the Hero who in all encounters overcometh, Most eminent for power, destroyer in the conflict, fierce and exceeding strong, stalwart and full of vigour.

8.97.d: समीं रेभासो अस्वरन्निन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये । स्वर्पतिं यदीं वृधे धृतव्रतो ह्योजसा समूतिभिः ॥
8.97.e: Bards joined in song to Indra so that he might drink the Soma juice, The Lord of Light, that he whose laws stand fast might aid with power and with the help he gives.

8.97.d: नेमिं नमन्ति चक्षसा मेषं विप्रा अभिस्वरा । सुदीतयो वो अद्रुहोऽपि कर्णे तरस्विनः समृक्वभिः ॥
8.97.e: The holy sages form a ring, looking and singing to the Ram. Inciters, full of vigour, not to be deceived, are with the chanters, nigh to hear.

8.97.d: तमिन्द्रं जोहवीमि मघवानमुग्रं सत्रा दधानमप्रतिष्कुतं शवांसि । मंहिष्ठो गीर्भिरा च यज्ञियो ववर्तद्राये नो विश्वा सुपथा कृणोतु वज्री ॥
8.97.e: Loudly I call that Indra, Maghavan the Mighty, who evermore possesses power, ever resistless. Holy, most liberal, may he lead us on to riches, and, Thunder-armed, make all our pathways pleasant for us.

8.97.d: त्वं पुर इन्द्र चिकिदेना व्योजसा शविष्ठ शक्र नाशयध्यै । त्वद्विश्वानि भुवनानि वज्रिन्द्यावा रेजेते पृथिवी च भीषा ॥
8.97.e: Thou knowest well, O Śakra, thou Most Potent, with thy strength, Indra, to destroy these castles. Before thee, Thunder-armed! all beings tremble: the heavens and earth before thee shake with terror.

8.97.d: तन्म ऋतमिन्द्र शूर चित्र पात्वपो न वज्रिन्दुरिताति पर्षि भूरि । कदा न इन्द्र राय आ दशस्येर्विश्वप्स्न्यस्य स्पृहयाय्यस्य राजन् ॥
8.97.e: May thy truth, Indra, Wondrous Hero! be my guard: bear me o’er much woe, Thunderer! as over floods. When, Indra, wilt thou honour us with opulence, all-nourishing and much-to-be-desired, O King ?

8.98.d: इन्द्राय साम गायत विप्राय बृहते बृहत् । धर्मकृते विपश्चिते पनस्यवे ॥
8.98.e: To Indra sing a Sāma hymn, a lofty song to Lofty Sage,  To him who guards the Law, inspired, and fain for praise.

8.98.d: त्वमिन्द्राभिभूरसि त्वं सूर्यमरोचयः । विश्वकर्मा विश्वदेवो महाँ असि ॥
8.98.e: Thou, Indra, art the Conqueror: thou gavest splendour to the Sun.  Maker of all things, thou art Mighty and All-God.

8.98.d: विभ्राजञ्ज्योतिषा स्व१रगच्छो रोचनं दिवः । देवास्त इन्द्र सख्याय येमिरे ॥
8.98.e: Radiant with light thou wentest to the sky, the luminous realm of heaven.  ne Deities, Indra strove to win thee for their Friend.

8.98.d: एन्द्र नो गधि प्रियः सत्राजिदगोह्यः । गिरिर्न विश्वतस्पृथुः पतिर्दिवः ॥
8.98.e: Come unto us, O Indra, dear, still conquering, unconcealable,  Vast as a mountain spread on all sides, Lord of Heaven.

8.98.d: अभि हि सत्य सोमपा उभे बभूथ रोदसी । इन्द्रासि सुन्वतो वृधः पतिर्दिवः ॥
8.98.e: O truthful Soma-drinker, thou art mightier than both the worlds.  Thou strengthenest him who pours libation, Lord of Heaven.

8.98.d: त्वं हि शश्वतीनामिन्द्र दर्ता पुरामसि । हन्ता दस्योर्मनोर्वृधः पतिर्दिवः ॥
8.98.e: For thou art he, O Indra, wiio stormeth all castles of the foe,  Slayer of Dasyus, man's Supporter, Lord of Heaven.

8.98.d: अधा हीन्द्र गिर्वण उप त्वा कामान्महः ससृज्महे । उदेव यन्त उदभिः ॥
8.98.e: Now have we, Indra, Friend of Song, sent our great wishes forth to thee, Coming like floods that follow floods.

8.98.d: वार्ण त्वा यव्याभिर्वर्धन्ति शूर ब्रह्माणि । वावृध्वांसं चिदद्रिवो दिवेदिवे ॥
8.98.e: As rivers swell the ocean, so, Hero, our prayers increase thy might. Though of thyself, O Thunderer, waxing day by day.

8.98.d: युञ्जन्ति हरी इषिरस्य गाथयोरौ रथ उरुयुगे । इन्द्रवाहा वचोयुजा ॥
8.98.e: With holy song they bind to the broad wide-yoked car the Bay Steeds of the rapid God, Bearers of Indra, yoked by word.

8.98.d: त्वं न इन्द्रा भरँ ओजो नृम्णं शतक्रतो विचर्षणे । आ वीरं पृतनाषहम् ॥
8.98.e: O Indra, bring great strength to us, bring valour, Śatakratu, thou most active, bring A hero conquering in war.

8.98.d: त्वं हि नः पिता वसो त्वं माता शतक्रतो बभूविथ । अधा ते सुम्नमीमहे ॥
8.98.e: For, gracious Śatakratu, thou hast ever been a Mother and a Sire to us, So now for bliss we pray to thee.

8.98.d: त्वां शुष्मिन्पुरुहूत वाजयन्तमुप ब्रुवे शतक्रतो । स नो रास्व सुवीर्यम् ॥
8.98.e: To thee, Strong, Much-invoked, who showest forth thy strength, O Śatakratu, do I speak: So grant thou us heroic strength.

8.99.d: त्वामिदा ह्यो नरोऽपीप्यन्वज्रिन्भूर्णयः । स इन्द्र स्तोमवाहसामिह श्रुध्युप स्वसरमा गहि ॥
8.99.e: O THUNDERER, zealous worshippers gave thee drink this time yesterday.  So, Indra, listen here to those who bring the laud: come near unto our dwellingplace.

8.99.d: मत्स्वा सुशिप्र हरिवस्तदीमहे त्वे आ भूषन्ति वेधसः । तव श्रवांस्युपमान्युक्थ्या सुतेष्विन्द्र गिर्वणः ॥
8.99.e: Lord of Bay Steeds, fair-helmed, rejoice thee: this we crave. Here the disposers wait on thee.  Thy loftiest glories claim our lauds beside the juice, O Indra, Lover of the Song.

8.99.d: श्रायन्त इव सूर्यं विश्वेदिन्द्रस्य भक्षत । वसूनि जाते जनमान ओजसा प्रति भागं न दीधिम ॥
8.99.e: Turning, as ’twere, to meet the Sun, enjoy from Indra all good things.  When he who will be born is born with power we look to treasures as our heritage.

8.99.d: अनर्शरातिं वसुदामुप स्तुहि भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः । सो अस्य कामं विधतो न रोषति मनो दानाय चोदयन् ॥
8.99.e: Praise him who sends us wealth, whose bounties injure none: good are the gifts which Indra. grants.  He is not worth with one who satisfies his wish: he turns his mind to giving boons.

8.99.d: त्वमिन्द्र प्रतूर्तिष्वभि विश्वा असि स्पृधः । अशस्तिहा जनिता विश्वतूरसि त्वं तूर्य तरुष्यतः ॥
8.99.e: Thou in thy battles, Indra, art subduer of all hostile bands.  Father art thou, aIl-conquering, cancelling the curse, thou victor of the vanquisher.

8.99.d: अनु ते शुष्मं तुरयन्तमीयतुः क्षोणी शिशुं न मातरा । विश्वास्ते स्पृधः श्नथयन्त मन्यवे वृत्रं यदिन्द्र तूर्वसि ॥
8.99.e: The Earth and Heaven clung close to thy victorious might as to their calf two mother-cows.  When thou attackest Vṛtra all the hostile bands shrink and faint, Indra, at thy wrath.

8.99.d: इत ऊती वो अजरं प्रहेतारमप्रहितम् । आशुं जेतारं हेतारं रथीतममतूर्तं तुग्र्यावृधम् ॥
8.99.e: Bring to your aid the Eternal One, who shoots and none may shoot at him, Inciter, swift, victorious, best of Charioteers, Tugrya’s unvanquished Strengthener;

8.99.d: इष्कर्तारमनिष्कृतं सहस्कृतं शतमूतिं शतक्रतुम् । समानमिन्द्रमवसे हवामहे वसवानं वसूजुवम् ॥
8.99.e: Arranger of things unarranged, e’en Śatakratu, source of might, Indra, the Friend of all, for succour we invoke, Guardian of treasure, sending wealth.

8.100.d: अयं त एमि तन्वा पुरस्ताद्विश्वे देवा अभि मा यन्ति पश्चात् । यदा मह्यं दीधरो भागमिन्द्रादिन्मया कृणवो वीर्याणि ॥
8.100.e: I MOVE before thee here present in person, and all the Deities follow behind me. When, Indra, thou securest me my portion, with me thou shalt perform heroic actions.

8.100.d: दधामि ते मधुनो भक्षमग्रे हितस्ते भागः सुतो अस्तु सोमः । असश्च त्वं दक्षिणतः सखा मेऽधा वृत्राणि जङ्घनाव भूरि ॥
8.100.e: The food of meath in foremost place I give thee, thy Soma shall be pressed, thy share appointed. Thou on my right shalt be my friend and comrade: then shall we two smite dead full many a foeman.

8.100.d: प्र सु स्तोमं भरत वाजयन्त इन्द्राय सत्यं यदि सत्यमस्ति । नेन्द्रो अस्तीति नेम उ त्व आह क ईं ददर्श कमभि ष्टवाम ॥
8.100.e: Striving for strength bring forth a laud to Indra, a truthful hymn if he in truth existeth. One and another say, There is no Indra. Who hath beheld him? Whom then shall we honour?

8.100.d: अयमस्मि जरितः पश्य मेह विश्वा जातान्यभ्यस्मि मह्ना । ऋतस्य मा प्रदिशो वर्धयन्त्यादर्दिरो भुवना दर्दरीमि ॥
8.100.e: Here am I, look upon me here, O singer. All that existeth I surpass in greatness. The Holy Law's commandments make me mighty. Rending with strength I rend the worlds asunder.

8.100.d: आ यन्मा वेना अरुहन्नृतस्यँ एकमासीनं हर्यतस्य पृष्ठे । मनश्चिन्मे हृद आ प्रत्यवोचदचिक्रदञ्छिशुमन्तः सखायः ॥
8.100.e: When the Law's lovers mounted and approached me as I sate lone upon the dear sky's summit. Then spake my spirit to the heart within me, My friends have cried unto me with their children.

8.100.d: विश्वेत्ता ते सवनेषु प्रवाच्या या चकर्थ मघवन्निन्द्र सुन्वते । पारावतं यत्पुरुसम्भृतं वस्वपावृणोः शरभाय ऋषिबन्धवे ॥
8.100.e: All these thy deeds must be declared at Soma-feasts, wrought, Indra, Bounteous Lord, for him who sheds the juice, When thou didst open wealth heaped up by many, brought from far away to Sarabha, the Rishi's kin.

8.100.d: प्र नूनं धावता पृथङ्नेह यो वो अवावरीत् । नि षीं वृत्रस्य मर्मणि वज्रमिन्द्रो अपीपतत् ॥
8.100.e: Now run ye forth your several ways: he is not here who kept you back. For hath not Indra sunk his bolt deep down in Vṛtra's vital part?

8.100.d: मनोजवा अयमान आयसीमतरत्पुरम् । दिवं सुपर्णो गत्वाय सोमं वज्रिण आभरत् ॥
8.100.e: On-rushing with the speed of thought within the iron fort he pressed : The Falcon went to heaven and brought the Soma to the Thunderer.

8.100.d: समुद्रे अन्तः शयत उद्ना वज्रो अभीवृतः । भरन्त्यस्मै संयतः पुरःप्रस्रवणा बलिम् ॥
8.100.e: Deep in the ocean lies the bolt with waters compassed round about, And in continuous Onward flow the floods their tribute bring to it.

8.100.d: यद्वाग्वदन्त्यविचेतनानि राष्ट्री देवानां निषसाद मन्द्रा । चतस्र ऊर्जं दुदुहे पयांसि क्व स्विदस्याः परमं जगाम ॥
8.100.e: When, uttering words which no one comprehended, Vak, Queen of Gods, the Gladdener, was seated, The heaven’s four regions drew forth drink and vigour: now whither hath her noblest portion vanished?

8.100.d: देवीं वाचमजनयन्त देवास्तां विश्वरूपाः पशवो वदन्ति । सा नो मन्द्रेषमूर्जं दुहाना धेनुर्वागस्मानुप सुष्टुतैतु ॥
8.100.e: The Deities generated Vak the Goddess, and animals of every figure speak her. May she, the Gladdener, yielding food and vigour, the Milch-cow Vak, approach us meetly lauded.

8.100.d: सखे विष्णो वितरं वि क्रमस्व द्यौर्देहि लोकं वज्राय विष्कभे । हनाव वृत्रं रिणचाव सिन्धूनिन्द्रस्य यन्तु प्रसवे विसृष्टाः ॥
8.100.e: Step forth with wider stride, my comrade Vishnu; make room, Dyaus, for the leaping of the lightning. Let us slay Vṛtra, let us free the rivers: let them flow loosed at the command of Indra.

8.101.d: ऋधगित्था स मर्त्यः शशमे देवतातये । यो नूनं मित्रावरुणावभिष्टय आचक्रे हव्यदातये ॥
8.101.e: YEA, specially that mortal man hath toiled for service of the Gods,  Who quickly hath brought near Mitra and Varuṇa. to share his sacrificial gifts.

8.101.d: वर्षिष्ठक्षत्रा उरुचक्षसा नरा राजाना दीर्घश्रुत्तमा । ता बाहुता न दंसना रथर्यतः साकं सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः ॥
8.101.e: Supreme in sovran power, far-sighted, Chiefs and Kings, most swift to hear from far away,  Both, wondrously, set them in motion as with arms, in company with Sūrya's beams.

8.101.d: प्र यो वां मित्रावरुणाजिरो दूतो अद्रवत् । अयःशीर्षा मदेरघुः ॥
8.101.e: The rapid messenger who runs before you, Mitra-Varuṇa, with iron head, swift to the draught,

8.101.d: न यः सम्पृच्छे न पुनर्हवीतवे न संवादाय रमते । तस्मान्नो अद्य समृतेरुरुष्यतं बाहुभ्यां न उरुष्यतम् ॥
8.101.e: He whom no man may question, none may summon back, who stands not still for colloquy,—  From hostile clash with him keep ye us safe this day: keep us in safety with your arms.

8.101.d: प्र मित्राय प्रार्यम्णे सचथ्यमृतावसो । वरूथ्यं१ वरुणे छन्द्यं वचः स्तोत्रं राजसु गायत ॥
8.101.e: To Aryaman and Mitra sing a reverent song, O pious one,  A pleasant hymn that shall protect to Varuṇa: sing forth a laud unto the Kings.

8.101.d: ते हिन्विरे अरुणं जेन्यं वस्वेकं पुत्रं तिसॄणाम् । ते धामान्यमृता मर्त्यानामदब्धा अभि चक्षते ॥
8.101.e: The true, Red Treasure they have sent, one only Son born of the Three.  They, the Immortal Ones, never deceived, survey the families of mortal men.

8.101.d: आ मे वचांस्युद्यता द्युमत्तमानि कर्त्वा । उभा यातं नासत्या सजोषसा प्रति हव्यानि वीतये ॥
8.101.e: My songs are lifted up, and acts most splendid are to be performed. Come hither, ye Nāsatyas, with accordant mind, to meet and to enjoy my gifts.

8.101.d: रातिं यद्वामरक्षसं हवामहे युवाभ्यां वाजिनीवसू । प्राचीं होत्रां प्रतिरन्तावितं नरा गृणाना जमदग्निना ॥
8.101.e: Lords of great wealth, ẉhen we invoke your bounty which no demon checks, Both of you, furthering our eastward-offered praise, come, Chiefs whom Jamadagni lauds!

8.101.d: आ नो यज्ञं दिविस्पृशं वायो याहि सुमन्मभिः । अन्तः पवित्र उपरि श्रीणानो३ऽयं शुक्रो अयामि ते ॥
8.101.e: Come, Vāyu, drawn by fair hymns, to our sacrifice that reaches heaven. Poured on the middle of the straining-cloth, and cooked, this bright drink hath been offered thee.

8.101.d: वेत्यध्वर्युः पथिभी रजिष्ठैः प्रति हव्यानि वीतये । अधा नियुत्व उभयस्य नः पिब शुचिं सोमं गवाशिरम् ॥
8.101.e: He comes by straightest paths, as ministering Priest, to taste the sacrificial gifts. Then, Lord of harnessed teams! drink of the twofold draught, bright Soma mingled with the milk.

8.101.d: बण्महाँ असि सूर्य बळादित्य महाँ असि । महस्ते सतो महिमा पनस्यतेऽद्धा देव महाँ असि ॥
8.101.e: Verily, Sūrya, thou art great; truly, Āditya, thou art great. As thou art great indeed, thy greatness is admired: yea, verily, thou, God, art great.

8.101.d: बट् सूर्य श्रवसा महाँ असि सत्रा देव महाँ असि । मह्ना देवानामसुर्यः पुरोहितो विभु ज्योतिरदाभ्यम् ॥
8.101.e: Yea, Sūrya, thou art great in fame: thou evermore, O God, art great. Thou by thy greatness art the Gods' High Priest, divine, far-spread unconquerable light.

8.101.d: इयं या नीच्यर्किणी रूपा रोहिण्या कृता । चित्रेव प्रत्यदर्श्यायत्य१न्तर्दशसु बाहुषु ॥
8.101.e: She yonder, bending lowly down, clothed in red hues and rich in rays, Is seen, advancing as it were with various tints, amid the ten surrounding arms.
