8.101.d: प्रजा ह तिस्रो अत्यायमीयुर्न्य१न्या अर्कमभितो विविश्रे । बृहद्ध तस्थौ भुवनेष्वन्तः पवमानो हरित आ विवेश ॥
8.101.e: Past and gone are three mortal generations: the fourth and last into the Sun hath entered. He mid the worlds his lofty place hath taken. Into green plants is gone the Purifying.

8.101.d: माता रुद्राणां दुहिता वसूनां स्वसादित्यानाममृतस्य नाभिः । प्र नु वोचं चिकितुषे जनाय मा गामनागामदितिं वधिष्ट ॥
8.101.e: The Rudras' Mother, Daughter of the Vasus, centre of nectar, the Ādityas' Sister — To folk who understand will I proclaim it — injure not Aditi, the Cow, the sinless.

8.101.d: वचोविदं वाचमुदीरयन्तीं विश्वाभिर्धीभिरुपतिष्ठमानाम् । देवीं देवेभ्यः पर्येयुषीं गामा मावृक्त मर्त्यो दभ्रचेताः ॥
8.101.e: Weak-minded men have as a cow adopted me who came hither from the Gods, a Goddess, Who, skilled in eloquence, her voice uplifteth, who standeth near at hand with all devotions.

8.102.d: त्वमग्ने बृहद्वयो दधासि देव दाशुषे । कविर्गृहपतिर्युवा ॥
8.102.e: LORD of the house, Sage, ever young, high power of life, O Agni, God,  Thou givest to thy worshipper.

8.102.d: स न ईळानया सह देवाँ अग्ने दुवस्युवा । चिकिद्विभानवा वह ॥
8.102.e: So with our song that prays and serves, attentive, Lord of spreading light,  Agni, bring hitherward the Gods.

8.102.d: त्वया ह स्विद्युजा वयं चोदिष्ठेन यविष्ठ्य । अभि ष्मो वाजसातये ॥
8.102.e: For, Ever-Youthful One, with thee, best Furtherer, as our ally,  We overcome, to win the spoil.

8.102.d: और्वभृगुवच्छुचिमप्नवानवदा हुवे । अग्निं समुद्रवाससम् ॥
8.102.e: As Aurva Bhṛgu used, as Apnavāna used, I call the pure  Agni who clothes him with the sea.

8.102.d: हुवे वातस्वनं कविं पर्जन्यक्रन्द्यं सहः । अग्निं समुद्रवाससम् ॥
8.102.e: 1 call the Sage who sounds like wind, the Might that like Parjanya roars,  Agni who clothes him with the sea.

8.102.d: आ सवं सवितुर्यथा भगस्येव भुजिं हुवे । अग्निं समुद्रवाससम् ॥
8.102.e: As Savitar's productive Power, as him who sends down bliss, I call  Agni who clothes him with the sea.

8.102.d: अग्निं वो वृधन्तमध्वराणां पुरूतमम् । अच्छा नप्त्रे सहस्वते ॥
8.102.e: Hither, for powerful kirship, I call Agni, him Who prospers you,  Most frequent at our solemn rites

8.102.d: अयं यथा न आभुवत्त्वष्टा रूपेव तक्ष्या । अस्य क्रत्वा यशस्वतः ॥
8.102.e: That through this famed One's power, he may stand by us even as Tvaṣṭar comes Unto the forms that must be shaped.

8.102.d: अयं विश्वा अभि श्रियोऽग्निर्देवेषु पत्यते । आ वाजैरुप नो गमत् ॥
8.102.e: This Agni is the Lord supreme above all glories mid the Gods: May he come nigh to us with strength.

8.102.d: विश्वेषामिह स्तुहि होतॄणां यशस्तमम् । अग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यम् ॥
8.102.e: Here praise ye him the most renowned of all the ministering Priests, Agni, the Chief at sacrifice;

8.102.d: शीरं पावकशोचिषं ज्येष्ठो यो दमेष्वा । दीदाय दीर्घश्रुत्तमः ॥
8.102.e: Piercing, with purifying flame, enkindled in our homes, most high, Swiftest to hear from far away.

8.102.d: तमर्वन्तं न सानसिं गृणीहि विप्र शुष्मिणम् । मित्रं न यातयज्जनम् ॥
8.102.e: Sage, laud the Mighty One who wins the spoil of victory like a steed, And, Mitra-like, unites the folk.

8.102.d: उप त्वा जामयो गिरो देदिशतीर्हविष्कृतः । वायोरनीके अस्थिरन् ॥
8.102.e: Still turning to their aim in thee, the oblation-bearer's sister hymns Have come to thee before the wind.

8.102.d: यस्य त्रिधात्ववृतं बर्हिस्तस्थावसंदिनम् । आपश्चिन्नि दधा पदम् ॥
8.102.e: The waters find their place in him, for whom the threefold sacred grass Is spread unbound, unlimited.

8.102.d: पदं देवस्य मीळ्हुषोऽनाधृष्टाभिरूतिभिः । भद्रा सूर्य इवोपदृक् ॥
8.102.e: The station of the Bounteous God hath, through his aid which none impair, A pleasant aspect like the Sun.

8.102.d: अग्ने घृतस्य धीतिभिस्तेपानो देव शोचिषा । आ देवान्वक्षि यक्षि च ॥
8.102.e: Blazing with splendour, Agni, God, through pious gifts of sacred oil, Bring thou the Gods and worship them.

8.102.d: तं त्वाजनन्त मातरः कविं देवासो अङ्गिरः । हव्यवाहममर्त्यम् ॥
8.102.e: The Gods as mothers brought thee forth, the Immortal Sage, O Aṅgiras, The bearer of our gifts to heaven.

8.102.d: प्रचेतसं त्वा कवेऽग्ने दूतं वरेण्यम् । हव्यवाहं नि षेदिरे ॥
8.102.e: Wise Agni, Gods established thee, the Seer, noblest messenger, As bearer of our sacred gifts.

8.102.d: नहि मे अस्त्यघ्न्या न स्वधितिर्वनन्वति । अथैतादृग्भरामि ते ॥
8.102.e: No cow have I to call mine own, no axe at hand wherewith to work, Yet what is here I bring to thee.

8.102.d: यदग्ने कानि कानि चिदा ते दारूणि दध्मसि । ता जुषस्व यविष्ठ्य ॥
8.102.e: O Agni, whatsoever be the fuel that we lay for thee, Be pleased therewith, Most Youthful God.

8.102.d: यदत्त्युपजिह्विका यद्वम्रो अतिसर्पति । सर्वं तदस्तु ते घृतम् ॥
8.102.e: That which the white-ant eats away, that over which the emmet crawls — May all of this be oil to thee.

8.102.d: अग्निमिन्धानो मनसा धियं सचेत मर्त्यः । अग्निमीधे विवस्वभिः ॥
8.102.e: When he enkindles Agni, man should with his heart attend the song: I with the priests have kindled him.

8.103.d: अदर्शि गातुवित्तमो यस्मिन्व्रतान्यादधुः । उपो षु जातमार्यस्य वर्धनमग्निं नक्षन्त नो गिरः ॥
8.103.e: THAT noblest Furtherer hath appeared, to whom men bring their holy works. Our songs of praise have risen aloft to Agni who was barn to give the Ārya strength.

8.103.d: प्र दैवोदासो अग्निर्देवाँ अच्छा न मज्मना । अनु मातरं पृथिवीं वि वावृते तस्थौ नाकस्य सानवि ॥
8.103.e: Agni of Divodāsa turned, as 'twere in majesty, to the Gods. Onward he sped along the mother earth, and took his station in the height of heaven.

8.103.d: यस्माद्रेजन्त कृष्टयश्चर्कृत्यानि कृण्वतः । सहस्रसां मेधसाताविव त्मनाग्निं धीभिः सपर्यत ॥
8.103.e: Him before whom the people shrink ẉhen he performs his glorious deeds, Him who wins thousands at the worship of the Gods, himself, that Agni, serve with son s.

8.103.d: प्र यं राये निनीषसि मर्तो यस्ते वसो दाशत् । स वीरं धत्ते अग्न उक्थशंसिनं त्मना सहस्रपोषिणम् ॥
8.103.e: The mortal man whom thou wouldst lead to opulence, O Vasu, he who brings thee gifts. He, Agni, wins himself a hero singing lauds, yea, one who feeds a thousand men.

8.103.d: स दृळ्हे चिदभि तृणत्ति वाजमर्वता स धत्ते अक्षिति श्रवः । त्वे देवत्रा सदा पुरूवसो विश्वा वामानि धीमहि ॥
8.103.e: He with the steed wins spoil even in the fenced fort, and gains imperishable fame. In thee, O Lord of wealth, continually we lay all precious offerings to the Gods.

8.103.d: यो विश्वा दयते वसु होता मन्द्रो जनानाम् । मधोर्न पात्रा प्रथमान्यस्मै प्र स्तोमा यन्त्यग्नये ॥
8.103.e: To him who dealeth out all wealth, who is the cheerful Priest of men, To him, like the first vessels filled with savoury juice, to Agni go the songs of praise.

8.103.d: अश्वं न गीर्भी रथ्यं सुदानवो मर्मृज्यन्ते देवयवः । उभे तोके तनये दस्म विश्पते पर्षि राधो मघोनाम् ॥
8.103.e: Votaries, richly-gifted, deck him with their songs, even as the steed who draws the car. On both, Strong Lord of men! on child and grandson pour the bounties which our nobles give.

8.103.d: प्र मंहिष्ठाय गायत ऋताव्ने बृहते शुक्रशोचिषे । उपस्तुतासो अग्नये ॥
8.103.e: Sing forth to him, the Holy, most munificent, sublime with his refulgent glow, To Agni, ye Upastutas.

8.103.d: आ वंसते मघवा वीरवद्यशः समिद्धो द्युम्न्याहुतः । कुविन्नो अस्य सुमतिर्नवीयस्यच्छा वाजेभिरागमत् ॥
8.103.e: Worshipped with gifts, enkindled, splendid, Maghavan shall win himself heroic fame. And will not his most newly shown benevolence come to us with abundant strength?

8.103.d: प्रेष्ठमु प्रियाणां स्तुह्यासावातिथिम् । अग्निं रथानां यमम् ॥
8.103.e: Priest, presser of the juice! praise now the dearest Guest of all our friends, Agni, the driver of the cars.

8.103.d: उदिता यो निदिता वेदिता वस्वा यज्ञियो ववर्तति । दुष्टरा यस्य प्रवणे नोर्मयो धिया वाजं सिषासतः ॥
8.103.e: Who, finder-out of treasures open and concealed, bringeth them hither, Holy One; Whose waves, as in a cataract, are hard to pass, ẉhen he, through song, would win him strength.

8.103.d: मा नो हृणीतामतिथिर्वसुरग्निः पुरुप्रशस्त एषः । यः सुहोता स्वध्वरः ॥
8.103.e: Let not the noble Guest, Agni, be wroth with us: by many a man his praise is sung, Good Herald, skilled in sacrifice.

8.103.d: मो ते रिषन्ये अच्छोक्तिभिर्वसोऽग्ने केभिश्चिदेवैः । कीरिश्चिद्धि त्वामीट्टे दूत्याय रातहव्यः स्वध्वरः ॥
8.103.e: O Vasu, Agni, let not them be harmed who come in any way with lauds to thee. Even the lowly, skilled in rites, with offered gifts, seeketh thee for the envoy's task.

8.103.d: आग्ने याहि मरुत्सखा रुद्रेभिः सोमपीतये । सोभर्या उप सुष्टुतिं मादयस्व स्वर्णरे ॥
8.103.e: Friend of the Maruts, Agni, come with Rudras to the Soma-draught, To Sobharī's fair song of praise, and be thou joyful in the light.

9.1.d: स्वादिष्ठया मदिष्ठया पवस्व सोम धारया । इन्द्राय पातवे सुतः ॥
9.1.e: In sweetest and most gladdening stream  flow pure, O Soma, on thy way,  Pressed out for Indra, for his drink.
Fiend-queller, Friend of all men, he hath with the wood attained unto  His place, his iron-fashioned home.

9.1.d: वरिवोधातमो भव मंहिष्ठो वृत्रहन्तमः । पर्षि राधो मघोनाम् ॥
9.1.e: Be thou best Vṛtra-slayer, best granter of bliss, most liberal:  Promote our wealthy princes' gifts.

9.1.d: अभ्यर्ष महानां देवानां वीतिमन्धसा । अभि वाजमुत श्रवः ॥
9.1.e: Flow onward with thy juice unto the banquet of the Mighty Gods:  Flow hither for our strength and fame.

9.1.d: त्वामच्छा चरामसि तदिदर्थं दिवेदिवे । इन्दो त्वे न आशसः ॥
9.1.e: O Indu, we draw nigh to thee, with this one object day by day:  To thee alone our prayers are said

9.1.d: पुनाति ते परिस्रुतं सोमं सूर्यस्य दुहिता । वारेण शश्वता तना ॥
9.1.e: By means of this eternal fleece may Sūrya's Daughter purify  Thy Soma that is foaming forth.

9.1.d: तमीमण्वीः समर्य आ गृभ्णन्ति योषणो दश । स्वसारः पार्ये दिवि ॥
9.1.e: Ten sister maids of slender form seize him within the press and hold  Him firmly on the final day.

9.1.d: तमीं हिन्वन्त्यग्रुवो धमन्ति बाकुरं दृतिम् । त्रिधातु वारणं मधु ॥
9.1.e: The virgins send him forth: they blow the the skin musician-like and fuse  The triple foe-repelling meath.

9.1.d: अभी३ममघ्न्या उत श्रीणन्ति धेनवः शिशुम् । सोममिन्द्राय पातवे ॥
9.1.e: Inviolable milch-kine round about him blend for Indra's drink,  The fresh young Soma with their milk.

9.1.d: अस्येदिन्द्रो मदेष्वा विश्वा वृत्राणि जिघ्नते । शूरो मघा च मंहते ॥
9.1.e: In the wild raptures of this draught, Indra slays all the Vṛtras: he,  The Hero, pours his wealth on us.

9.2.d: पवस्व देववीरति पवित्रं सोम रंह्या । इन्द्रमिन्दो वृषा विश ॥
9.2.e: Soma, flow on, inviting Gods, speed to the purifying cloth:  Pass into Indra, as a Bull.

9.2.d: आ वच्यस्व महि प्सरो वृषेन्दो द्युम्नवत्तमः । आ योनिं धर्णसिः सदः ॥
9.2.e: As mighty food speed hitherward, Indu, as a most splendid Steer:  Sit in thy place as one with strength.

9.2.d: अधुक्षत प्रियं मधु धारा सुतस्य वेधसः । अपो वसिष्ट सुक्रतुः ॥
9.2.e: The well-loved meath was made to flow, the stream of the creative juice  ne Sage drew waters to himself.

9.2.d: महान्तं त्वा महीरन्वापो अर्षन्ति सिन्धवः । यद्गोभिर्वासयिष्यसे ॥
9.2.e: The mighty waters, yea, the floods accompany thee Mighty One,  When thou wilt clothe thee with the milk.

9.2.d: समुद्रो अप्सु मामृजे विष्टम्भो धरुणो दिवः । सोमः पवित्रे अस्मयुः ॥
9.2.e: The lake is brightened in the floods. Soma, our Friend, heaven's prop and stay,  Falls on the purifying cloth.

9.2.d: अचिक्रदद्वृषा हरिर्महान्मित्रो न दर्शतः । सं सूर्येण रोचते ॥
9.2.e: The tawny Bull hath bellowed, fair as mighty Mitra to behold:  He shines together with the Sun.

9.2.d: गिरस्त इन्द ओजसा मर्मृज्यन्ते अपस्युवः । याभिर्मदाय शुम्भसे ॥
9.2.e: Songs, Indu, active in their might are beautified for thee, wherewith  Thou deckest thee for our delight.

9.2.d: तं त्वा मदाय घृष्वय उ लोककृत्नुमीमहे । तव प्रशस्तयो महीः ॥
9.2.e: To thee who givest ample room we pray, to win the joyous draught:  Great are the praise& due to thee.

9.2.d: अस्मभ्यमिन्दविन्द्रयुर्मध्वः पवस्व धारया । पर्जन्यो वृष्टिमाँ इव ॥
9.2.e: Indu as, Indra's Friend, on us pour with a stream of sweetness, like  Parjanya sender of the rain.

9.2.d: गोषा इन्दो नृषा अस्यश्वसा वाजसा उत । आत्मा यज्ञस्य पूर्व्यः ॥
9.2.e: Winner of kine, Indu, art thou, winner of heroes, steeds, and strength  Primeval Soul of sacrifice.

9.3.d: एष देवो अमर्त्यः पर्णवीरिव दीयति । अभि द्रोणान्यासदम् ॥
9.3.e: HERE present this Immortal God flies, like a bird upon her wings,  To settle in the vats of wood.

9.3.d: एष देवो विपा कृतोऽति ह्वरांसि धावति । पवमानो अदाभ्यः ॥
9.3.e: This God, made ready with the hymn, runs swiftly through the winding ways,  Inviolable as he flows.

9.3.d: एष देवो विपन्युभिः पवमान ऋतायुभिः । हरिर्वाजाय मृज्यते ॥
9.3.e: This God while flowing is adorned, like a bay steed for war, by men  Devout and skilled in holy songs.

9.3.d: एष विश्वानि वार्या शूरो यन्निव सत्वभिः । पवमानः सिषासति ॥
9.3.e: He, like a warrior going forth with heroes, as he flows along  Is fain to win all precious boons.

9.3.d: एष देवो रथर्यति पवमानो दशस्यति । आविष्कृणोति वग्वनुम् ॥
9.3.e: This God, as he is flowing on, speeds like a car and gives his gifts:  He lets his voice be heard of all

9.3.d: एष विप्रैरभिष्टुतोऽपो देवो वि गाहते । दधद्रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥
9.3.e: Praised by the sacred bards, this God dives into waters, and bestows  Rich gifts upon the worshipper.

9.3.d: एष दिवं वि धावति तिरो रजांसि धारया । पवमानः कनिक्रदत् ॥
9.3.e: Away he rushes with his stream, across the regions, into heaven,  And roars as he is flowing on.

9.3.d: एष दिवं व्यासरत्तिरो रजांस्यस्पृतः । पवमानः स्वध्वरः ॥
9.3.e: While flowing, meet for sacrifice, he hath gone up to heaven across  The regions, irresistible.

9.3.d: एष प्रत्नेन जन्मना देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः । हरिः पवित्रे अर्षति ॥
9.3.e: After the 'way of ancient time, this God, pressed out for Deities,  Flows tawny to the straining-cloth.

9.3.d: एष उ स्य पुरुव्रतो जज्ञानो जनयन्निषः । धारया पवते सुतः ॥
9.3.e: This Lord of many Holy Laws, even at his birth engendering strength,  Effused, flows onward in a stream.

9.4.d: सना च सोम जेषि च पवमान महि श्रवः । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
9.4.e: O Soma flowing on thy way, win thou and conquer high renown;  And make us better than we are.

9.4.d: सना ज्योतिः सना स्व१र्विश्वा च सोम सौभगा । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
9.4.e: Win thou the light, win heavenly light, and, Soma, all felicities;  And make us better than we are.

9.4.d: सना दक्षमुत क्रतुमप सोम मृधो जहि । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
9.4.e: Win skilful strength and mental power. O Soma, drive away our foes;  And make us better than we are.

9.4.d: पवीतारः पुनीतन सोममिन्द्राय पातवे । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
9.4.e: Ye purifiers, purify Soma for Indra, for his drink:  Make thou us better than we are.

9.4.d: त्वं सूर्ये न आ भज तव क्रत्वा तवोतिभिः । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
9.4.e: Give us our portion in the Sun through thine own mental power and aids;  And make us better than we are.

9.4.d: तव क्रत्वा तवोतिभिर्ज्योक्पश्येम सूर्यम् । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
9.4.e: Through thine own mental power and aid long may we look upon the Sun;  Make thou us better than we are.

9.4.d: अभ्यर्ष स्वायुध सोम द्विबर्हसं रयिम् । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
9.4.e: Well-weaponed Soma, pour to usa stream of riches doubly great;  And make us better than we are.

9.4.d: अभ्य१र्षानपच्युतो रयिं समत्सु सासहिः । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
9.4.e: As one victorious unsubdued in battle pour forth wealth to us;  And make us better than we are.

9.4.d: त्वां यज्ञैरवीवृधन्पवमान विधर्मणि । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
9.4.e: By worship, Pavamana! men have strengthened thee to prop the Law:  Make thou us better than we are.

9.4.d: रयिं नश्चित्रमश्विनमिन्दो विश्वायुमा भर । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
9.4.e: O Indu, bring us wealth in steeds, manifold. quickening all life;  And mate us better than we are.

9.5.d: समिद्धो विश्वतस्पतिः पवमानो वि राजति । प्रीणन्वृषा कनिक्रदत् ॥
9.5.e: ENKINDLED, Pavamana, Lord, sends forth his light on, every side  In friendly show, the bellowing Bull.

9.5.d: तनूनपात्पवमानः शृङ्गे शिशानो अर्षति । अन्तरिक्षेण रारजत् ॥
9.5.e: He, Pavamana, Self-produced, speeds onward sharpening his horns:  He glitters through the firmament.

9.5.d: ईळेन्यः पवमानो रयिर्वि राजति द्युमान् । मधोर्धाराभिरोजसा ॥
9.5.e: Brilliant like wealth, adorable, with splendour Pavamana shines,  Mightily with the streams of meath.

9.5.d: बर्हिः प्राचीनमोजसा पवमानः स्तृणन्हरिः । देवेषु देव ईयते ॥
9.5.e: The tawny Pavamana, who strews from of old the grass with might,  Is worshipped, God amid the Gods.
The golden, the Celestial Doors are lifted with their frames on high,  By Pavamana glorified.

9.5.d: सुशिल्पे बृहती मही पवमानो वृषण्यति । नक्तोषासा न दर्शते ॥
9.5.e: With passion Pavamana longs for the great lofty pair, well-formed  Like beauteous maidens, Night and Dawn

9.5.d: उभा देवा नृचक्षसा होतारा दैव्या हुवे । पवमान इन्द्रो वृषा ॥
9.5.e: Both Gods who look on men I call, Celestial Heralds: Indra's Self  Is Pavamana, yea, the Bull.

9.5.d: भारती पवमानस्य सरस्वतीळा मही । इमं नो यज्ञमा गमन्तिस्रो देवीः सुपेशसः ॥
9.5.e: This, Pavamana's sacrifice, shall the three beauteous Goddesses,  Sarasvatī and Bhāratī and Iḷā, Mighty One, attend.

9.5.d: त्वष्टारमग्रजां गोपां पुरोयावानमा हुवे । इन्दुरिन्द्रो वृषा हरिः पवमानः प्रजापतिः ॥
9.5.e: 1 summon Tvaṣṭar hither, our protector, champion, earliest-born,  Indu is Indra, tawny Steer; Pavamana is Prajāpati.

9.5.d: वनस्पतिं पवमान मध्वा समङ्ग्धि धारया । सहस्रवल्शं हरितं भ्राजमानं हिरण्ययम् ॥
9.5.e: O Pavamana, with the meath in streams anoint Vanaspati,  The ever-green. the golden-hued, refulgent, with a thousand boughs.

9.5.d: विश्वे देवाः स्वाहाकृतिं पवमानस्या गत । वायुर्बृहस्पतिः सूर्योऽग्निरिन्द्रः सजोषसः ॥
9.5.e: Come to the consecrating rite of Pavamana, all ye Gods,—  Vāyu, Sūrya, Bṛhaspati, Indra, and Agni, in accord.

9.6.d: मन्द्रया सोम धारया वृषा पवस्व देवयुः । अव्यो वारेष्वस्मयुः ॥
9.6.e: SOMA, flow on with pleasant stream, a Bull devoted to the Gods,  Our Friend, unto the woollen sieve.

9.6.d: अभि त्यं मद्यं मदमिन्दविन्द्र इति क्षर । अभि वाजिनो अर्वतः ॥
9.6.e: Pour hitherward, as Indra's Self, Indu, that gladdening stream of thine,  And send us coursers full of strength.

9.6.d: अभि त्यं पूर्व्यं मदं सुवानो अर्ष पवित्र आ । अभि वाजमुत श्रवः ॥
9.6.e: Flow to the filter hitherward, pouring that ancient gladdening juice,  Streaming forth power and high renown.

9.6.d: अनु द्रप्सास इन्दव आपो न प्रवतासरन् । पुनाना इन्द्रमाशत ॥
9.6.e: Hither the sparkling drops have flowed, like waters down a steep descent  They have reached Indra purified.

9.6.d: यमत्यमिव वाजिनं मृजन्ति योषणो दश । वने क्रीळन्तमत्यविम् ॥
9.6.e: Whom, having passed the filter, ten dames cleanse, as ’twere a vigorous steed,  While he disports him in the wood,—

9.6.d: तं गोभिर्वृषणं रसं मदाय देववीतये । सुतं भराय सं सृज ॥
9.6.e: The steer-strong juice with milk pour forth, for feast and service of the Gods,  To him who bears away the draught.

9.6.d: देवो देवाय धारयेन्द्राय पवते सुतः । पयो यदस्य पीपयत् ॥
9.6.e: Effused, the God flows onward with his stream to Indra, to the God,  So that his milk may strengthen him.

9.6.d: आत्मा यज्ञस्य रंह्या सुष्वाणः पवते सुतः । प्रत्नं नि पाति काव्यम् ॥
9.6.e: Soul of the sacrifice, the juice effused flows quickly on: he keeps  His ancient wisdom of a Sage.

9.6.d: एवा पुनान इन्द्रयुर्मदं मदिष्ठ वीतये । गुहा चिद्दधिषे गिरः ॥
9.6.e: So pouring forth, as Indra's Friend, strong drink, best Gladdener! for the feast,  Thou, even in secret, storest hymns.

9.7.d: असृग्रमिन्दवः पथा धर्मन्नृतस्य सुश्रियः । विदाना अस्य योजनम् ॥
9.7.e: FORTH on their way the glorious drops have flowed for maintenance of Law,  Knowing this sacrifice's course.

9.7.d: प्र धारा मध्वो अग्रियो महीरपो वि गाहते । हविर्हविष्षु वन्द्यः ॥
9.7.e: Down in the mighty waters sinks the stream of meath, most excellent,  Oblation best of all in worth.

9.7.d: प्र युजो वाचो अग्रियो वृषाव चक्रदद्वने । सद्माभि सत्यो अध्वरः ॥
9.7.e: About the holy place, the Steer true, guileless, noblest, hath sent forth  Continuous voices in the wood.

9.7.d: परि यत्काव्या कविर्नृम्णा वसानो अर्षति । स्वर्वाजी सिषासति ॥
9.7.e: When, clothed in manly strength, the Sage flows in celestial wisdom round,  The Strong would win the light of heaven.

9.7.d: पवमानो अभि स्पृधो विशो राजेव सीदति । यदीमृण्वन्ति वेधसः ॥
9.7.e: When purified, he sits as King above the hosts, among his folk,  What time the sages bring him nigh.

9.7.d: अव्यो वारे परि प्रियो हरिर्वनेषु सीदति । रेभो वनुष्यते मती ॥
9.7.e: Dear, golden-coloured, in the fleece he sinks and settles in the wood:  The Singer shows his zeal in hymns.

9.7.d: स वायुमिन्द्रमश्विना साकं मदेन गच्छति । रणा यो अस्य धर्मभिः ॥
9.7.e: He goes to Indra, Vāyu, to the Aśvins, as his custom is,  With gladdening juice which gives them joy.

9.7.d: आ मित्रावरुणा भगं मध्वः पवन्त ऊर्मयः । विदाना अस्य शक्मभिः ॥
9.7.e: Tle streams of pleasant Soma flow to Bhaga, Mitra-VARUNA,– Well-knowing through his mighty powers. Heaven and Earth, riches of meath to win us wealth: Gain for us treasures and renown.

9.7.d: अस्मभ्यं रोदसी रयिं मध्वो वाजस्य सातये । श्रवो वसूनि सं जितम् ॥
9.7.e: Heaven and Earth, riches of meath to win us wealth:  Gain for us treasures and renown.

9.8.d: एते सोमा अभि प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काममक्षरन् । वर्धन्तो अस्य वीर्यम् ॥
9.8.e: OBEYING Indra's dear desire these Soma juices have flowed forth,  Increasing his heroic might.

9.8.d: पुनानासश्चमूषदो गच्छन्तो वायुमश्विना । ते नो धान्तु सुवीर्यम् ॥
9.8.e: Laid in the bowl, pure-flowing on to Vāyu and the Aśvins, may  These give us great heroic strength.

9.8.d: इन्द्रस्य सोम राधसे पुनानो हार्दि चोदय । ऋतस्य योनिमासदम् ॥
9.8.e: Soma, as thou art purified, incite to bounty Indra's heart,  To sit in place of sacrifice.

9.8.d: मृजन्ति त्वा दश क्षिपो हिन्वन्ति सप्त धीतयः । अनु विप्रा अमादिषुः ॥
9.8.e: The ten swift fingers deck thee forth, seven ministers impel thee on:  The sages have rejoiced in thee.

9.8.d: देवेभ्यस्त्वा मदाय कं सृजानमति मेष्यः । सं गोभिर्वासयामसि ॥
9.8.e: When through the filter thou art poured, we clothe thee with a robe of milk  To be a gladdening draught for Gods.

9.8.d: पुनानः कलशेष्वा वस्त्राण्यरुषो हरिः । परि गव्यान्यव्यत ॥
9.8.e: When purified within the jars, Soma, brightred and golden-hued,  Hath clothed him with a robe of milk.

9.8.d: मघोन आ पवस्व नो जहि विश्वा अप द्विषः । इन्दो सखायमा विश ॥
9.8.e: Flow on to us and make us rich. Drive all our enemies away. O Indu, flow into thy Friend. Send down the rain from heaven, a stream of opulence from earth. Give us, O Soma, victory in war.

9.8.d: वृष्टिं दिवः परि स्रव द्युम्नं पृथिव्या अधि । सहो नः सोम पृत्सु धाः ॥
9.8.e: Send down the rain from heaven, a stream of opulence from earth. Give us,  O Soma, victory in war.

9.8.d: नृचक्षसं त्वा वयमिन्द्रपीतं स्वर्विदम् । भक्षीमहि प्रजामिषम् ॥
9.8.e: May we obtain thee, Indra's drink, who viewest men and findest light,  Gain thee, and progeny and food.

9.9.d: परि प्रिया दिवः कविर्वयांसि नप्त्योर्हितः । सुवानो याति कविक्रतुः ॥
9.9.e: THE Sage of Heaven whose heart is wise, when laid between both hands and pressed,  Sends us delightful powers of life.

9.9.d: प्रप्र क्षयाय पन्यसे जनाय जुष्टो अद्रुहे । वीत्यर्ष चनिष्ठया ॥
9.9.e: On, onward to a glorious home; dear to the people void of guile,  With excellent enjoyment, flow.

9.9.d: स सूनुर्मातरा शुचिर्जातो जाते अरोचयत् । महान्मही ऋतावृधा ॥
9.9.e: He, the bright Son, when born illumed his Parents who had sprung to life,  Great Son great Strengtheners of Law.

9.9.d: स सप्त धीतिभिर्हितो नद्यो अजिन्वदद्रुहः । या एकमक्षि वावृधुः ॥
9.9.e: Urged by the seven devotions he hath stirred the guileless rivers which  Have magnified the Single Eye.

9.9.d: ता अभि सन्तमस्तृतं महे युवानमा दधुः । इन्दुमिन्द्र तव व्रते ॥
9.9.e: These helped to might theYouthful One, high over all, invincible,  Even Indu, Indra! in thy law.

9.9.d: अभि वह्निरमर्त्यः सप्त पश्यति वावहिः । क्रिविर्देवीरतर्पयत् ॥
9.9.e: The immortal Courser, good to draw, looks down upon the Seven: the fount  Hath satisfied the Goddesses

9.9.d: अवा कल्पेषु नः पुमस्तमांसि सोम योध्या । तानि पुनान जङ्घनः ॥
9.9.e: Aid us in holy rites, O Man: O Pavamana, drive away  Dark shades that must be met in fight.

9.9.d: नू नव्यसे नवीयसे सूक्ताय साधया पथः । प्रत्नवद्रोचया रुचः ॥
9.9.e: Make the paths ready for a hymn newer and newer evermore:  Make the lights shine as erst they shone.

9.9.d: पवमान महि श्रवो गामश्वं रासि वीरवत् । सना मेधां सना स्वः ॥
9.9.e: Give, Pavamana, high renown, give kine and steeds and hero sons:  Win for us wisdom, win the light.

9.10.d: प्र स्वानासो रथा इवार्वन्तो न श्रवस्यवः । सोमासो राये अक्रमुः ॥
9.10.e: LIKE cars that thunder on their way, like coursers eager for renown,  Have Soma-drops flowed forth for wealth.

9.10.d: हिन्वानासो रथा इव दधन्विरे गभस्त्योः । भरासः कारिणामिव ॥
9.10.e: Forth have they rushed from holding hands, like chariots that are urged to speed,  Like joyful songs of singing-men.

9.10.d: राजानो न प्रशस्तिभिः सोमासो गोभिरञ्जते । यज्ञो न सप्त धातृभिः ॥
9.10.e: The Somas deck themselves with milk, as Kings are graced with eulogies,  And, with seven priests, the sacrifice.

9.10.d: परि सुवानास इन्दवो मदाय बर्हणा गिरा । सुता अर्षन्ति धारया ॥
9.10.e: Pressed for the gladdening draught, the drops flow forth abundantly with song,  The Soma juices in a stream.

9.10.d: आपानासो विवस्वतो जनन्त उषसो भगम् । सूरा अण्वं वि तन्वते ॥
9.10.e: Winning Vivasvān's glory and producing Morning's light, the Suns  Pass through the openings of the cloth.

9.10.d: अप द्वारा मतीनां प्रत्ना ऋण्वन्ति कारवः । वृष्णो हरस आयवः ॥
9.10.e: The singing-men of ancient time open the doors of sacred songs,—  Men, for the mighty to accept.

9.10.d: समीचीनास आसते होतारः सप्तजामयः । पदमेकस्य पिप्रतः ॥
9.10.e: Combined in close society sit the seven priests, the brother-hood,  Filling the station of the One.

9.10.d: नाभा नाभिं न आ ददे चक्षुश्चित्सूर्ये सचा । कवेरपत्यमा दुहे ॥
9.10.e: He gives us kinship with the Gods, and with the Sun unites our eye:  The Sage's ofrspring hath appeared.

9.10.d: अभि प्रिया दिवस्पदमध्वर्युभिर्गुहा हितम् । सूरः पश्यति चक्षसा ॥
9.10.e: The Sun with his dear eye beholds that quarter of the heavens which priests  Have placed within the sacred cell.

9.11.d: उपास्मै गायता नरः पवमानायेन्दवे । अभि देवाँ इयक्षते ॥
9.11.e: SING forth to Indu, O ye men, to him who is purified,  Fain to pay worship to the Gods.

9.11.d: अभि ते मधुना पयोऽथर्वाणो अशिश्रयुः । देवं देवाय देवयु ॥
9.11.e: Together with thy pleasant juice the Atharvans have commingled milk,  Divine, devoted to the God.

9.11.d: स नः पवस्व शं गवे शं जनाय शमर्वते । शं राजन्नोषधीभ्यः ॥
9.11.e: Bring, by thy flowing, weal to kine, weal to the people, weal to steeds.  Weal, O thou King, to growing plants

9.11.d: बभ्रवे नु स्वतवसेऽरुणाय दिविस्पृशे । सोमाय गाथमर्चत ॥
9.11.e: Sing a praise-song to Soma brown of hue, of independent might.  The Red, who reaches up to heaven.

9.11.d: हस्तच्युतेभिरद्रिभिः सुतं सोमं पुनीतन । मधावा धावता मधु ॥
9.11.e: Purify Soma when effused with stones which bands move rapidly,  And pour the sweet milk in the meath.

9.11.d: नमसेदुप सीदत दध्नेदभि श्रीणीतन । इन्दुमिन्द्रे दधातन ॥
9.11.e: With humble homage draw ye nigh; blend the libation with the curds:  To Indra offer Indu up.

9.11.d: अमित्रहा विचर्षणिः पवस्व सोम शं गवे । देवेभ्यो अनुकामकृत् ॥
9.11.e: Soma, foe-que chief o’er men, doing the will of pour forth  Prosperity upon our kine.

9.11.d: इन्द्राय सोम पातवे मदाय परि षिच्यसे । मनश्चिन्मनसस्पतिः ॥
9.11.e: Heart-knower, Sovran of the heart, thou art effused, O Soma, that Indra may drink thee and rejoice.

9.11.d: पवमान सुवीर्यं रयिं सोम रिरीहि नः । इन्दविन्द्रेण नो युजा ॥
9.11.e: O Soma Pavamana, give us riches and heroic strength,—  Indu! with. Indra for ally.

9.12.d: सोमा असृग्रमिन्दवः सुता ऋतस्य सादने । इन्द्राय मधुमत्तमाः ॥
9.12.e: To Indra have the Soma drops, exceeding rich in sweets, been poured,  Shed in the seat of sacrifice.

9.12.d: अभि विप्रा अनूषत गावो वत्सं न मातरः । इन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये ॥
9.12.e: As mother kine low to their calves, to Indra have the sages called,  Called him to drink the Soma juice.

9.12.d: मदच्युत्क्षेति सादने सिन्धोरूर्मा विपश्चित् । सोमो गौरी अधि श्रितः ॥
9.12.e: In the stream's wave wise Soma dwells, distilling rapture, in his seat,  Resting upon a wiId-cow's hide.

9.12.d: दिवो नाभा विचक्षणोऽव्यो वारे महीयते । सोमो यः सुक्रतुः कविः ॥
9.12.e: Far-sighted Soma, Sage and Seer, is worshipped in the central point  Of heaven, the straining-cloth of wool.

9.12.d: यः सोमः कलशेष्वाँ अन्तः पवित्र आहितः । तमिन्दुः परि षस्वजे ॥
9.12.e: In close embraces Indu holds Soma when  poured within the jars.  And on the. purifying sieve.

9.12.d: प्र वाचमिन्दुरिष्यति समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपि । जिन्वन्कोशं मधुश्चुतम् ॥
9.12.e: Indu sends forth a voice on high to regions of the sea of air,  Shaking the vase that drops with meath.

9.12.d: नित्यस्तोत्रो वनस्पतिर्धीनामन्तः सबर्दुघः । हिन्वानो मानुषा युगा ॥
9.12.e: The Tree whose praises never fail yields heavenly milk among our hymns,  Urging men's generations on.

9.12.d: अभि प्रिया दिवस्पदा सोमो हिन्वानो अर्षति । विप्रस्य धारया कविः ॥
9.12.e: The Wise One, with the Sage's stream, the Soma urged to speed, flows on  To the dear places of the sky.

9.12.d: आ पवमान धारय रयिं सहस्रवर्चसम् । अस्मे इन्दो स्वाभुवम् ॥
9.12.e: O Pavamana, bring us wealth bright with a thousand splendours. Yea.  O Indu, give us ready help.

9.13.d: सोमः पुनानो अर्षति सहस्रधारो अत्यविः । वायोरिन्द्रस्य निष्कृतम् ॥
9.13.e: PASSED through, the fleece in thousand streams the Soma, purified, flows on  To Indra's, Viyu's special place.

9.13.d: पवमानमवस्यवो विप्रमभि प्र गायत । सुष्वाणं देववीतये ॥
9.13.e: Sing forth, ye men who long for help, to Pavamana, to the Sage,  Effused to entertain the Gods.

9.13.d: पवन्ते वाजसातये सोमाः सहस्रपाजसः । गृणाना देववीतये ॥
9.13.e: The Soma-drops with thousand powers are purified for victory,  Hymned to become the feast of Gods.

9.13.d: उत नो वाजसातये पवस्व बृहतीरिषः । द्युमदिन्दो सुवीर्यम् ॥
9.13.e: Yea, as thou flowest bring great store of food that we may win the spoil  Indu, bring splendid manly might.

9.13.d: ते नः सहस्रिणं रयिं पवन्तामा सुवीर्यम् । सुवाना देवास इन्दवः ॥
9.13.e: May they in flowing give us wealth in thousands, and heroic power,—  These Godlike Soma-drops effused.

9.13.d: अत्या हियाना न हेतृभिरसृग्रं वाजसातये । वि वारमव्यमाशवः ॥
9.13.e: Like coursers by their drivers urged, they were poured forth, for victory,  Swift through the woollen straining-cloth.

9.13.d: वाश्रा अर्षन्तीन्दवोऽभि वत्सं न धेनवः । दधन्विरे गभस्त्योः ॥
9.13.e: Noisily flow the Soma-drops, like milch-kine lowing to their calves:  They have run forth from both the hands.

9.13.d: जुष्ट इन्द्राय मत्सरः पवमान कनिक्रदत् । विश्वा अप द्विषो जहि ॥
9.13.e: As Gladdener whom Indra loves, O Pavamana, with a roar  Drive all our enemies away.

9.13.d: अपघ्नन्तो अराव्णः पवमानाः स्वर्दृशः । योनावृतस्य सीदत ॥
9.13.e: O Pavamamas, driving off the godless, looking on the light,  Sit in the place of sacrifice.

9.14.d: परि प्रासिष्यदत्कविः सिन्धोरूर्मावधि श्रितः । कारं बिभ्रत्पुरुस्पृहम् ॥
9.14.e: REPOSING on the river's wave the Sage hath widely flowed around,  Bearing the hymn which many love.

9.14.d: गिरा यदी सबन्धवः पञ्च व्राता अपस्यवः । परिष्कृण्वन्ति धर्णसिम् ॥
9.14.e: When the Five kindred Companies, active in duty, with the song  Establish him, the Powerful,

9.14.d: आदस्य शुष्मिणो रसे विश्वे देवा अमत्सत । यदी गोभिर्वसायते ॥
9.14.e: Then in his juice whose strength is great, have all the Gods rejoiced themselves,  When he hath clothed him in the milk.

9.14.d: निरिणानो वि धावति जहच्छर्याणि तान्वा । अत्रा सं जिघ्नते युजा ॥
9.14.e: Freeing himself he flows away, leaving his body's severed limbs,  And meets his own Companion here.

9.14.d: नप्तीभिर्यो विवस्वतः शुभ्रो न मामृजे युवा । गाः कृण्वानो न निर्णिजम् ॥
9.14.e: He by the daughters of the priest, like a fair youth, hath been adorned,  Making the milk, as ’twere, his robe.

9.14.d: अति श्रिती तिरश्चता गव्या जिगात्यण्व्या । वग्नुमियर्ति यं विदे ॥
9.14.e: O'er the fine fingers, through desire of milk, in winding course he goes,  And utters voice which he hath found.

9.14.d: अभि क्षिपः समग्मत मर्जयन्तीरिषस्पतिम् । पृष्ठा गृभ्णत वाजिनः ॥
9.14.e: The nimble fingers have approached, adorning him the Lord of Strength:  They grasp the vigorous Courser's back.

9.14.d: परि दिव्यानि मर्मृशद्विश्वानि सोम पार्थिवा । वसूनि याह्यस्मयुः ॥
9.14.e: Comprising all the treasures that are in the heavens and on the earth,  Come, Soma, as our faithful Friend.

9.15.d: एष धिया यात्यण्व्या शूरो रथेभिराशुभिः । गच्छन्निन्द्रस्य निष्कृतम् ॥
9.15.e: THROUGH the fine fingers, with the song, this Hero comes with rapid ears,  Going to Indra's special place.

9.15.d: एष पुरू धियायते बृहते देवतातये । यत्रामृतास आसते ॥
9.15.e: In holy thought he ponders much for the great worship of the Gods.  Where the Immortals have their seat.

9.15.d: एष हितो वि नीयतेऽन्तः शुभ्रावता पथा । यदी तुञ्जन्ति भूर्णयः ॥
9.15.e: Like a good horse is he led out, when on the path that shines with light  The mettled steeds exert their strength.

9.15.d: एष शृङ्गाणि दोधुवच्छिशीते यूथ्यो३ वृषा । नृम्णा दधान ओजसा ॥
9.15.e: He brandishes his horns on high, and whets them Bull who leads the herd,  Doing with might heroic deeds.

9.15.d: एष रुक्मिभिरीयते वाजी शुभ्रेभिरंशुभिः । पतिः सिन्धूनां भवन् ॥
9.15.e: He moves, a vigorous Steed, adorned with beauteous rays of shining gold,  Becoming Sovran of the streams.

9.15.d: एष वसूनि पिब्दना परुषा ययिवाँ अति । अव शादेषु गच्छति ॥
9.15.e: He, over places rough to pass, bringing rich treasures closely packed.  Descends into the reservoirs.

9.15.d: एतं मृजन्ति मर्ज्यमुप द्रोणेष्वायवः । प्रचक्राणं महीरिषः ॥
9.15.e: Men beautify him in the vats, him worthy to be beautified,  Him who brings forth abundant food.

9.15.d: एतमु त्यं दश क्षिपो मृजन्ति सप्त धीतयः । स्वायुधं मदिन्तमम् ॥
9.15.e: Him, even him, the fingers ten and the seven songs make beautiful,  Well-weaponed, best of gladdeners.

9.16.d: प्र ते सोतार ओण्यो३ रसं मदाय घृष्वये । सर्गो न तक्त्येतशः ॥
9.16.e: THE pressers from the Soma-press send forth thy juice for rapturous joy  The speckled sap runs like a flood.

9.16.d: क्रत्वा दक्षस्य रथ्यमपो वसानमन्धसा । गोषामण्वेषु सश्चिम ॥
9.16.e: With strength we follow through the sieve him who brings might and wins the kine,  Enrobed in water with his juice.

9.16.d: अनप्तमप्सु दुष्टरं सोमं पवित्र आ सृज । पुनीहीन्द्राय पातवे ॥
9.16.e: Pour on the sieve the Soma, ne’er subdued in waters, waterless,  And make it pure for Indra's drink.

9.16.d: प्र पुनानस्य चेतसा सोमः पवित्रे अर्षति । क्रत्वा सधस्थमासदत् ॥
9.16.e: Moved by the purifier's thought, the Soma flows into the sieve:  By wisdom it hath gained its home.

9.16.d: प्र त्वा नमोभिरिन्दव इन्द्र सोमा असृक्षत । महे भराय कारिणः ॥
9.16.e: With humble homage, Indra, have the Soma-drops flowed forth to thee,  Contending for the glorious prize.

9.16.d: पुनानो रूपे अव्यये विश्वा अर्षन्नभि श्रियः । शूरो न गोषु तिष्ठति ॥
9.16.e: Purified in his fleecy garb, attaining every beauty, he  Stands, hero-like, amid the kine.

9.16.d: दिवो न सानु पिप्युषी धारा सुतस्य वेधसः । वृथा पवित्रे अर्षति ॥
9.16.e: Swelling, as ’twere, to heights of heaven, the stream of the creative juice  Falls lightly on the cleansing sieve.

9.16.d: त्वं सोम विपश्चितं तना पुनान आयुषु । अव्यो वारं वि धावसि ॥
9.16.e: Thus, Soma, purifying himwho knoweth song mid living men,  Thou wanderest through the cloth of wool.

9.17.d: प्र निम्नेनेव सिन्धवो घ्नन्तो वृत्राणि भूर्णयः । सोमा असृग्रमाशवः ॥
9.17.e: LIKE rivers down a steep descent, slaying the Vṛtras, full of zeal,  The rapid Soma-streams have flowed.

9.17.d: अभि सुवानास इन्दवो वृष्टयः पृथिवीमिव । इन्द्रं सोमासो अक्षरन् ॥
9.17.e: The drops of Soma juice effused fall like the rain upon the earth:  To Indra flow the Soma-streams.

9.17.d: अत्यूर्मिर्मत्सरो मदः सोमः पवित्रे अर्षति । विघ्नन्रक्षांसि देवयुः ॥
9.17.e: With swelling wave the gladdening drink, the Soma, flows intoṭhe sieve,  Loving the Gods and slaying fiends.

9.17.d: आ कलशेषु धावति पवित्रे परि षिच्यते । उक्थैर्यज्ञेषु वर्धते ॥
9.17.e: It hastens to the pitchers, poured upon the sieve it waxes strong  At sacrifices through the lauds.

9.17.d: अति त्री सोम रोचना रोहन्न भ्राजसे दिवम् । इष्णन्त्सूर्यं न चोदयः ॥
9.17.e: Soma, thou shinest mounting heaven as ’twere above light's triple realm,  And moving secm'st to speed the Sun.

9.17.d: अभि विप्रा अनूषत मूर्धन्यज्ञस्य कारवः । दधानाश्चक्षसि प्रियम् ॥
9.17.e: To him, the head of sacnfice, singers and bards have sung their songs,  Offering what he loves to see.

9.17.d: तमु त्वा वाजिनं नरो धीभिर्विप्रा अवस्यवः । मृजन्ति देवतातये ॥
9.17.e: The men, the sages with their hymns, eager for help, deck thee strong &teed,  Deck thee for service of the Gods.

9.17.d: मधोर्धारामनु क्षर तीव्रः सधस्थमासदः । चारुर्ऋताय पीतये ॥
9.17.e: Flow onward to the stream of meath rest efficacious in thy home,  Fair, to be drunk at sacrifice.

9.18.d: परि सुवानो गिरिष्ठाः पवित्रे सोमो अक्षाः । मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
9.18.e: THOU, Soma, dweller on the hills, effused, hast flowed into the sieve,:  All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

9.18.d: त्वं विप्रस्त्वं कविर्मधु प्र जातमन्धसः । मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
9.18.e: Thou art a sacred Bard, a Sage; the meath is offipring of thy sap:  All-bountcous art thou in carouse.

9.18.d: तव विश्वे सजोषसो देवासः पीतिमाशत । मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
9.18.e: All Deities of one accord have come that they may drink of thee:  All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

9.18.d: आ यो विश्वानि वार्या वसूनि हस्तयोर्दधे । मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
9.18.e: He who containeth in his hands all treasures much to be desired:  All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

9.18.d: य इमे रोदसी मही सं मातरेव दोहते । मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
9.18.e: Who milketh out this mighty Pair, the Earth and Heaven, like mother kine  All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

9.18.d: परि यो रोदसी उभे सद्यो वाजेभिरर्षति । मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
9.18.e: Who in a moment mightily floweth around these two world-halvcs:  All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

9.18.d: स शुष्मी कलशेष्वा पुनानो अचिक्रदत् । मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
9.18.e: The Strong One, being purified, hath in the pitchers cried aloud:  All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

9.19.d: यत्सोम चित्रमुक्थ्यं दिव्यं पार्थिवं वसु । तन्नः पुनान आ भर ॥
9.19.e: O SOMA, being purified bring us the wondrous treasure, meet  For lauds, that is in earth and heaven.

9.19.d: युवं हि स्थः स्वर्पती इन्द्रश्च सोम गोपती । ईशाना पिप्यतं धियः ॥
9.19.e: For ye Twain, Indra, Soma, are Lords of the light, Lords of the kine:  Great Rulers, prosper ye our songs.

9.19.d: वृषा पुनान आयुषु स्तनयन्नधि बर्हिषि । हरिः सन्योनिमासदत् ॥
9.19.e: The tawny Steer, while cleansed among the living, bellowing on the grass,  Hath sunk and settled in his home.

9.19.d: अवावशन्त धीतयो वृषभस्याधि रेतसि । सूनोर्वत्सस्य मातरः ॥
9.19.e: Over the Steer's productive flow the sacred songs were resonant,  The mothers of the darling Son.

9.19.d: कुविद्वृषण्यन्तीभ्यः पुनानो गर्भमादधत् । याः शुक्रं दुहते पयः ॥
9.19.e: Hath he not, purified, impregned the kine whb long to meet their Lord,  The kine who yield the shining milk?

9.19.d: उप शिक्षापतस्थुषो भियसमा धेहि शत्रुषु । पवमान विदा रयिम् ॥
9.19.e: Bring near us those who stand aloof strike fear into our enemies:  O Pavamana, find us wealth.

9.19.d: नि शत्रोः सोम वृष्ण्यं नि शुष्मं नि वयस्तिर । दूरे वा सतो अन्ति वा ॥
9.19.e: Soma, bring down the foeman's might, his vigorous strength and vital powe'r,  Whether he be afar or near.

9.20.d: प्र कविर्देववीतयेऽव्यो वारेभिरर्षति । साह्वान्विश्वा अभि स्पृधः ॥
9.20.e: FORTH through the straining-cloth the Sage flows to the banquet of the Gods,  Subduing all our enemies.

9.20.d: स हि ष्मा जरितृभ्य आ वाजं गोमन्तमिन्वति । पवमानः सहस्रिणम् ॥
9.20.e: For he, as Pavamana, sends thousandfold treasure in the shape  Of cattle to the singing-men.

9.20.d: परि विश्वानि चेतसा मृशसे पवसे मती । स नः सोम श्रवो विदः ॥
9.20.e: Thou graspest all things with thy mind, and purifiest thee with thoughts  As such, O Soma, find us fame.

9.20.d: अभ्यर्ष बृहद्यशो मघवद्भ्यो ध्रुवं रयिम् । इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
9.20.e: Pour lofty glory on us, send sure riches to our liberal lords,  Bring food to those who sing thy praise.

9.20.d: त्वं राजेव सुव्रतो गिरः सोमा विवेशिथ । पुनानो वह्ने अद्भुत ॥
9.20.e: As thou art cleansed, O Wondrous Steed, O Soma, thou hast entered, like  A pious King, into the songs.

9.20.d: स वह्निरप्सु दुष्टरो मृज्यमानो गभस्त्योः । सोमश्चमूषु सीदति ॥
9.20.e: He, Soma, like a courser in the floods invincible, made clean  With hands, is resting in the jars.

9.20.d: क्रीळुर्मखो न मंहयुः पवित्रं सोम गच्छसि । दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम् ॥
9.20.e: Disporting, like a liberal chief, thou goest, Soma, to the sieve,  Lending the laud a Hero's strength.

9.21.d: एते धावन्तीन्दवः सोमा इन्द्राय घृष्वयः । मत्सरासः स्वर्विदः ॥
9.21.e: To Indra flow these running drops, these Somas frolicsome in mood.  Exhilarating, finding light;

9.21.d: प्रवृण्वन्तो अभियुजः सुष्वये वरिवोविदः । स्वयं स्तोत्रे वयस्कृतः ॥
9.21.e: Driving off foes, bestowing room upon the presser, willingly  Bringing their praiser vitalforce.

9.21.d: वृथा क्रीळन्त इन्दवः सधस्थमभ्येकमित् । सिन्धोरूर्मा व्यक्षरन् ॥
9.21.e: Lightly disporting them, the drops flow to one common reservoir,  And fall into the river's wave.

9.21.d: एते विश्वानि वार्या पवमानास आशत । हिता न सप्तयो रथे ॥
9.21.e: These Pavamanas have obtained all blessings much to be desired,  Like coursers harnessed to a car.
With view to us, O Soma-drops, bestow his manifold desire  On him who yet hath given us naught.

9.21.d: ऋभुर्न रथ्यं नवं दधाता केतमादिशे । शुक्राः पवध्वमर्णसा ॥
9.21.e: Bring us our wish with this design, as a wright brings his new-wrought wheel:  Flow pure and shining with the stream.

9.21.d: एत उ त्ये अवीवशन्काष्ठां वाजिनो अक्रत । सतः प्रासाविषुर्मतिम् ॥
9.21.e: These drops have cried with resonant voice: like swift steeds they have run the course,  And roused the good man's hymn to life.

9.22.d: एते सोमास आशवो रथा इव प्र वाजिनः । सर्गाः सृष्टा अहेषत ॥
9.22.e: THESE rapid Soma-streams have stirred themselves to motion like strong steeds,  Like cars, like armies hurried forth.

9.22.d: एते वाता इवोरवः पर्जन्यस्येव वृष्टयः । अग्नेरिव भ्रमा वृथा ॥
9.22.e: Swift as wide winds they lightly move, like rain-storms of Parjanya, like  The flickering flames of burning fire.

9.22.d: एते पूता विपश्चितः सोमासो दध्याशिरः । विपा व्यानशुर्धियः ॥
9.22.e: These Soma juices, blent with curds, purified, skilled in sacred hymns,  Have gained by song their hearts'desire.

9.22.d: एते मृष्टा अमर्त्याः ससृवांसो न शश्रमुः । इयक्षन्तः पथो रजः ॥
9.22.e: Immortal, cleansed, these drops, since first they flowed, have never wearied, fain  To reach the regions and their paths.

9.22.d: एते पृष्ठानि रोदसोर्विप्रयन्तो व्यानशुः । उतेदमुत्तमं रजः ॥
9.22.e: Advancing they have travelled o’er the ridges of the earth and heaven,  And this the highest realm of all.
Over the heights have they attained the highest thread that is spun out,  And this which must be deemed most high.

9.22.d: त्वं सोम पणिभ्य आ वसु गव्यानि धारयः । ततं तन्तुमचिक्रदः ॥
9.22.e: Thou, Soma, boldest wealth in kine which thou hast seized from niggard churls:  Thou calledst forth the outspun thread.

9.23.d: सोमा असृग्रमाशवो मधोर्मदस्य धारया । अभि विश्वानि काव्या ॥
9.23.e: SWIFT Soma drops have been effused in streams of meath, the gladdening drink,  For sacred lore of every kind.

9.23.d: अनु प्रत्नास आयवः पदं नवीयो अक्रमुः । रुचे जनन्त सूर्यम् ॥
9.23.e: Hither to newer. resting-place the ancient Living Ones are come.  They made the Sun that he might shine.

9.23.d: आ पवमान नो भरार्यो अदाशुषो गयम् । कृधि प्रजावतीरिषः ॥
9.23.e: O Pavamana, bring to us the unsacrificing foeman's wealth,  And give us food with progeny.

9.23.d: अभि सोमास आयवः पवन्ते मद्यं मदम् । अभि कोशं मधुश्चुतम् ॥
9.23.e: The living Somas being cleansed diffuse exhilarating drink,  Turned to the vat which drips with meath.

9.23.d: सोमो अर्षति धर्णसिर्दधान इन्द्रियं रसम् । सुवीरो अभिशस्तिपाः ॥
9.23.e: Soma gows on intelligent, possessing sap and mighty strength,  Brave Hero who repels the curse.

9.23.d: इन्द्राय सोम पवसे देवेभ्यः सधमाद्यः । इन्दो वाजं सिषाससि ॥
9.23.e: For Indra, Soma! thou art cleansed, a feast-companion for the Gods:  1ndu, thou fain wilt win us strength

9.23.d: अस्य पीत्वा मदानामिन्द्रो वृत्राण्यप्रति । जघान जघनच्च नु ॥
9.23.e: When he had drunken draughts of this, Indra smote down resistless foes:  Yea, smote them, and shall smite them still.

9.24.d: प्र सोमासो अधन्विषुः पवमानास इन्दवः । श्रीणाना अप्सु मृञ्जत ॥
9.24.e: HITHERWARD have the Soma streamed,  the drops while they are purified:  When bIent, in waters they are rinsed.

9.24.d: अभि गावो अधन्विषुरापो न प्रवता यतीः । पुनाना इन्द्रमाशत ॥
9.24.e: The milk hath run to meet them like floods rushing down a precipice:  They come to Indra, being cleansed.

9.24.d: प्र पवमान धन्वसि सोमेन्द्राय पातवे । नृभिर्यतो वि नीयसे ॥
9.24.e: O Soma Pavamana, thou art flowing to be Indra's drink:  The men have seized and lead thee forth.

9.24.d: त्वं सोम नृमादनः पवस्व चर्षणीसहे । सस्निर्यो अनुमाद्यः ॥
9.24.e: Victorious, to be hailed with joy, O Soma, flow, delighting men,  To him who ruleth o’er mankind.

9.24.d: इन्दो यदद्रिभिः सुतः पवित्रं परिधावसि । अरमिन्द्रस्य धाम्ने ॥
9.24.e: Thou, Indu, when, effused by stones, thou runnest to the filter, art,  Ready for Indra's high decree.
Flow on, best Vṛtra-slayer; flow meet to be hailed with joyful lauds.  Pure, purifying, wonderful.

9.24.d: शुचिः पावक उच्यते सोमः सुतस्य मध्वः । देवावीरघशंसहा ॥
9.24.e: Pure, purifying is he called the Soma of the meath eflused,  Slayer of sinners, dear to Gods.

9.25.d: पवस्व दक्षसाधनो देवेभ्यः पीतये हरे । मरुद्भ्यो वायवे मदः ॥
9.25.e: GREEN-HUED! as one who giveth strength flow on for Gods to drink, a draught  For Vāyu and the Marut host.

9.25.d: पवमान धिया हितो३ऽभि योनिं कनिक्रदत् । धर्मणा वायुमा विश ॥
9.25.e: O Pavamana, sent by song, roaring about thy dwelling-place,  Pass into Vāyu as Law bids.

9.25.d: सं देवैः शोभते वृषा कविर्योनावधि प्रियः । वृत्रहा देववीतमः ॥
9.25.e: The Steer shines with the Deities, dear Sage in his appointed home,  Foe-Slayer, most beloved by Gods.

9.25.d: विश्वा रूपाण्याविशन्पुनानो याति हर्यतः । यत्रामृतास आसते ॥
9.25.e: Taking each beauteous form, he goes, desirable, while purified,  Thither where- the Immortals sit.

9.25.d: अरुषो जनयन्गिरः सोमः पवत आयुषक् । इन्द्रं गच्छन्कविक्रतुः ॥
9.25.e: To Indra Soma flows, the Red, engendering song, exceeding wise,  The visitor of living men.

9.25.d: आ पवस्व मदिन्तम पवित्रं धारया कवे । अर्कस्य योनिमासदम् ॥
9.25.e: Flow, best exhilarator, Sage, flow to the filter in a stream  To seat thee in the place of song.

9.26.d: तममृक्षन्त वाजिनमुपस्थे अदितेरधि । विप्रासो अण्व्या धिया ॥
9.26.e: THE sages with the fingers' art have dressed and decked that vigorous Steed  Upon the lap of Aditi,

9.26.d: तं गावो अभ्यनूषत सहस्रधारमक्षितम् । इन्दुं धर्तारमा दिवः ॥
9.26.e: The kine have called aloud to him exhaustless with a thousand streams,  To Indu who supporteth heaven.

9.26.d: तं वेधां मेधयाह्यन्पवमानमधि द्यवि । धर्णसिं भूरिधायसम् ॥
9.26.e: Him, nourisher of many, Sage, creative Pavamana, they  Have sent, by wisdom, to the sky.

9.26.d: तमह्यन्भुरिजोर्धिया संवसानं विवस्वतः । पतिं वाचो अदाभ्यम् ॥
9.26.e: Him, dweller with Vivasvān, they with use of both arms have sent forth,  The Lord of Speech infallible.

9.26.d: तं सानावधि जामयो हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । हर्यतं भूरिचक्षसम् ॥
9.26.e: Him, green, beloved, many eyed, the Sisters with prosing stones  Send down to ridges of the sieve.

9.26.d: तं त्वा हिन्वन्ति वेधसः पवमान गिरावृधम् । इन्दविन्द्राय मत्सरम् ॥
9.26.e: O Pavamana, Indu, priests hurry thee on to Indra, thee  Who aidest song and cheerest him.

9.27.d: एष कविरभिष्टुतः पवित्रे अधि तोशते । पुनानो घ्नन्नप स्रिधः ॥
9.27.e: THIS Sage, exalted by our lauds, flows to the purifying cloth,  Scattering foes as he is cleansed.

9.27.d: एष इन्द्राय वायवे स्वर्जित्परि षिच्यते । पवित्रे दक्षसाधनः ॥
9.27.e: As giving power and winning light, for Indra and for Vāyu he  Is poured upon the filtering-cloth.

9.27.d: एष नृभिर्वि नीयते दिवो मूर्धा वृषा सुतः । सोमो वनेषु विश्ववित् ॥
9.27.e: The men conduct him, Soma, Steer, Omniscient, and the Head of Heaven,  Effused into the vats of wood.
Longing for kine, longing for gold hath Indu Pavamana lowed,  Still Conqueror, never overcome.

9.27.d: एष सूर्येण हासते पवमानो अधि द्यवि । पवित्रे मत्सरो मदः ॥
9.27.e: This Pavamana, gladdening draught, drops on the filtering cloth, and then  Mounts up with Sūrya to the sky.

9.27.d: एष शुष्म्यसिष्यददन्तरिक्षे वृषा हरिः । पुनान इन्दुरिन्द्रमा ॥
9.27.e: To Indra in the firmament this mighty tawny Steer hath flowed,  This Indu, being purified.

9.28.d: एष वाजी हितो नृभिर्विश्वविन्मनसस्पतिः । अव्यो वारं वि धावति ॥
9.28.e: URGED by the men, this vigorous Steed, Lord of the mind, Omniscient,  Runs to the woollen straining-cloth.

9.28.d: एष पवित्रे अक्षरत्सोमो देवेभ्यः सुतः । विश्वा धामान्याविशन् ॥
9.28.e: Within the filter hath he flowed, this Soma for the Gods effused,  Entering all their essences.

9.28.d: एष देवः शुभायतेऽधि योनावमर्त्यः । वृत्रहा देववीतमः ॥
9.28.e: He shines in beauty there, this God Immortal in his dwelling-place,  Foe-slayer, dearest to the Gods.

9.28.d: एष वृषा कनिक्रदद्दशभिर्जामिभिर्यतः । अभि द्रोणानि धावति ॥
9.28.e: Directed by the Sisters ten, bellowing on his way this Steer  Runs onward to the wooden vats.

9.28.d: एष सूर्यमरोचयत्पवमानो विचर्षणिः । विश्वा धामानि विश्ववित् ॥
9.28.e: This Pavamana, swiftand strong, Omniscient, gave spleudour to  The Sun and all his forms of light.

9.28.d: एष शुष्म्यदाभ्यः सोमः पुनानो अर्षति । देवावीरघशंसहा ॥
9.28.e: This Soma being purified, flows mighty and infallible,  Slayer of sinners, dear toGods.

9.29.d: प्रास्य धारा अक्षरन्वृष्णः सुतस्यौजसा । देवाँ अनु प्रभूषतः ॥
9.29.e: FORWARD with mighty force have flowed the currents of this Steer effused,  Of him who sets him by the Gods.

9.29.d: सप्तिं मृजन्ति वेधसो गृणन्तः कारवो गिरा । ज्योतिर्जज्ञानमुक्थ्यम् ॥
9.29.e: The singers praise him with their song, and learned priests adorn the Steed,  Brought forth as light that merits laud.

9.29.d: सुषहा सोम तानि ते पुनानाय प्रभूवसो । वर्धा समुद्रमुक्थ्यम् ॥
9.29.e: These things thou winnest lightly while purified, Soma, Lord of wealth:  Fill full the sea that claims our praise.

9.29.d: विश्वा वसूनि संजयन्पवस्व सोम धारया । इनु द्वेषांसि सध्र्यक् ॥
9.29.e: Winning all precious things at once, flow on, O Soma, with thy stream  Drive to one place our enemies.

9.29.d: रक्षा सु नो अररुषः स्वनात्समस्य कस्य चित् । निदो यत्र मुमुच्महे ॥
9.29.e: Preserve us from the godless, from ill-omened voice of one and all,  That so we may be freed from blame.

9.29.d: एन्दो पार्थिवं रयिं दिव्यं पवस्व धारया । द्युमन्तं शुष्ममा भर ॥
9.29.e: O Indu, as thou flowest on bring us the wealth of earth and heaven,  And splendid vigour, in thy stream.

9.30.d: प्र धारा अस्य शुष्मिणो वृथा पवित्रे अक्षरन् । पुनानो वाचमिष्यति ॥
9.30.e: STREAMS of this Potent One have flowed easily to the straining-cloth:  While he is cleansed he lifts his voice.
Indu, by pressers urged to speed, bellowing out while beautified.  Sends forth a very mighty sound.

9.30.d: आ नः शुष्मं नृषाह्यं वीरवन्तं पुरुस्पृहम् । पवस्व सोम धारया ॥
9.30.e: Pour on us, Soma, with thy stream manconquering might which many crave,  Accompanied with hero sons.

9.30.d: प्र सोमो अति धारया पवमानो असिष्यदत् । अभि द्रोणान्यासदम् ॥
9.30.e: Hither hath Pavamana flowed, Soma flowed hither in a stream,  To settle in the vats of wood.

9.30.d: अप्सु त्वा मधुमत्तमं हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । इन्दविन्द्राय पीतये ॥
9.30.e: To waters with the stones they drive thee tawny-hued, most rich in sweets,  O Indu, to be Indra's drink.

9.30.d: सुनोता मधुमत्तमं सोममिन्द्राय वज्रिणे । चारुं शर्धाय मत्सरम् ॥
9.30.e: For Indra, for the Thunderer press the Soma very rich in sweets,  Lovely, inspiriting, for strength.

9.31.d: प्र सोमासः स्वाध्य१ः पवमानासो अक्रमुः । रयिं कृण्वन्ति चेतनम् ॥
9.31.e: THE, Soma-drops, benevolent, come forth as they are purified,  Bestowing wealth which all may see.

9.31.d: दिवस्पृथिव्या अधि भवेन्दो द्युम्नवर्धनः । भवा वाजानां पतिः ॥
9.31.e: O Indu, high o’er heaven and earth be thou, increaser of our might:  The Master of all strength be thou.

9.31.d: तुभ्यं वाता अभिप्रियस्तुभ्यमर्षन्ति सिन्धवः । सोम वर्धन्ति ते महः ॥
9.31.e: The winds are gracious in their love to thee, the rivers flow to thee  Soma, they multiply thy power.

9.31.d: आ प्यायस्व समेतु ते विश्वतः सोम वृष्ण्यम् । भवा वाजस्य संगथे ॥
9.31.e: Soma, wax great. From every side may vigorous powers unite in thee:  Be in the gathering-Place of strength.

9.31.d: तुभ्यं गावो घृतं पयो बभ्रो दुदुह्रे अक्षितम् । वर्षिष्ठे अधि सानवि ॥
9.31.e: For thee, brown-hued! the kine have poured imperishable oil and milk.  Aloft on the sublimest height.

9.31.d: स्वायुधस्य ते सतो भुवनस्य पते वयम् । इन्दो सखित्वमुश्मसि ॥
9.31.e: Friendship, O Indu, we desire with thee who bearest noble arms,  With thee, O Lord of all that is.

9.32.d: प्र सोमासो मदच्युतः श्रवसे नो मघोनः । सुता विदथे अक्रमुः ॥
9.32.e: THE rapture-shedding Soma-drops, effused in our assembly, have  Flowed forth to glorify our prince.

9.32.d: आदीं त्रितस्य योषणो हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये ॥
9.32.e: Then Trita's Maidens onward urge the Tawny-coloured with the stones,  Indu for Indra, for his drink.

9.32.d: आदीं हंसो यथा गणं विश्वस्यावीवशन्मतिम् । अत्यो न गोभिरज्यते ॥
9.32.e: Now like a swan he maketh all the company sing each his hymn:  He, like a steed, is bathed in milk.

9.32.d: उभे सोमावचाकशन्मृगो न तक्तो अर्षसि । सीदन्नृतस्य योनिमा ॥
9.32.e: O Soma, viewing heaven and earth, thou runncst like a darting deer  Set in the place of sacrifice.

9.32.d: अभि गावो अनूषत योषा जारमिव प्रियम् । अगन्नाजिं यथा हितम् ॥
9.32.e: The cows have sung with joy to him, even as a woman to her love  He came as to a settled race.

9.32.d: अस्मे धेहि द्युमद्यशो मघवद्भ्यश्च मह्यं च । सनिं मेधामुत श्रवः ॥
9.32.e: Bestow illustrious fame on us, both on our liberal lords and me,  Glory, intelligence, and wealth.

9.33.d: प्र सोमासो विपश्चितोऽपां न यन्त्यूर्मयः । वनानि महिषा इव ॥
9.33.e: LIKE waves of waters, skilled in song the juices of the Soma speed  Onward, as buffaloes to woods.

9.33.d: अभि द्रोणानि बभ्रवः शुक्रा ऋतस्य धारया । वाजं गोमन्तमक्षरन् ॥
9.33.e: With stream of sacrifice the brown bright drops have flowed with strength in store  Of kine into the wooden vats.

9.33.d: सुता इन्द्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः । सोमा अर्षन्ति विष्णवे ॥
9.33.e: To Indra, Vāyu, Varuṇa, to Viṣṇu, and the Maruts, flow  The drops of Soma juice effused.

9.33.d: तिस्रो वाच उदीरते गावो मिमन्ति धेनवः । हरिरेति कनिक्रदत् ॥
9.33.e: Three several words are uttered: kine are ]owing, cows who give their milk:  The Tawny-hued goes bellowing on.

9.33.d: अभि ब्रह्मीरनूषत यह्वीर्ऋतस्य मातरः । मर्मृज्यन्ते दिवः शिशुम् ॥
9.33.e: The young and sacred mothers of the holy rite have uttered praise:  They decorate the Child of Heaven.

9.33.d: रायः समुद्राँश्चतुरोऽस्मभ्यं सोम विश्वतः । आ पवस्व सहस्रिणः ॥
9.33.e: From every side, O Soma, for our profit, pour thou forth four seas  Filled full of riches thousandfold.

9.34.d: प्र सुवानो धारया तनेन्दुर्हिन्वानो अर्षति । रुजद्दृळ्हा व्योजसा ॥
9.34.e: THE drop of Soma juice effused flows onward with this stream impelled.  Rending strong places with its might.

9.34.d: सुत इन्द्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः । सोमो अर्षति विष्णवे ॥
9.34.e: Poured forth to Indra, Varuṇa, to Vāyu and the Marut hosts,  To Viṣṇu, flows the Soma juice.

9.34.d: वृषाणं वृषभिर्यतं सुन्वन्ति सोममद्रिभिः । दुहन्ति शक्मना पयः ॥
9.34.e: With stones they press the Soma forth, the Strong conducted by the strong:  They milk the liquor out with skill.

9.34.d: भुवत्त्रितस्य मर्ज्यो भुवदिन्द्राय मत्सरः । सं रूपैरज्यते हरिः ॥
9.34.e: ’Tis he whom Trita must refine, ’tis he who shall make Indra glad:  The Tawny One is decked with tints.

9.34.d: अभीमृतस्य विष्टपं दुहते पृश्निमातरः । चारु प्रियतमं हविः ॥
9.34.e: Him do the Sons of Pṛśni milk, the dwelling-place of sacrifice,  Oblation lovely and most dear.

9.34.d: समेनमह्रुता इमा गिरो अर्षन्ति सस्रुतः । धेनूर्वाश्रो अवीवशत् ॥
9.34.e: To him in one unitcd stream th-,se songs flow on straight forward. he,  Loud voiced, hath made the milch-kine low.

9.35.d: आ नः पवस्व धारया पवमान रयिं पृथुम् । यया ज्योतिर्विदासि नः ॥
9.35.e: Pour forth on us abundant wealth, O Pavamana, with thy stream.  Wherewith thou mayest find us light

9.35.d: इन्दो समुद्रमीङ्खय पवस्व विश्वमेजय । रायो धर्ता न ओजसा ॥
9.35.e: O Indu, swayer of the sea, shaker of all things, flow thou on,  Bearer of wealth to us with might.

9.35.d: त्वया वीरेण वीरवोऽभि ष्याम पृतन्यतः । क्षरा णो अभि वार्यम् ॥
9.35.e: With thee for Hero, Valiant One! may we subdue our enemies:  Let what is precious flow to us.

9.35.d: प्र वाजमिन्दुरिष्यति सिषासन्वाजसा ऋषिः । व्रता विदान आयुधा ॥
9.35.e: Indu arouses strength the Sage who strives for victory, winning power,  Discovering holy works and means.

9.35.d: तं गीर्भिर्वाचमीङ्खयं पुनानं वासयामसि । सोमं जनस्य गोपतिम् ॥
9.35.e: Mover of speech, we robe him with our songs as he is purified  Soma, the Guardian of the folk;

9.35.d: विश्वो यस्य व्रते जनो दाधार धर्मणस्पतेः । पुनानस्य प्रभूवसोः ॥
9.35.e: On whose way, Lord of Holy Law, most richi as he is purified.  The people all have set their hearts.

9.36.d: असर्जि रथ्यो यथा पवित्रे चम्वोः सुतः । कार्ष्मन्वाजी न्यक्रमीत् ॥
9.36.e: FORTH from the mortar is the juice sent, like a car-horse, to the sieve:  The Steed steps forward to the goal.

9.36.d: स वह्निः सोम जागृविः पवस्व देववीरति । अभि कोशं मधुश्चुतम् ॥
9.36.e: Thus, Soma, watchful, bearing well, cheering the Gods, flow past the sieve,  Turned to the vat that drops with meath.

9.36.d: स नो ज्योतींषि पूर्व्य पवमान वि रोचय । क्रत्वे दक्षाय नो हिनु ॥
9.36.e: Excellent Pavamana, make the lights shine brightly out for us.  Speed us to mental power and skill.

9.36.d: शुम्भमान ऋतायुभिर्मृज्यमानो गभस्त्योः । पवते वारे अव्यये ॥
9.36.e: He, beautified by pious men, and coming from their hands adorned,  Flows through the fleecy straining-cloth.

9.36.d: स विश्वा दाशुषे वसु सोमो दिव्यानि पार्थिवा । पवतामान्तरिक्ष्या ॥
9.36.e: May Soma pour all treasures of the heavens, the earth, the firmament  Upon the liberal worshipper.

9.36.d: आ दिवस्पृष्ठमश्वयुर्गव्ययुः सोम रोहसि । वीरयुः शवसस्पते ॥
9.36.e: Thou mountest to the height of heaven, O Soma, seeking steeds and kine,  And seeking heroes, Lord of Strength!

9.37.d: स सुतः पीतये वृषा सोमः पवित्रे अर्षति । विघ्नन्रक्षांसि देवयुः ॥
9.37.e: SOMA, the Steer, effused for draught, flows to the purifying sieve,  Slaying the fiends, loving the Gods.

9.37.d: स पवित्रे विचक्षणो हरिरर्षति धर्णसिः । अभि योनिं कनिक्रदत् ॥
9.37.e: Far-sighted, tawny-coloured, he flows to the sieve, intelligent,  Bellowing, to his place of rest.

9.37.d: स वाजी रोचना दिवः पवमानो वि धावति । रक्षोहा वारमव्ययम् ॥
9.37.e: This vigorous Pavamana runs forth to the luminous realm of heaven,  Fiend-slayer, through the fleecy sieve.

9.37.d: स त्रितस्याधि सानवि पवमानो अरोचयत् । जामिभिः सूर्यं सह ॥
9.37.e: This Payamana up above Trita's high ridge hath made the Sun,  Together with the Sisters, shine.

9.37.d: स वृत्रहा वृषा सुतो वरिवोविददाभ्यः । सोमो वाजमिवासरत् ॥
9.37.e: This Vṛtra-slaying Steer, effused, Soma room-giver, ne’er deceived,  Hath gone, as ’twere, to win the spoil.

9.37.d: स देवः कविनेषितो३ऽभि द्रोणानि धावति । इन्दुरिन्द्राय मंहना ॥
9.37.e: Urged onward by the sage, the God speeds forward to the casks of wood,  Indu to Indra willingly.

9.38.d: एष उ स्य वृषा रथोऽव्यो वारेभिरर्षति । गच्छन्वाजं सहस्रिणम् ॥
9.38.e: THIS Steer, this Chariot, rushes through the woollen filter, as he goes  To war that wins a thousand spoils.

9.38.d: एतं त्रितस्य योषणो हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये ॥
9.38.e: The Dames of Trita with the stones onward impel this Tawny One  Indu to Indra for his drink.

9.38.d: एतं त्यं हरितो दश मर्मृज्यन्ते अपस्युवः । याभिर्मदाय शुम्भते ॥
9.38.e: Ten active fingers carefully adorn him here; they make him bright  And beauteous for the gladdening draught.

9.38.d: एष स्य मानुषीष्वा श्येनो न विक्षु सीदति । गच्छञ्जारो न योषितम् ॥
9.38.e: He like a falcon settles down amid the families of men.  Speeding like lover to his love.

9.38.d: एष स्य मद्यो रसोऽव चष्टे दिवः शिशुः । य इन्दुर्वारमाविशत् ॥
9.38.e: This young exhilarating juice looks downward from its place in heaven,  This Soma-drop that pierced the sieve.

9.38.d: एष स्य पीतये सुतो हरिरर्षति धर्णसिः । क्रन्दन्योनिमभि प्रियम् ॥
9.38.e: Poured for the draught, this tawny juice  flows forth, intelligent, crying out,  Unto the well-beloved place.

9.39.d: आशुरर्ष बृहन्मते परि प्रियेण धाम्ना । यत्र देवा इति ब्रवन् ॥
9.39.e: FLOW On, O thou of lofty thought, flow swift in thy beloved form,  Saying, I go where dwell the Gods.

9.39.d: परिष्कृण्वन्ननिष्कृतं जनाय यातयन्निषः । वृष्टिं दिवः परि स्रव ॥
9.39.e: Preparing what is unprepared, and bringing store of food to man,  Make thou the rain descend from heaven.

9.39.d: सुत एति पवित्र आ त्विषिं दधान ओजसा । विचक्षाणो विरोचयन् ॥
9.39.e: With might, bestowing power, thejuice enters the purifying sieve,  Far-seeing, sending forth its light.

9.39.d: अयं स यो दिवस्परि रघुयामा पवित्र आ । सिन्धोरूर्मा व्यक्षरत् ॥
9.39.e: This is it which in rapid course hath with the river's wave flowed down  From heaven upon the straining cloth.

9.39.d: आविवासन्परावतो अथो अर्वावतः सुतः । इन्द्राय सिच्यते मधु ॥
9.39.e: Inviting him frorh far away, and even from near at hand, the juice  For Indra is poured forth as meath.

9.39.d: समीचीना अनूषत हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । योनावृतस्य सीदत ॥
9.39.e: In union they have sung the hymn: with stones they urge the Tawny One.  Sit in the place of sacrifice.

9.40.d: पुनानो अक्रमीदभि विश्वा मृधो विचर्षणिः । शुम्भन्ति विप्रं धीतिभिः ॥
9.40.e: THE Very Active hath assailed, while purified, all enemies:  They deck the Sage with holy songs.

9.40.d: आ योनिमरुणो रुहद्गमदिन्द्रं वृषा सुतः । ध्रुवे सदसि सीदति ॥
9.40.e: The Red hath mounted to his place; to India, goes the mighty juice:  He settles in his firm abode.

9.40.d: नू नो रयिं महामिन्दोऽस्मभ्यं सोम विश्वतः । आ पवस्व सहस्रिणम् ॥
9.40.e: O Indu, Soma, send us now great opulence from every side, Pour on us treasures thousandfold.

9.40.d: विश्वा सोम पवमान द्युम्नानीन्दवा भर । विदाः सहस्रिणीरिषः ॥
9.40.e: O Soma Pavamana, bring, Indu, all splcndours hitherward:  Find for us food in boundless store.

9.40.d: स नः पुनान आ भर रयिं स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम् । जरितुर्वर्धया गिरः ॥
9.40.e: As thou art cleansed, bring hero strength and riches to thy worshipper,  And prosper thou the singer's hymns.

9.40.d: पुनान इन्दवा भर सोम द्विबर्हसं रयिम् । वृषन्निन्दो न उक्थ्यम् ॥
9.40.e: O Indu, Soma, being cleansed, bring hither riches doublypiled,  Wealth, mighty Indu, meet for lauds.

9.41.d: प्र ये गावो न भूर्णयस्त्वेषा अयासो अक्रमुः । घ्नन्तः कृष्णामप त्वचम् ॥
9.41.e: ACTIVE and bright have they come forth, impetuous in speed like bulls,  Driving the black skin far away.

9.41.d: सुवितस्य मनामहेऽति सेतुं दुराव्यम् । साह्वांसो दस्युमव्रतम् ॥
9.41.e: Quelling the riteless Dasyu, may we think upon the bridge of bliss,  Leaving the bridge of woe behind.

9.41.d: शृण्वे वृष्टेरिव स्वनः पवमानस्य शुष्मिणः । चरन्ति विद्युतो दिवि ॥
9.41.e: The mighty Pavamana's roar is heard as ’twere the rush of rain  Lightnings are flashing to the sky.

9.41.d: आ पवस्व महीमिषं गोमदिन्दो हिरण्यवत् । अश्वावद्वाजवत्सुतः ॥
9.41.e: Pour out on us abundant food, when thou art pressed, O Indu wealth  In kine and gold and steeds and spoil.

9.41.d: स पवस्व विचर्षण आ मही रोदसी पृण । उषाः सूर्यो न रश्मिभिः ॥
9.41.e: Flow on thy way, Most Active, thou. fill full the mighty heavens and earth,  As Dawn, as Sūrya with his beams.

9.41.d: परि णः शर्मयन्त्या धारया सोम विश्वतः । सरा रसेव विष्टपम् ॥
9.41.e: On every side, O Soma, flow round us with thy protecting stream,  As Rasā flows around the world.

9.42.d: जनयन्रोचना दिवो जनयन्नप्सु सूर्यम् । वसानो गा अपो हरिः ॥
9.42.e: ENGENDERING the Sun in floods, engendering heaven's lights, green-hued,  Robed in the waters and the milk,

9.42.d: एष प्रत्नेन मन्मना देवो देवेभ्यस्परि । धारया पवते सुतः ॥
9.42.e: According to primeval plan this Soma, with his stream, effused  Flows purely on, a God for Gods.

9.42.d: वावृधानाय तूर्वये पवन्ते वाजसातये । सोमाः सहस्रपाजसः ॥
9.42.e: For him victorious, waxen great, the juices with a thousand powers  Are purified for winning spoil.

9.42.d: दुहानः प्रत्नमित्पयः पवित्रे परि षिच्यते । क्रन्दन्देवाँ अजीजनत् ॥
9.42.e: Shedding the ancient fluid he is poured into the cleansing sieve:  He, thundering, hath produced the Gods.

9.42.d: अभि विश्वानि वार्याभि देवाँ ऋतावृधः । सोमः पुनानो अर्षति ॥
9.42.e: Soma, while purifying, sends hither all things to be desired,  He sends the Gods who strengthen Law.
Soma, effused, pour on us wealth in kine, in heroes, steeds, and spoil,  Send us abundant store of food.

9.43.d: यो अत्य इव मृज्यते गोभिर्मदाय हर्यतः । तं गीर्भिर्वासयामसि ॥
9.43.e: WE will enrobe with sacred song the Lovely One who, as a Steed,  Is decked with milk for rapturous joy.

9.43.d: तं नो विश्वा अवस्युवो गिरः शुम्भन्ति पूर्वथा । इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये ॥
9.43.e: All songs of ours desiring grace adorn him in the ancient way,  Indu for Indra, for his drink.

9.43.d: पुनानो याति हर्यतः सोमो गीर्भिः परिष्कृतः । विप्रस्य मेध्यातिथेः ॥
9.43.e: Soma flows on when purified, beloved and adorned with songs,  Songs of the sage Medhyātithi.

9.43.d: पवमान विदा रयिमस्मभ्यं सोम सुश्रियम् । इन्दो सहस्रवर्चसम् ॥
9.43.e: O Soma Pavamana, find exceeding glorious wealth for us,  Wealth, Indu, fraught with boundless might.

9.43.d: इन्दुरत्यो न वाजसृत्कनिक्रन्ति पवित्र आ । यदक्षारति देवयुः ॥
9.43.e: Like courser racing to the prize Indu, the lover of the Gods,  Roars, as he passes, in the sieve.

9.43.d: पवस्व वाजसातये विप्रस्य गृणतो वृधे । सोम रास्व सुवीर्यम् ॥
9.43.e: Flow on thy way to win us strength, to speed the sage who praises thee:  Soma, bestow heroic power.

9.44.d: प्र ण इन्दो महे तन ऊर्मिं न बिभ्रदर्षसि । अभि देवाँ अयास्यः ॥
9.44.e: INDU, to us for this great rite, bearing as ’twere thy wave to Gods,  Unwearied, thou art flowing forQh.

9.44.d: मती जुष्टो धिया हितः सोमो हिन्वे परावति । विप्रस्य धारया कविः ॥
9.44.e: Pleased with the hymn, impelled by prayer, Soma is hurried far away,  The Wise One in the Singer's stream.,

9.44.d: अयं देवेषु जागृविः सुत एति पवित्र आ । सोमो याति विचर्षणिः ॥
9.44.e: Watchful among the. gods, this juice advances to the cleansing sieve  Soma, most active, travels on.

9.44.d: स नः पवस्व वाजयुश्चक्राणश्चारुमध्वरम् । बर्हिष्माँ आ विवासति ॥
9.44.e: Flow onward, seeking strength for us, embellishing the sacrifice:  The priest with trimmed grass calleth thee.

9.44.d: स नो भगाय वायवे विप्रवीरः सदावृधः । सोमो देवेष्वा यमत् ॥
9.44.e: May Soma, ever bringing power to Bhaga and to Vāyu, Sage  And Hero, lead us to the Gods.

9.44.d: स नो अद्य वसुत्तये क्रतुविद्गातुवित्तमः । वाजं जेषि श्रवो बृहत् ॥
9.44.e: So, to increase our wealth to-day, Inspirer, best of Furtherers,  Win for us strength and high renown.

9.45.d: स पवस्व मदाय कं नृचक्षा देववीतये । इन्दविन्द्राय पीतये ॥
9.45.e: FLOW, thou who viewest men, to give delight, to entertain the Gods,  Indu, to Indra for his drink.

9.45.d: स नो अर्षाभि दूत्यं१ त्वमिन्द्राय तोशसे । देवान्त्सखिभ्य आ वरम् ॥
9.45.e: Stream to thine embassy for us: thou hastenest, for Indra, to  The Gods, O better than our friends.

9.45.d: उत त्वामरुणं वयं गोभिरञ्ज्मो मदाय कम् । वि नो राये दुरो वृधि ॥
9.45.e: We balm thee, red of hue, with milk to fit thee for the rapturous joy:  Unbar for us the doors of wealth.

9.45.d: अत्यू पवित्रमक्रमीद्वाजी धुरं न यामनि । इन्दुर्देवेषु पत्यते ॥
9.45.e: He through the sieve hath passed, as comes a courser to the pole, to run  Indu belongs unto the Gods.

9.45.d: समी सखायो अस्वरन्वने क्रीळन्तमत्यविम् । इन्दुं नावा अनूषत ॥
9.45.e: All friends have lauded him as he sports in the wood, beyond the fleece:  Singers have chanted Indu's praise.

9.45.d: तया पवस्व धारया यया पीतो विचक्षसे । इन्दो स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम् ॥
9.45.e: Flow, Indu, with that stream wherein steeped thou announcest to the man  Who worships thee heroic strength.

9.46.e: LIKE able coursers they have been sent forth to be the feast of Gods,  joying in mountains, flowing on.

9.46.d: परिष्कृतास इन्दवो योषेव पित्र्यावती । वायुं सोमा असृक्षत ॥
9.46.e: To Vāyu flow the Soma-streams, the drops of juice made beautiful  Like a bride dowered by her sire.

9.46.d: एते सोमास इन्दवः प्रयस्वन्तश्चमू सुताः । इन्द्रं वर्धन्ति कर्मभिः ॥
9.46.e: Pressed in the mortar, these, the drops of  juice, the Somas rich in food,  Give strength to Indra with their work.

9.46.d: आ धावता सुहस्त्यः शुक्रा गृभ्णीत मन्थिना । गोभिः श्रीणीत मत्सरम् ॥
9.46.e: Deft-handed men, run hither, seize the brilliant juices blent with meal,  And cook with milk the gladdening draught.

9.46.d: स पवस्व धनंजय प्रयन्ता राधसो महः । अस्मभ्यं सोम गातुवित् ॥
9.46.e: Thus, Soma, Conqueror of wealth! flow, finding furtherance for us,  Giver oF ample opulence.

9.46.d: एतं मृजन्ति मर्ज्यं पवमानं दश क्षिपः । इन्द्राय मत्सरं मदम् ॥
9.46.e: This Pavamana, meet to be adorned, the fingers ten adorn,  The draught that shall make Indra glad.

9.47.d: अया सोमः सुकृत्यया महश्चिदभ्यवर्धत । मन्दान उद्वृषायते ॥
9.47.e: GREAT as he was, Soma hath gained strength by this high solemnity:  joyous he riseth like a bull.

9.47.d: कृतानीदस्य कर्त्वा चेतन्ते दस्युतर्हणा । ऋणा च धृष्णुश्चयते ॥
9.47.e: His task is done: his crushings of the Dasyus are made manifest:  He sternly reckoneth their debts.

9.47.d: आत्सोम इन्द्रियो रसो वज्रः सहस्रसा भुवत् । उक्थं यदस्य जायते ॥
9.47.e: Soon as his song of praise is born, the Soma, Indra's juice, becomes  A thousand-winning thunderbolt.

9.47.d: स्वयं कविर्विधर्तरि विप्राय रत्नमिच्छति । यदी मर्मृज्यते धियः ॥
9.47.e: Seer and Sustainer, he himself desireth riches for the sage  When he embellisheth his songs.
Fain would they both win riches as in races of the steeds. In war  Thou art upon the conquerors' side.

9.48.d: तं त्वा नृम्णानि बिभ्रतं सधस्थेषु महो दिवः । चारुं सुकृत्ययेमहे ॥
9.48.e: WITH sacrifice we seek to thee kind Cherisher of manly might  In mansions of the lofty heavens;

9.48.d: संवृक्तधृष्णुमुक्थ्यं महामहिव्रतं मदम् । शतं पुरो रुरुक्षणिम् ॥
9.48.e: Gladdening crusher of the bold, ruling with very mighty sway,  Destroyer of a hundred forts.

9.48.d: अतस्त्वा रयिमभि राजानं सुक्रतो दिवः । सुपर्णो अव्यथिर्भरत् ॥
9.48.e: Hence, Sapient One! the Falcon, strong of wing, unwearied, brought thee down,  Lord over riches, from the sky.

9.48.d: विश्वस्मा इत्स्वर्दृशे साधारणं रजस्तुरम् । गोपामृतस्य विर्भरत् ॥
9.48.e: That each may see the light, the Bird brought us the guard of Law, the Friend  Of all, the speeder through the air.

9.48.d: अधा हिन्वान इन्द्रियं ज्यायो महित्वमानशे । अभिष्टिकृद्विचर्षणिः ॥
9.48.e: And now, sent forth, it hath attained to mighty power and majesty,  Most active, ready to assist.

9.49.d: पवस्व वृष्टिमा सु नोऽपामूर्मिं दिवस्परि । अयक्ष्मा बृहतीरिषः ॥
9.49.e: Poust down the rain upon us, pour a wave of waters from the sky,  And plenteous store of wholesome fbod.

9.49.d: तया पवस्व धारया यया गाव इहागमन् । जन्यास उप नो गृहम् ॥
9.49.e: Flow onward with that stream of thine, whereby the cows have come to us,  The kine of strangers to our home.

9.49.d: घृतं पवस्व धारया यज्ञेषु देववीतमः । अस्मभ्यं वृष्टिमा पव ॥
9.49.e: Chief Friend of Gods in sacred rites, pour on us fatness with thy stream,  Ppur down on us a flood of rain.

9.49.d: स न ऊर्जे व्य१व्ययं पवित्रं धाव धारया । देवासः शृणवन्हि कम् ॥
9.49.e: To give us vigour, with thy stream run through the fleecy straining-cloth  For verily the Gods will bear.
Onward hath Pavamana flowed and beaten off the Rākṣasas,  Flashing out splendour as of old.

9.50.d: उत्ते शुष्मास ईरते सिन्धोरूर्मेरिव स्वनः । वाणस्य चोदया पविम् ॥
9.50.e: LOUD as a river's roaring wave thy powers have lifted up themselves:  Urge on thine arrow's sharpened point.

9.50.d: प्रसवे त उदीरते तिस्रो वाचो मखस्युवः । यदव्य एषि सानवि ॥
9.50.e: At thine effusion upward rise three voices full of joy, when thou  Flowest upon the fleecy ridge.

9.50.d: अव्यो वारे परि प्रियं हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । पवमानं मधुश्चुतम् ॥
9.50.e: On to the fleece they urge with stone the tawny well-beloved One,  Even Pavamana, dropping meath.

9.50.d: आ पवस्व मदिन्तम पवित्रं धारया कवे । अर्कस्य योनिमासदम् ॥
9.50.e: Flow with thy current to the sieve, O Sage most powerful to cheer,  To seat thee in the place of song.

9.50.d: स पवस्व मदिन्तम गोभिरञ्जानो अक्तुभिः । इन्दविन्द्राय पीतये ॥
9.50.e: Flow, Most Exhilarating! flow anointed with the milk for balm,  Indu, for Indra, for his drink.

9.51.d: अध्वर्यो अद्रिभिः सुतं सोमं पवित्र आ सृज । पुनीहीन्द्राय पातवे ॥
9.51.e: ADHVARYU, on the filter pour the Soma juice expressed with stones,  And make it pure for Indra's drink.

9.51.d: दिवः पीयूषमुत्तमं सोममिन्द्राय वज्रिणे । सुनोता मधुमत्तमम् ॥
9.51.e: Pour out for Indra, Thunder-armed, the milk of heaven,, the Soma's juice,  Most excellent, most rich in sweets.

9.51.d: तव त्य इन्दो अन्धसो देवा मधोर्व्यश्नते । पवमानस्य मरुतः ॥
9.51.e: These Gods and all the Marut host, Indu enjoy this juice of thine,  This Pavamana's flowing meath.

9.51.d: त्वं हि सोम वर्धयन्त्सुतो मदाय भूर्णये । वृषन्त्स्तोतारमूतये ॥
9.51.e: For, Soma, thou hast been effused, strengthening for the wild carouse,  O Steer, the singer, for our help.

9.51.d: अभ्यर्ष विचक्षण पवित्रं धारया सुतः । अभि वाजमुत श्रवः ॥
9.51.e: Flow with thy stream, Far-sighted One, effused, into the cleansing sieve:  Flow on to give us strength and fame.

9.52.d: परि द्युक्षः सनद्रयिर्भरद्वाजं नो अन्धसा । सुवानो अर्ष पवित्र आ ॥
9.52.e: WEALTH-WINNER, dwelling in the sky, bringing us vigour with the juice,  Flow to the filter when effused.

9.52.d: तव प्रत्नेभिरध्वभिरव्यो वारे परि प्रियः । सहस्रधारो यात्तना ॥
9.52.e: So, in thine ancient ways, may he, beloved, with a thousand streams  Run o’er the fleecy straining-cloth.
Him who is like a caldron shake: O Indu, shake thy gift to us  Shake it, armed Warrior! with thine arms.

9.52.d: नि शुष्ममिन्दवेषां पुरुहूत जनानाम् । यो अस्माँ आदिदेशति ॥
9.52.e: Indu, invoked with many a prayer, bring down the vigour of these men,  Of him who threatens us with war.

9.52.d: शतं न इन्द ऊतिभिः सहस्रं वा शुचीनाम् । पवस्व मंहयद्रयिः ॥
9.52.e: Indu, Wealth-giver, with thine help pour out for us a hundred, yea,  A thousand of thy pure bright streams.

9.53.d: उत्ते शुष्मासो अस्थू रक्षो भिन्दन्तो अद्रिवः । नुदस्व याः परिस्पृधः ॥
9.53.e: O THOU with stones for arms, thy powers, crushing the fiends, have raised themselves:  Chase thou the foes who compass us.

9.53.d: अया निजघ्निरोजसा रथसंगे धने हिते । स्तवा अबिभ्युषा हृदा ॥
9.53.e: Thou conquerest thus with might when car meets car, and when the prize is staked:  With fearless heart will I sing praise.

9.53.d: अस्य व्रतानि नाधृषे पवमानस्य दूढ्या । रुज यस्त्वा पृतन्यति ॥
9.53.e: No one with evil thought assails this Pavamana's holy laws:  Crush him who fain would fight with thee.

9.53.d: तं हिन्वन्ति मदच्युतं हरिं नदीषु वाजिनम् । इन्दुमिन्द्राय मत्सरम् ॥
9.53.e: For Indra to the streams they drive the tawny rapture-dropping Steed,  Indu the bringer of delight.

9.54.d: अस्य प्रत्नामनु द्युतं शुक्रं दुदुह्रे अह्रयः । पयः सहस्रसामृषिम् ॥
9.54.e: AFTER his ancient splendour, they, the bold, have drawn the bright milk from  The Sage who wins a thousand gifts.

9.54.d: अयं सूर्य इवोपदृगयं सरांसि धावति । सप्त प्रवत आ दिवम् ॥
9.54.e: In aspect he is like the Sun; he runneth forward to the lakes,  Seven currents flowing through the sky.

9.54.d: अयं विश्वानि तिष्ठति पुनानो भुवनोपरि । सोमो देवो न सूर्यः ॥
9.54.e: He, shining in his splendour, stands high over all things that exist-  Soma, a God as Sūrya is.

9.54.d: परि णो देववीतये वाजाँ अर्षसि गोमतः । पुनान इन्दविन्द्रयुः ॥
9.54.e: Thou, Indu, in thy brilliancy, pourest on us, as Indra's Friend,  Wealth from the kine to feast the Gods.

9.55.d: यवंयवं नो अन्धसा पुष्टम्पुष्टं परि स्रव । सोम विश्वा च सौभगा ॥
9.55.e: POUR on us with thy juice all kinds of corn, each sort of nourishment,  And, Soma, all felicities.

9.55.d: इन्दो यथा तव स्तवो यथा ते जातमन्धसः । नि बर्हिषि प्रिये सदः ॥
9.55.e: As thine, O Indu, is the praise, and thine what springeth from the juice,  Seat thee on the dear sacred grass.
And, finding for us kine and steeds, O Soma, with thy juice flow on  Through days that fly most rapidly.

9.55.d: यो जिनाति न जीयते हन्ति शत्रुमभीत्य । स पवस्व सहस्रजित् ॥
9.55.e: As one who conquers, ne’er subdued, attacks and stays the enemy,  Thus, Vanquisher of thousands! flow.

9.56.d: परि सोम ऋतं बृहदाशुः पवित्रे अर्षति । विघ्नन्रक्षांसि देवयुः ॥
9.56.e: SWIFT to the purifying sieve flows Soma as exalted Law,  Slaying the fiends, loving the Gods.

9.56.d: यत्सोमो वाजमर्षति शतं धारा अपस्युवः । इन्द्रस्य सख्यमाविशन् ॥
9.56.e: When Soma pours the strengthening food a hundred ever-active streams  To Indra's friendship win theirway.

9.56.d: अभि त्वा योषणो दश जारं न कन्यानूषत । मृज्यसे सोम सातये ॥
9.56.e: Ten Dames have sung to welcome thee, even as a maiden greets her love:  O Soma, thou art decked to win.

9.56.d: त्वमिन्द्राय विष्णवे स्वादुरिन्दो परि स्रव । नॄन्त्स्तोतॄन्पाह्यंहसः ॥
9.56.e: Flow hitherward, O Indu, sweet to Indra and to Viṣṇu: guard  The men, the singers, from distress.

9.57.d: प्र ते धारा असश्चतो दिवो न यन्ति वृष्टयः । अच्छा वाजं सहस्रिणम् ॥
9.57.e: THY streams that never fail or waste flow forth like showers of rain from heaven,  To bring a thousand stores of strength.

9.57.d: अभि प्रियाणि काव्या विश्वा चक्षाणो अर्षति । हरिस्तुञ्जान आयुधा ॥
9.57.e: He flows beholding on his way all wellbeloved sacred lore,  Green-tinted, brandishing his, arms.

9.57.d: स मर्मृजान आयुभिरिभो राजेव सुव्रतः । श्येनो न वंसु षीदति ॥
9.57.e: He, when the people deck him like a docile king of elephants.  Sits as a falcon in the, wood.

9.57.d: स नो विश्वा दिवो वसूतो पृथिव्या अधि । पुनान इन्दवा भर ॥
9.57.e: So bring thou hitherward to us, Indu, while thou art purified,  All treasures both of heaven and earth.

9.58.d: तरत्स मन्दी धावति धारा सुतस्यान्धसः । तरत्स मन्दी धावति ॥
9.58.e: SWIFT runs this giver of delight, even the stream of flowing juice:  Swift runs this giver of delight.

9.58.d: उस्रा वेद वसूनां मर्तस्य देव्यवसः । तरत्स मन्दी धावति ॥
9.58.e: The Morning knows all precious things, the Goddess knows her grace to man:  Swift runs this giver of delight.

9.58.d: ध्वस्रयोः पुरुषन्त्योरा सहस्राणि दद्महे । तरत्स मन्दी धावति ॥
9.58.e: We have accepted thousands from Dhvasra's and Puruṣanti's hands:  Swift runs this giver of delight.

9.58.d: आ ययोस्त्रिंशतं तना सहस्राणि च दद्महे । तरत्स मन्दी धावति ॥
9.58.e: From whom we have accepted thus thousands and three times ten beside:  Swift runs this giver of delight.
